messages.msgid: Your digestive system and power supply are interconnected; bionic energy is replenished by burning calories.  Can be toggled on and off at will.
translations: 你的消化系统和生化能量系统被连接到了一起，可以通过消耗卡路里来恢复生化能量。可以随意开关。

messages.msgid: You're visibly shaken up, and are having a hard time focusing on what's going on around you.
translations: 你明显被震晕了，很难集中精神注意到发生在你身边的事情。

messages.msgid: Range of Sight: 0.  You cannot see anything.
translations: 视野降至0，你看不到任何东西。

messages.msgid: You can't hear anything and your head aches from all the noise.  You can't converse with NPCs.
translations: 你听不见任何声音，噪音让你脑袋发疼，你无法与他人对话了。
你可以再次听到声音了！

messages.msgid: Your stomach is extremely upset, and you are quite nauseated.
translations: 你的胃中不停地翻滚，你感到非常的恶心。
你的胃不停地让你分心。

messages.msgid: You are disoriented as strange visions flash through your mind.
translations: 当奇怪的幻觉闪过你的脑海时，你有点迷失了方向。

messages.msgid: You are overwhelmed by the disturbing imagery and concepts you're flooded with.
translations: 你的脑中充满了那些令人不安的图像和概念。

messages.msgid: You can't comprehend the things around you…
translations: 你无法理解你周围的事物……

messages.msgid: You don't know what is and isn't real anymore…
translations: 你无法分清真实和虚幻……
你对现实的感觉扭曲了！

messages.msgid: You sense something emitting electricity here.
translations: 你感觉这里有东西在放电。

messages.msgid: You sense an otherworldy danger here.
translations: 你感觉到这里有一种异界的危险。

messages.msgid: You add the facilities to your map.
translations: 你在地图上标记了这个地点。
回收的 CMES 激光炮
回收的 RMES 狙击系统

messages.msgid: You pull the pin on the grenade.
translations: 你拉开了手雷的保险销。

messages.msgid: Your head is pounding and you feel unwell.
translations: 你的头很痛，感觉不舒服。

messages.msgid: Your head throbs and it's hard to see straight.
translations: 你的头在抽痛，很难看清楚。

messages.msgid: You can barely think through the pain in your head.
translations: 你几乎无法思考头脑中的痛苦。

messages.msgid: Your skull feels like it's going to explode.
translations: 你的头骨感觉要爆炸了。

messages.msgid: The agony is the only thing in the world that matters.
translations: 痛苦是世界上仅剩的事情了。

messages.msgid: Your powers reveal electrical creatures and robots to you.
translations: 你的灵能会向你展示带电生物和机器人。

messages.msgid: You can no longer sense the flow of current.
translations: 你再也感受不到电流的流动了。

messages.msgid: Your body is filled with electrical currents.
The tingling on your skin fades.
translations: 皮肤上的酥麻感消失了。

messages.msgid: You can no longer manipulate the circuitry of nearby devices.
translations: 你无法再操纵附近的电子设备。

messages.msgid: You are generating a wireless aura of electrical power.
translations: 你身边环绕着无形的带电光环。

messages.msgid: You stop the flow of electricity to your devices.
translations: 你停止向随身个人设备供电。

messages.msgid: Your powers are affecting movement around you; dangerous objects are slowed and your own speed is increased.
translations: 你的灵能正在影响你周围的运动；危险物体的速度会减慢，你自己的速度也会增加。
附近的动量恢复了正常。

messages.msgid: You are looking out for other minds.
translations: 你开始探查其它的思维体。

messages.msgid: Your awareness of other minds fades away.
translations: 你对其他思维体的感知消失了。
你感知到此地存在智慧生物。

messages.msgid: Your mind is warded against telepathic attack or detection.
translations: 你的思维对心灵攻击或侦测有所防护。

messages.msgid: Your thoughts are once again unguarded.
translations: 你的思维再次失去了防护。
你可以黑掉附近的设备。
你感觉到这里有东西在动。

messages.msgid: The ability to read thoughts and influence others' minds.
translations: 读懂思想并影响他人思想的能力。

messages.msgid: You are capable of holding the same thing in mind even when sitting in an uncomfortable position or after skipping a meal.
translations: 即使坐姿难受或者没有进食，你也能维持一样的思绪。

messages.msgid: You can maintain your concentration even when suffering crippling injuries or while on mind-altering substances.
translations: 即使在遭受严重伤害或服用改变思维的物质时你也仍能保持专注。

messages.msgid:
End your concentration on all of your maintained powers.

Channeling this power <color_green>always succeeds</color>.
translations:
结束对所有维持的灵能的专注。

引导这种灵能<color_green>总是成功</color>。

messages.msgid:
Open your senses to the flow of electricity, revealing nearby electrical creatures or robots.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
开始尝试感受电流的流动，定位附近的带电生物或机器人。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid: Unleash a shock when touching a target, doing a small amount of damage and dazing them.
translations: 对接触到的目标释放一道电击，造成少量伤害并使其眩晕。
在你的手上有电流噼啪跳动。

messages.msgid:
Create an electrical interface with your powers, allowing you to hack nearby devices as if you were using a computer.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
用灵能创建一个电子接口，让你可以像使用电脑一样破解附近的电子设备。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid: Turn your own energy into power for a vehicle or appliance.  You need merely touch the vehicle or any part of the power grid to recharge the batteries.
translations: 将体内的灵能转化为车辆或设备的电力。触摸车辆或电网的任何部位即可进行充电。
灵能流进了你的目标之中。

messages.msgid: Move a set of items towards or away from you.
translations: 将一组物品朝你移动或者移走。

messages.msgid: Shove a target away or pull it towards you with a burst of psionic force.  The distance the target can be moved depends on its weight versus your power level; heavier things will not go as far, and if your target is too heavy, you may not be able to move it at all.
translations: 用一股灵能将目标生物推开或拉向你。目标可以移动的距离取决于它的重量与你的灵能等级；更重的物品不会被移动得太远，如果你的目标太重，你可能根本无法移动它。

messages.msgid:
Edit the momentum of yourself and nearby objects to your benefit, slowing damaging force and slightly increasing your speed.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
操控自己和附近物体的动量，以获取战斗优势，减少受到的伤害并略微增加你的速度。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid: Unleash a telekinetic wave around you that indiscriminately knocks everything back.
translations: 在你周围释放一股心灵震波，不分青红皂白地将一切击退。
你操控念力波击退周围的一切事物！

messages.msgid: Smash a single target or small area with a fist of telekinetic force.
translations: 用灵能砸击单个目标或小片区域。

messages.msgid: You smash your target with a fist of force.
translations: 你使用灵能砸击你的目标。

messages.msgid:
You can use your powers to detect the tell-tale hum of a living, sapient mind, no matter how strange or alien it may be.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
你可以利用你的灵能来察觉到一个有生命、有智慧的思维的微弱嗡鸣声，无论它多么奇怪或陌生。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid: Disconnect a target's brain from its senses, leaving it blinded and confused.
translations: 切断目标的大脑与其感官的连接，使其失明和困惑。

messages.msgid: You lock your target's mind away!
The is the part of the Sensory Deprivation that blinds the target.  It's a bug if you have it.
translations: 意识剥夺能力的一部分，使目标失明。拥有这个能力说明你出bug了。

messages.msgid: You assault the mind of your target!
You take control of the animal's mind!
A cool breeze hits your skin.
translations: 一阵冷风吹拂你的皮肤。

messages.msgid: You bleed much less than normal.
translations: 你流血的速度大大减慢了。

messages.msgid: Minute quantities of matrix crystal interface with your optic nerves, allowing you to detect the presence of living beings that seek to do you harm.  Activate to toggle on.
translations: 微量的矩阵晶体接驳着你的视神经，使你能够侦测到那些意图伤害你的生命体。激活以开启。

messages.msgid: A Compact Bionics Module that increases your power capacity by 600 kJ.
translations: 一个紧凑型生化插件，能将你的能量储备上限提升600千焦。

messages.msgid: A series of implants along your skeleton and in major muscle groups can be activated to greatly increase your strength and agility.  Activate to toggle on.
translations: 一系列植入体沿你的骨骼与主要肌群分布，激活后能极大增强你的力量和敏捷。激活以开启。

messages.msgid: Implants under your skin throughout your body that bend light around you when activated, making it much harder to spot you from a distance.  While not invisibility, it can keep you unseen when it counts.  Activate to toggle on.
translations: 遍布你全身皮下的植入体在激活时能扭曲周身的光线，让你在远处极难被发现。这并非完全隐形，但在关键时刻能让你不被察觉。激活以开启。

messages.msgid: You are immune to life drain.
You are immune to forcible teleportation.
You are protected against telepathic attack.  Sometimes.
translations: 你有时候能够免受心灵攻击。

messages.msgid: This is a matrix crystal attuned to biokinesis.
translations: 与炼体术同调的矩阵晶体

messages.msgid: This is a matrix crystal attuned to clairsentience.
translations: 与灵视术同调的矩阵晶体

messages.msgid: This is a matrix crystal attuned to electrokinesis.
translations: 与控电术同调的矩阵晶体

messages.msgid: This is a matrix crystal attuned to photokinesis.
translations: 与控光术同调的矩阵晶体

messages.msgid: This is a matrix crystal attuned to pyrokinesis.
translations: 与焰动术同调的矩阵晶体

messages.msgid: This is a matrix crystal attuned to telekinesis.
translations: 与念动术同调的矩阵晶体

messages.msgid: This is a matrix crystal attuned to telepathy.
translations: 与传心术同调的矩阵晶体

messages.msgid: This is a matrix crystal attuned to teleportation.
translations: 与传送术同调的矩阵晶体

messages.msgid: This is a matrix crystal attuned to vitakinesis.
translations: 与疗愈术同调的矩阵晶体

messages.msgid: This is a matrix crystal with an unclear attunement.
Psionic powers for Cataclysm.  The Readme contains extensive information on how the process of gaining and using powers works, so make sure to check it if you're confused.
translations: 大灾变也要有灵能。 说明文档中包含如何获取和使用灵能的详细信息，因此如果你使用本模组时有任何疑问，请务必查看它。

messages.msgid: Your ability to manipulate forces of energy often considered supernatural.
translations: 操纵能量的超自然能力。

messages.msgid: There is a long moment of darkness and terrible cold that seems like it will freeze your heart, and then you are somewhere else.
translations: 伴随着一段漫长黑暗和似乎能冻结你心灵的可怕寒冷，你到了另一个地方。

messages.msgid: Your stomach is seized with cramps!
You're not exactly sure what morphic reinforcement means, but it definitely itches like crazy.
translations: 你不确定“形态加固”具体是什么意思，但这玩意儿绝对让你痒得要命。
剧烈的瘙痒最终消失了。

messages.msgid: The air around you is wavering strangely.
translations: 周围的空气都在奇怪地波动。

messages.msgid: The world takes on a slightly bent look, as though you're a straw inserted into a glass of water.
translations: 世界看起来有点弯曲，就像你插在一杯水中的吸管。

messages.msgid: The world snaps back into focus.
You are chilled from the inside out.
translations: 你感到寒意自内而外地袭来。

messages.msgid: A numbing cold spreads out from your stomach to your whole body.
translations: 一股麻木的寒意从你的胃部蔓延至全身。

messages.msgid: A roar fills your mind and you stagger!
translations: 一声咆哮充斥着你的脑海，你踉跄了一下！

messages.msgid: Your body twitches under the electrical assault!
translations: 你的身体在电击下抽搐！

messages.msgid: You are more resilient than normal.
You are enhancing your speed and senses.

translations: 你正在提升自己的速度。

messages.msgid: Causes the target to eventually die.  It's a bug if you have it.
translations: 导致目标最终死亡。拥有这个效果的话是bug。

messages.msgid: A faint glow springs up around you!
translations: 你的周围涌现出微弱的光芒！

messages.msgid: The faint glow around you fades away.
translations: 你周身的微光逐渐消散。

messages.msgid: You are glowing.  The light is a color you have no name for, a kind of actinic purple-red.
translations: 你在发光。这种光是一种你无法命名的颜色，一种带有活性的紫红色。

messages.msgid: A harsh glow springs up around you!
translations: 一道明亮的光芒在你周围升起！

messages.msgid: The harsh glow around you fades away.
translations: 你周围的刺眼光芒逐渐消散。

messages.msgid: You are altering the motion of nearby objects in your favor.
translations: 你让四周物体的运动变得对你更有利。

messages.msgid: A barrier of telekinetic force is protecting you.
translations: 一面念力屏障正在保护你。

messages.msgid: You have a shield up to prevent telepathic detection and attack.
translations: 你已升起一道护盾，用以防御心灵感应的侦测与攻击。

messages.msgid: Your mind is filled with whispers just below the threshold of understanding, making it almost impossible to think.
translations: 你的脑海里充满了若有若无的低语，让你几乎无法思考。

messages.msgid: A chorus of whispers just below the threshold of understanding fills your mind.
translations: 无数难以明辨的低语在你脑中汇成一片。

messages.msgid: You will automatically teleport enemies that strike you away from yourself.
translations: 攻击你的敌人会被自动传送到别处。

messages.msgid: Your melee attacks travel further than the range of your weapons makes it seem like they should.
translations: 你的近战攻击距离超出了武器应有的范围。

messages.msgid: You feel like you're barely part of the world.
translations: 你似乎感觉自己不是这个世界的一部分。

messages.msgid: With a jolt you feel more solid again.
translations: 随着身体一震，你感到自己再次变得坚实。

messages.msgid: You feel a strange, inward force.
translations: 你感到一阵奇怪的、向内的力。

messages.msgid: The strange, inward force suddenly vanishes.
translations: 那种向内的奇怪的力消失了。

messages.msgid: The feeling of weakness fades away.

translations: 你感到疲惫不堪，身体发虚。

messages.msgid: Your skin seems to be slowly crumbling as you watch.
translations: 你眼看着皮肤似乎在慢慢崩溃。

messages.msgid: Blood sample contains noetic steroid particles and pigeon dander.
translations: 血样中含有灵能类固醇微粒与鸽子皮屑。

messages.msgid: Patient has allergens in blood stream.
translations: 患者血液中含有过敏原。

messages.msgid: You feel a little odd and your control over your powers isn't as sure as it was.  There might be unexpected results of you channeling psionics now.
translations: 你感觉有点奇怪，对自身的灵能控制不如从前。现在引导灵能可能会出现意外。

messages.msgid: You feel a little odd, like you've just awoken from a dream.  All that psionic channeling might have unexpected effects.
translations: 你感觉有点奇怪，就像刚从梦中醒来。引导了过多灵能可能带来了意想不到的效果。

messages.msgid: Your mind thrums with power.  It's intoxicating, but growing increasingly harder to control.
translations: 力量在你的意识中轰鸣。这感觉令人陶醉，却也愈发难以掌控。

messages.msgid: Your whole body pulses with a raging torrent of energy.  It's taking almost all of your concentration to hold on.
translations: 狂暴的能量洪流在你体内奔涌。你必须倾尽全副心神才能勉强压制。

messages.msgid: You take a deep breath as the strange feelings fade.  You are in full control of your powers once again.
translations: 你深吸一口气，奇怪的感觉渐渐消失。你再次完全掌控自己的灵能。

messages.msgid: The constant hum of power fades, just a little.  It's easier to think now.
translations: 持续不断的能量嗡鸣声稍稍减弱。现在思绪清晰多了。

messages.msgid: The roar of the Nether subsides.  You can finally hear your own thoughts again.
translations: 来自虚空的咆哮逐渐平息。你终于能再次听清自己的思绪了。

messages.msgid: You have the strong impression that someone, or something, is watching you.
translations: 你有一种强烈的感觉，有人或某物正在观察着你。

messages.msgid: The endless feeling of being watched finally fades away.
translations: 一直存在着被监视的感觉终于消失了。
刺痒的感觉最终消失了。

messages.msgid: You have to work extra hard to draw enough energy to use your powers.
translations: 汲取施展能力所需的能量变得格外费力。

messages.msgid: Your difficulty in drawing on the Nether fades.
translations: 你汲取虚空能量时的滞涩感消失了。

messages.msgid: Whenever you use your powers, your stomach rumbles.
translations: 每当你动用自身灵能，腹中便会传来阵阵声音。

messages.msgid: You feel a persistent itching that will not go away.
translations: 你感到一种挥之不去的刺挠。
那股诡异的寒意消散了。

messages.msgid: You're getting pretty hungry and thirsty.
Your gnawing hunger finally fades away.
translations: 啃噬般的饥饿感终于消退了。

messages.msgid: You feel the sensation of watching eyes and see prowling forms out of the corners of your vision.  Using further teleportation powers would be very unwise.
translations: 你感到芒刺在背，眼角余光瞥见有黑影在四周潜行。此时再动用传送能力绝非明智之举。

messages.msgid: The prowling forms finally fade away.
translations: 那些潜行的黑影终于消散了。

messages.msgid: A roiling fog coalesces out of the surrounding air.
translations: 周遭的空气中凝聚出一片翻腾的浓雾。

messages.msgid: The roiling fog surrounding you dissipates.
translations: 你周遭翻腾的浓雾消散了。
你的神经系统得到了强化。
你的反应水平变回了普通人。

messages.msgid: Your exposure to the portal storm has awakened latent psionic powers in you.
translations: 你暴露在空间风暴中已经唤醒了你体内潜在的灵能。

messages.msgid: You feel a dull pain behind your eyes and a terrible sense of loss.
translations: 你感到眼睛后方隐隐作痛，伴随着一种可怕的失落感。

messages.msgid: You have a sudden sense of regaining something you had lost.
translations: 你突然感到重新获得了你失去的东西。

messages.msgid: Something is directly interfering with your use of psionics.
translations: 有东西直接干扰你使用灵能。

messages.msgid: You sense of acute vulnerability fades.
translations: 你不在感到那种极端的脆弱。

messages.msgid: You're in so much pain you can't concentrate to use your powers!
translations: 你太痛了，无法集中精力使用灵能！

messages.msgid: You're having a hard time getting enough air.
translations: 你感觉自己呼吸不上来。

messages.msgid: You finally manage to catch your breath
Your muscles and coordination are impaired.
translations: 你的肌肉和协调能力受损。
你的肌肉因为虚弱而颤抖！

messages.msgid: You muscles don't seem to be reacting exactly the way you want them to.
translations: 你的肌肉似乎不完全按照你想要的方式工作。
你的肢体不由自主地抽搐！

messages.msgid: The glow from your skin fades.
translations: 你皮肤上的光芒逐渐消退。

messages.msgid: Objects in the distance aren't where they seem to be.
translations: 远处的物体并不在他们看起来的地方。

messages.msgid: You shake your head as your vision clears.
translations: 你晃晃头，视野最终清晰了起来。

messages.msgid: The air feels much cooler now.
The air around you is overheating!
translations: 你周围的空气变得十分炎热！

messages.msgid: With a jolt, you feel more solid again.
translations: 猛地一震，你感觉自己重新变得坚实。

messages.msgid: Nothing is quite where it seems to be.
translations: 所有物体都不像是看上去的样子。

messages.msgid: Your vision doesn't agree with where things seem to actually be
translations: 你的视野似乎与实际情况不一致
距离似乎又回到了原样。

messages.msgid: The air itself seems to press down on you!
translations: 像是空气本身都在压下你！

messages.msgid: You don't feel as bad anymore!
translations: 你不再感到那么糟糕了！

messages.msgid: You're having a very hard time taking in enough air.
translations: 你很难吸入足够的空气。
你终于能够自由呼吸了。

messages.msgid: Your eyes are burning and your nose is gushing mucus.
translations: 你的眼睛疼痛，鼻子里全是鼻涕。

messages.msgid: You're suffering the effects of drinking the concentrated matrix crystal concoction.
translations: 你正承受着浓缩矩阵晶体药剂的效力反噬。

messages.msgid: The concoction's effects finally wear off.
You drank the concentrated matrix crystal concoction.
translations: 你饮下了浓缩的矩阵晶体药剂。

messages.msgid: The concoction's effects fade and are replaced with a gnawing weakness.
translations: 混合药剂的效果逐渐消退，被一种令人痛苦的虚弱感所取代。

messages.msgid: You're suffering the aftereffects of drinking the concentrated matrix crystal concoction.
translations: 你正在承受饮用浓缩矩阵晶体药剂的后遗症。

messages.msgid: The concoction's aftereffects finally wear off.
translations: 矩阵灵药的副作用最终消失了。

messages.msgid: The concoction's effects fade and darkness creeps in at the edges of your vision.
translations: 混合药剂的效果逐渐消退，黑暗在你的视野边缘蔓延。

messages.msgid: The concoction's effects fade and your muscles twitch.
translations: 药效消退，你的肌肉随之抽搐。

messages.msgid: The concoction's effects fade and your vision warps.
translations: 药效渐渐消退，你的眼前景象开始扭曲。

messages.msgid: The concoction's effects fade and are replaced with a burning heat.
translations: 混合药剂的效果逐渐消退，被一股灼热的热量所取代。

messages.msgid: The concoction's effects fade and you suddenly feel like something is pressing down on you.
translations: 混合药剂的效果消退，你突然感到有什么东西压在你身上。

messages.msgid: The concoction's effects fade and it gets hard to think straight.
translations: 混合药剂的效果逐渐消退，思维变得困难。

messages.msgid: The concoction's effects fade and you suddenly feel stretched, like something unseen is pulling at you.
translations: 混合药剂的效果逐渐消退，你突然感到被拉扯着，仿佛有什么看不见的东西在牵引着你。

messages.msgid: The concoction's effects fade and you stagger as you suddenly feel faint.
translations: 混合药剂的效果逐渐消退，你突然感到头晕，踉跄起来。

messages.msgid: You are fortified against too strong a connection with the Nether.
translations: 你受到了强化，避免与异界产生过强的联系。

messages.msgid: Your protection against too much connection to the Nether fades away.
translations: 你身上对过量异界联系的防护消散了。

messages.msgid: Your psionic capacity, and physical stamina, are reduced by the aftereffects of the noetic resilience treatment.
translations: 你的灵能和体力因为坚韧灵能的后遗症而降低。

messages.msgid: You feel a sudden weakness in your body.
translations: 你突然感到身体变得虚弱。

messages.msgid: You feel your strength and ability to channel your powers finally return to normal.
translations: 你感觉体力和灵能恢复到了正常水平。

messages.msgid: It's taking a lot of concentration to maintain your powers.
translations: 维持你目前的灵能需要耗费许多专注。

messages.msgid: You are enhancing your physical prowess.
translations: 你强化了你的身体力量

messages.msgid: The surge of power fades away.
Your powers are slightly lessening the pain you feel.
translations: 你用灵能稍微抑制了痛觉。
你的伤口再次感到痛楚。

messages.msgid: The pain you've been keeping away is starting to creep back in.
translations: 被抑制的疼痛开始悄悄出现。

messages.msgid: Your powers are lessening the pain you feel.
translations: 你用灵能减弱感受到的疼痛。

messages.msgid: Your powers are greatly lessening the pain you feel.
translations: 你用灵能抑制了大量的疼痛。

messages.msgid: Your powers are enormously lessening the pain you feel.
translations: 你用灵能最大限度地减弱疼痛。

messages.msgid: You can absorb oxygen through your skin.
translations: 你可以通过皮肤吸收氧气。

messages.msgid: You are enhancing your range of motion.
Your joints creak as your limbs lose their flexibility.
translations: 你的关节吱呀作响，肢体开始失去灵活性。
世界恢复到了正常速度。

messages.msgid: Your skin is more resilient thanks to psionic energy.
translations: 你的皮肤因为灵能而变得更坚韧。

messages.msgid: The slight itching and waxiness in your skin fades away.
translations: 皮肤轻微的瘙痒感和油蜡感逐渐消退。

messages.msgid: You are better at dealing with extremes of heat and cold.
translations: 你更擅长应对极端的炎热和寒冷。
温度又开始让人不爽了。

messages.msgid: The temperature is really starting to get to you.
translations: 温度真的让你快受不了了。

messages.msgid: Your adaptation to extreme temperatures is fading.
translations: 你对极端温度的适应力正在减弱。

messages.msgid: You find it much easier to move in encumbering gear.
translations: 穿着累赘的装备运动变得更容易了一些。

messages.msgid: Your gear suddenly seems to weigh you down.
translations: 你的装备突然感觉变得很沉重。

messages.msgid: Your bare hands substitute for several common tools.
translations: 你的双手可以替代一些常见的工具。

messages.msgid: You're no longer capable of hammering in a nail with your thumb.
translations: 你再也不能用你的拇指敲钉子了。

messages.msgid: You are protected from the dangers of the world.
translations: 你受到保护，免受世界的危险。

messages.msgid: You let out your breath in a rush.
You need to take a new breath, and soon!
Your lungs are straining with the effort of holding your breath.
translations: 你的肺正在努力对抗屏住呼吸的压力。

messages.msgid: Your metabolism is far more efficient than before.
translations: 你的新陈代谢比以前更有效率。

messages.msgid: You are a dynamo of death.
translations: 你是不知疲倦的杀戮化身。

messages.msgid: Your biology is running out of control.  Perhaps extensively drawing on the netherium was a bad idea.
translations: 你的身体机能正在失控。看来，过度汲取虚质的力量终究是个馊主意。

messages.msgid: Netherium energy surges through your cells, changing them in an unknowable way.  Something is about to change.
translations: 虚质能量在你的细胞中奔涌，以一种不可知的方式改造着它们。某种变化，即将来临。

messages.msgid: Whenever you mutate, you may pick the resulting mutation from a selection of options.
translations: 每当你发生变异时，都可以从一系列选项中选择最终获得的变异。

messages.msgid: You are no longer controlling your evolution.
translations: 你已无法掌控自身的进化。

messages.msgid: You feel like you can outrun a locomotive.
translations: 你感觉自己能跑过火车。

messages.msgid: The world returns to normal speed.
translations: 世界回到了正常的速度。

messages.msgid: Your movements are slower and slower now.
translations: 你的速度开始逐渐减慢。

messages.msgid: The world begins speeding up around you.
translations: 周围的世界逐渐加速恢复。

messages.msgid: You can attack faster than thought.
translations: 你的攻击速度快过了思维。

messages.msgid: You are steadily converting calories into vitamins.
translations: 你正在持续地将卡路里转化为维生素。

messages.msgid: You are enhancing your mundane senses.
translations: 你正在强化自身的凡俗感官。

messages.msgid: You can sense your surroundings in the dark.
translations: 你可以在黑暗中感知周围的环境。

messages.msgid: The darkness hides your surroundings again.
translations: 黑暗再次遮蔽了周围的环境。

messages.msgid: You are absorbing knowledge from books like a sponge absorbs water.
translations: 你正在像海绵吸水一样吸收书本中的知识。

messages.msgid: You know there's something out there.
The sense of danger fades away, but you know the danger remains.
translations: 危险仍然存在，但你对它的感知正逐渐消失。
你在此处察觉到了危险。

messages.msgid: Swirling colors are visible around others, revealing their emotions.
translations: 人们周围环绕着彩色灵气，揭示着他们的情绪。

messages.msgid: Your vulnerabilities have been laid open.
You no longer feel so exposed.
Your powers make aiming much easier for you.
translations: 你的灵能让你更容易瞄准。

messages.msgid: The world lurches as apparent distances snap back into place.
translations: 世界颤动，明了的距离重新变得不确定。
你可以感知环境的辐射。

messages.msgid: The ambient glow of radiation is almost invisible now.
translations: 辐射的辉光淡得让人难以察觉。

messages.msgid: Your ability to sense radiation is fading.
translations: 你感知辐射的能力正在减弱。

messages.msgid: You can see your enemies' attacks in advance.
translations: 你可以提前看到敌人的攻击。

messages.msgid: The fore-images of your enemies fade away.
translations: 指示敌人攻击的虚像消失了。

messages.msgid: You just know what you need to do next.  It's harder for you to pay attention to anything else due to the shifting futures, however, and you will lose awareness of the outside world entirely when making something.
translations: 你本能地知道下一步该做什么。然而，变幻莫测的未来让你难以专注于他事，在制作物品时，你会完全失去对外界的感知。

messages.msgid: Your powers allow you to see the true shape of reality.
translations: 你的灵能让你能够看到现实的真实面貌。

messages.msgid: The world seems wrapped in gauze compared to before.
translations: 世界重新被笼罩上了一层纱。
你的灵行走在此世界之上。

messages.msgid: You're being informed of the best way to fight.
translations: 你掌握着充足的信息便于指挥战斗。

messages.msgid: You're calling out tactics to your followers.  It's much harder to concentrate on your own defense.
translations: 你专注于指导你的同伴战斗。这使分出注意力保护自己变得困难。

messages.msgid: As the visions fade, you stop calling out orders.
translations: 随着预知视野的消失，你停止了对战斗的指挥。

messages.msgid: Your senses snap back to your physical body.
translations: 你的知觉回到了你的肉身里。

messages.msgid: Your melee attacks unleash electrical blasts.
translations: 电流附加到你武器的每一次挥动中。

messages.msgid: Your hands no longer spark with electricity.
translations: 你的手上不再闪烁电光。

messages.msgid: You have constructed an electrical interface to hack nearby devices.
translations: 你创造出了一个能黑掉附近的电子设备的接口。

messages.msgid: Your muscles are twitching and won't obey you!
translations: 你的肌肉正在抽搐，完全不听使唤！

messages.msgid: When it hurts, it won't hurt as much.
translations: 疼痛来袭时似乎有所减弱。

messages.msgid: Your nerves burn for a moment as a surge of pain hits them.
translations: 一阵疼痛袭来，你的神经感觉火辣辣的。

messages.msgid: You can't feel anything.  That means everything is fine, right?  Everything is fine.
translations: 你什么都感觉不到。这意味着一切都好，对吧？一切都好。

messages.msgid: All of your pain rushes back in!
translations: 你之前的疼痛卷土重来了！

messages.msgid: Your wounds are starting to ache.
translations: 你的伤口又开始隐隐作痛。

messages.msgid: You are enhancing your nervous system.
Anyone nearby risks being blasted by lightning.
translations: 电流场附近的任何人都可能会遭受电击。

messages.msgid: The thrum in the air around you dissipates.
translations: 你附近空气中的嗡嗡声消失了。

messages.msgid: The crackling aura around you is fading quickly.
translations: 你周围的带电场正在加速减弱。

messages.msgid: The lightning blasts are growing less powerful.
You still remain immune to the effects of electricity, if only briefly.
translations: 你仍然可以免受电击，哪怕只是暂时的。

messages.msgid: The air above your hand glows faintly.
translations: 你手上亮着一团微弱的光芒。

messages.msgid: A faint light springs up over your hand.
translations: 一团微弱的光芒在你的手中出现。

messages.msgid: The glow above your hand fades.
translations: 你手中的光芒渐渐消逝了。

messages.msgid: The air around you is glowing.
translations: 你周身的空气正散发着微光。
一圈光芒勾勒出你的轮廓。

messages.msgid: You are surrounded by shifting illusions, and your enemies struggle to see where your true form is.
translations: 你被不断变化的幻象所包裹，使敌人难以看清你的正体。

messages.msgid: The illusions around you suddenly vanish!
translations: 你周围的幻象彻底消失了！

messages.msgid: You bending nearby light to make yourself more difficult to spot.
translations: 你扭曲周围的光线，隐蔽自己的身形。

messages.msgid: You stop bending light around your location.
translations: 你停止扭曲附近的光线。

messages.msgid: You are protected from extremes of light and radiation.
translations: 你被极强的光线于辐射所保护着。

messages.msgid: The surrounding air shimmers once more as your light barrier fades.
translations: 随着灵光屏障的减弱，周围的空气再次开始闪烁。

messages.msgid: You're just another survivor.  There's definitely nothing odd about you at all.
translations: 你只是又一个幸存者罢了。嗯，你身上没什么古怪。

messages.msgid: The illusions around you fall away.
You can interpret and transmit radio waves.
translations: 你可以转译和收发无线电波。

messages.msgid: You stop paying attention to the radio waves around you.
translations: 你不再留意周围的电磁波。

messages.msgid: The obscuring veil of light fades, revealing your presence.
translations: 朦胧的光之帷幕缓缓消失，展露出你的存在。

messages.msgid: Your arms refract light to create the illusion of having multiple arms and their wielded items.
translations: 你的手臂折射光线，像有三头六臂一般，一齐挥动着武器。

messages.msgid: The light around your arms returns to normal.
translations: 你手臂周围的光线折射恢复了正常。

messages.msgid: Your illusionary arms are obviously translucent.
translations: 你的幻象手臂明显变得暗淡了。

messages.msgid: Your illusionary arms are losing some of their solid appearance.
translations: 你的幻象手臂失去了一些真实性。

messages.msgid: You are glowing like the sun.

translations: 最后一丝光芒也消失了。

messages.msgid: You used your powers to cauterize a wound here.  Whether it worked or not, it still stings terribly.
translations: 你使用灵能进行了伤口烧灼。无论是否起作用，这都非常疼。

messages.msgid: A flame is burning over one of your palms.
translations: 一团火焰在你掌心燃烧。

messages.msgid: The air around you has its temperature controlled.
translations: 你四周的空气变得更加舒适。

messages.msgid: A thin beam of searing plasma extends from one finger.
translations: 一道灼热纤细的等离子光束从你的一根手指射出。

messages.msgid: The flames surrounding you gutter out.
translations: 你周围的火焰闪烁着熄灭了。

messages.msgid: You are completely immune to fire.
translations: 你完全免疫火焰的影响。

messages.msgid: You are once again vulnerable to fire.
translations: 你再次易与遭受火焰伤害。

messages.msgid: You can walk over liquids without sinking into them.
translations: 你可以在液体表面上行走，而不至于沉入其中。

messages.msgid: Your feet are firm on the ground.
translations: 你的双脚稳稳地立于地面。

messages.msgid: The ground isn't as eager to receive you.
translations: 你感受到了一些地面的斥力。
你突然感觉身体变得沉重了。

messages.msgid: You can hover a single item nearby, at the ready.
translations: 你现在可以将一个物体悬停在你的旁边。

messages.msgid: You are greatly enhancing your ability to lift and break things.
translations: 你极大地增强了你举起和破坏物品的力量。

messages.msgid: The force supporting your muscles suddenly vanishes.
translations: 强化你肌肉的力量突然消失。

messages.msgid: The barrier of force around you falls apart.
translations: 你周围的念力屏障消失了。

messages.msgid: You are floating in defiance of gravity.
translations: 你正在无视重力地漂浮。

messages.msgid: Your feet touch the ground once again.
translations: 你的双脚再次落回地面。

messages.msgid: You are sinking despite your best efforts.
translations: 你的力量支撑不住，开始下降。

messages.msgid: You wobble briefly downward before recovering.
translations: 你在稍微下降后迅速恢复。

messages.msgid: The air loses its structure and you are vulnerable once again.
translations: 空气失去了组成神盾的结构，你再次变得脆弱。

messages.msgid: You are in a focused mental state, increasing the ease of learning.
translations: 你处于专注的精神状态，使学习更容易。

messages.msgid: You shake your head as you become aware of the outside world again.
translations: 你摇摇头，再次讲意识放回周围的世界。

messages.msgid: Your enhanced concentration is fading like a dream.
translations: 你增强的专注开始恍惚，像踏入梦境一般。

messages.msgid: The outside world is impinging itself on your awareness.
translations: 外部世界也逐渐开始回到你的意识。

messages.msgid: You snap out of your trance.
You are editing out your most negative thoughts.  When you think about it, is the Cataclysm really the worst thing that could have happened?
translations: 你正在抹除那些最消极的想法。你仔细思考，大灾变真的是可能发生的最糟糕的事情吗？

messages.msgid: You let your thoughts return to their normal flow.
You're positive that no one is there.
translations: 你很确定，此地空无一人。

messages.msgid: Wait a minute, there *is* someone there!
You are overcome with overwhelming dread.
translations: 你被压倒性的恐惧震慑。

messages.msgid: Your heart races as a sudden feeling of dread grips you.
translations: 你的心跳加速，一种突然的恐惧感包围了你。

messages.msgid: The heart-freezing terror fades as suddenly as it began.
translations: 令人心惊胆战的恐惧突然消失，就像来时一样。

messages.msgid: You are in constant communication with your allies, looking out for each other in combat.
translations: 你与你的盟友不断沟通，在战斗中互相照顾。
你脑中一刻不停的交流突然沉寂。

messages.msgid: The inner voices of your allies are only a whisper now.
translations: 脑海中同伴的声音变成了耳语。

messages.msgid: The inner voices of your allies begin to fade.
translations: 脑海中的同伴交流声减弱。

messages.msgid: You exist slightly outside of baseline reality, allowing you to effortlessly walk through solid matter.
translations: 你的存在略微脱离了基准现实，这让你能够毫不费力地穿行于实体物质之间。

messages.msgid: The surrounding matter feels real again.
translations: 周围的物质再次有了实感。

messages.msgid: You are concentrating on your locus.  You can teleport there at will with the [Ψ]Loci Technique.
translations: 你正专注于你的道标。你可以随时使用[Ψ]锚点回归传送至此。

messages.msgid: Your steps aren't taking you as far as your eyes tell you they should.
translations: 你的每一步走得并没有像眼睛预计的那般远。

messages.msgid: The air ripples and you stumble.
translations: 周围空间撕裂，你走得跌跌撞撞。

messages.msgid: Your eyes and your legs agree with each other again.
translations: 你的观察与步伐再次协调。

messages.msgid: Every step takes you further than your eyes tell you it should.
translations: 你的每一步都走得比眼睛预计得更远。

messages.msgid: Your steps are normal once again.
translations: 你的步伐回到了正常水平。

messages.msgid: Your melee attacks extend much further than would normally be possible.
translations: 你的近战攻击距离远超常人。

messages.msgid: Your reach goes back to normal.
translations: 你的攻击距离恢复了正常。

messages.msgid: Through constant teleports and warping of space, your combat prowess is increased.
translations: 通过不断的传送和空间扭曲，你的战斗技巧得到了提升。

messages.msgid: Your constant teleporting slows to a stop.
translations: 你连续的传送逐渐平息。

messages.msgid: For just a moment, you feel your blood rushing through your veins.
translations: 一瞬间，你开始感觉到血液重新在血管中奔流。

messages.msgid: You bleed much less than normal and sometimes not at all.
translations: 你的出血量比正常情况少得多，有时甚至根本不出血。

messages.msgid: The surge of vitality leaves you in a rush.
translations: 生命力的冲刷一齐消退了。

messages.msgid: Your %s is receiving the bulk of your body's healing resources.
translations: 你的%s正集中了你身体大部分的自愈资源。

messages.msgid: You are not going to get sick.  You absolutely refuse.  And if you do, you're going to get better.
translations: 你的免疫受到强化，不会生病。就算生病也会很快会康复。

messages.msgid: Thanks to your meditations you are healing much more quickly
translations: 因为你的冥想，你身体恢复得更快了。

messages.msgid: This reduces monsters' regeneration.  It's a bug if you have it.
translations: 这将削弱怪物的再生能力。拥有这个效果的话是bug。

messages.msgid: You are using your powers to cleanse yourself of radiation.
translations: 你正在用你的灵能清除自己的辐射。

messages.msgid: You are using your powers to cleanse yourself of radiation, but there are some side effects.
translations: 你正在用你的灵能清除自己的辐射，但会有一些副作用。

messages.msgid: Your body aches as your preternatural healing slows to a stop.
translations: 你的身体疼痛，同时你超自然的愈合能力逐渐停止。

messages.msgid: You flesh is withering and decaying!
translations: 你的血肉正在枯萎腐烂！

messages.msgid: The energy of your accelerated resuscitation is preventing you from feeling the pain you obviously should be, for the moment.
translations: 你加速复苏时产生的能量暂时屏蔽了你本应感受到的剧痛。

messages.msgid: If you suffer potentially-fatal damage, your powers will attempt to save you.
translations: 如果你受到可能至死的伤害，这个灵能会试图为你续命。

messages.msgid: The flames in your heart have kindled, fueling a connection to the Nether.  Your Nether Attunement will not reduce with time.
translations: 你心中的火焰已被点燃，为通往虚空的连接注入了燃料。你的虚空同调等级将不再随时间消退。

messages.msgid: The flames in your heart smolder, maintaining your connection to the Nether.  Your Nether Attunement will reduce with time, but more slowly.
translations: 你心中的火焰仍在闷燃，维系着你与虚空的连接。你的虚空同调等级仍会随时间消退，但速度会更慢。

messages.msgid: The power twists inside you.  Let it out.  Let the flames rise.
translations: 那股力量在你体内翻腾。释放它，让烈焰升腾吧。

messages.msgid: You feel far, far too warm.

translations: 你感觉自己快要烧起来了！

messages.msgid: You sense a hostile target here.
translations: 你在此处感知到了一个敌对目标。

messages.msgid: Your gear relays targeting data to your weapons, reducing dispersion by 25%.
translations: 你的装备将瞄准数据传输给武器，减少了25%的弹道散布。

messages.msgid: An lamp enhanced with matrix technology.
translations: 采用矩阵晶体技术增强的灯。

messages.msgid: A strange device, a bit like one of those eyesight testing machines you look into in an optometrist's office.  The main housing has a place to rest your chin and a pair of binocular-like tubes, but there is also a headband attached to a set of wires hanging from a hook on the side and an armband hanging from the other side.  It's supposed to be used for measuring your "noetic potential".
translations: 一个奇怪的装置，形似验光师办公室里的视力测试仪。主壳体上有一个下巴托和一对双筒镜般的镜筒，一侧挂钩上悬着一条连有数根线缆的头带，另一侧则挂着一条臂带。据说这东西是用来测量你的“心智潜能”的。
采用矩阵晶体技术的充能弹药。
采用超自然灵能技术的充能弹药。

messages.msgid: A light battery but with the casing devoid of branding or symbols other than a plus and minus on opposite ends.  It's surprisingly heavy.
translations: 一个轻型电池，外壳上没有任何品牌或标志，只在两端分别标有加号和减号。它出人意料地沉重。

messages.msgid: A medium battery but with the casing devoid of branding or symbols other than a plus and minus on opposite ends.  It's surprisingly heavy.
translations: 一个中型电池，外壳上没有任何品牌或标志，只在两端分别标有加号和减号。它出人意料地沉重。

messages.msgid: A battery cell, compatible with all kinds of industrial-grade equipment and portable tools, but with the casing devoid of branding or symbols other than a plus and minus on opposite ends.  It's surprisingly heavy.
translations: 一个蓄电池单元，兼容各类工业级设备和便携式工具，但外壳上没有任何品牌或标志，只在两端分别标有加号和减号。它出人意料地沉重。

messages.msgid: You can tell this CBM is meant to be installed around your eyes, but what exactly it will do, you have no idea.
translations: 你能看出这是个要安装在眼部周围的CBM，但它具体有什么作用，你却一无所知。

messages.msgid: A set of Ohuicatlachiyaliztimeh, this CBM uses matrix technology to detect hostility from nearby targets, acting as an infallible IFF.
translations: 一套凶视预警器，这款CBM使用矩阵技术来探测附近目标的敌意，充当着万无一失的敌我识别系统。

messages.msgid: An extremely-efficent form of bionic power storage, using integral matrix dust to increase the efficiency of possible storage multiple times.
translations: 一种效率极高的生化动力存储形式，利用内置的矩阵尘埃将存储效率提高数倍。

messages.msgid: A connection between the user's metabolism and their power storage allows this CBM to convert burned calories into bionic energy.
translations: 此CBM连接着使用者的的新陈代谢和动力存储系统，能将消耗的卡路里转化为生化电能。

messages.msgid: A series of implants along the skeleton and in major muscle groups allow a dramatic increase in the user's strength and agility.
translations: 一系列植入物沿着骨骼和主要肌群分布，能大幅提升使用者的力量与敏捷。

messages.msgid: Implants under the skin throughout the body that bend light when activated, making it much harder to spot the user from a distance.
translations: 遍布全身的皮下植入物，激活后能扭曲光线，使使用者在远处更难被发现。

messages.msgid: A description of simple meditation and breathing techniques, intended for a beginner.
translations: 针对初学者的简单冥想和呼吸技巧的描述。

messages.plural: copies of Zen Mind, Beginner's Mind

messages.msgid: This is a transcription of lectures given by Suzuki Shunryū, a Buddhist monk who founded the first Zen Buddhist monastery in the United States, containing discussion about Zen meditation and practice.
translations: 这是铃木俊隆讲课的抄本，铃木俊隆是一位佛教僧侣，他在美国创立了第一座禅宗寺院，其中包含关于禅宗冥想和修行的讨论。

messages.msgid: How to Meditate: A Practical Guide to Making Friends with Your Mind
translations: 如何冥想：用心灵交朋友的实用指南
messages.plural: copies of How to Meditate: A Practical Guide to Making Friends with Your Mind

messages.msgid: A book on meditation written for a general audience, containing simple techniques on breathing and mindfulness.
translations: 一本为普通读者写的关于冥想的书，包含有关呼吸和正念的简单技巧。

messages.msgid: The Wandering Mind: What Medieval Monks Tell Us about Distraction
translations: 流浪的心灵：中世纪僧侣告诉我们的分心
messages.plural: copies of The Wandering Mind: What Medieval Monks Tell Us about Distraction

messages.msgid: A history of monastic attempts at finding calm and peace in the midst of a profane world.  There are far fewer daily distractions now than pre-Cataclysm but there's still some useful techniques you could gain here.
translations: 一部僧侣试图在亵渎的世界中寻找平静与和平的历史。与大灾变前相比，现在的日常干扰要少得多，但仍然有一些有用的技巧可以在这里学到。

messages.msgid: The Miracle of Mindfulness: An Introduction to the Practice of Meditation
translations: 正念的奇迹：冥想练习入门
messages.plural: copies of The Miracle of Mindfulness: An Introduction to the Practice of Meditation

messages.msgid: A translation of a letter written by Thich Nhat Hanh to colleagues in Viet Nam, this book focuses on mindfulness and breathwork.
translations: 这本书是一行禅师写给越南同事的一封信的翻译，这本书专注于正念和呼吸。

messages.plural: copies of Secrets of the Zen Masters

messages.msgid: This book purports to contain hidden tips that will make you serene and calm in the face of the most grievous calamities.  Cataclysms, one might say.
translations: 这本书声称包含许多密不外传的技巧，可以让你在面对最严重的灾难时保持平静。有人可能会说，那就是大灾变。

messages.msgid: The Mind Illuminated: A Complete Meditation Guide Integrating Buddhist Wisdom and Brain Science for Greater Mindfulness
translations: 点亮心灵：完整冥想指南
messages.plural: copies of The Mind Illuminated: A Complete Meditation Guide Integrating Buddhist Wisdom and Brain Science for Greater Mindfulness

messages.msgid: Written by a neuroscientist and meditator practitioner, this book offers a ten-step meditation program that combines science with traditional meditation techniques.
translations: 这本书由一位神经学家和冥想练习者撰写，提供了一个将科学与传统冥想技术相结合的十步冥想计划。

messages.msgid: Mastering the Core Teachings of the Buddha: An Unusually Hardcore Dharma Book
translations: 掌握佛学奥义：一本不同寻常的硬核佛法书
messages.plural: copies of Mastering the Core Teachings of the Buddha: An Unusually Hardcore Dharma Book

messages.msgid: This book argues that meditation is not an eternal progression but can be mastered just like any other skill, and it will tell you how to do it.
translations: 这本书认为冥想不是一个永恒的过程，但可以像任何其他技能一样掌握，它会告诉你如何做到这一点。

messages.msgid: Not Always So: Practicing the True Spirit of Zen
translations: 并非总是如此：实践禅宗的真正精神
messages.plural: copies of Not Always So: Practicing the True Spirit of Zen

messages.msgid: A continuation of the lessons expounded on in "Zen Mind, Beginner's Mind", this book contains a myriad of parables and koans to help the student grasp the nature of meditation.
translations: 这本书是《禅心，初心》一书中阐述的课程的继续，本书包含了无数的寓言和常识，帮助学生掌握冥想的本质。

messages.msgid: This notebook is mostly a series of fanciful speculations about something the author alternately calls "Matrix Mechanics,", "Dimensional Metaphysics," or "Netherium Mathematics," sometimes using more than one in the same sentence.  Most of it is incoherent, but there is some experimental data about "Conscious redirection of nether energy" that catches your eye.
translations: 这本笔记主要是一系列异想天开的推测，作者交替称其为“矩阵力学”、“维度形而上学”或“虚质数学”，有时甚至在同一句话里混用。其中大部分内容都语无伦次，但一些关于“有意识地引导虚质能量”的实验数据引起了你的注意。
实验报告（引导流程 PGS38）
messages.plural: copies of Report: Channeling Protocol PGS38

messages.msgid: A formal report on a process to reduce the unpredictable effects of long-term psionic use.  It describes a special meditation technique, performed with the aid of a matrix crystal, though it does warn that the process: "puts extreme stress on the focus object.  Further refinement is required."
translations: 一份正式的报告，关于如何降低长期使用灵能所导致的不可预测影响。其中详细描述了一种特殊的冥想技巧，需要在矩阵晶体的帮助下进行，不过其中实实在在地警告说本过程：“对聚焦对象施加极大的压力。需要进一步完善。”

messages.msgid: Training Manual: Method of Loci and Dimensional Metaphysics
translations: 训练手册：轨迹记忆法和维度玄学
messages.plural: copies of Training Manual: Method of Loci and Dimensional Metaphysics

messages.msgid: A formal report on a series of training procedures to allow the practitioner to hold images and ideas in their head for long periods of time without being distracted or losing their train of thought.  The report concludes, "While the human mind is not adept at holding static images or scenes in place, some minor variation can be allowed for without suffering any adverse effects from the flow of Netherum energy.  Method of Loci allows the mathematician to maintain their thoughts within this area of variation while still exerting effective control over the mathematics."
translations: 一系列正式报告，通过特定训练程序使练习者能够在头脑中长时间记忆图像和想法，而不会分心或中断思维链路。报告中的结论处写道：“虽然人类思维不擅长长时间记忆静态图像或场景，但可以允许略微细小的变化，而不会受到异界能量流动所产生的不利影响。轨迹记忆法可以使灵能者们将自身的思维链路维持在这个变化范围内，同时仍然有效掌控数学。”

messages.msgid: Training Manual: VERDANT HAND Combat Protocols
translations: 训练手册：苍翠之手战斗规程
messages.plural: copies of Training Manual: VERDANT HAND Combat Protocols

messages.msgid: A formal report with a mostly-blank cover page, stamped with the Project PHAVIAN logo at the top and a red "VERDANT HAND - EYES ONLY" centered underneath.  Contrary to your initial assumption, it is not a martial arts training manual.  Instead, it describes a series of meditations and visualization exercises designed to "increase the subject's unarmed combat prowess fivefold".  There are several charts showing the results of a VERDANT HAND combatant against training opponents armed with weapons or firearms at various engagement distances.  It's clearly still not as good as just having a rifle, but the data look pretty promising if you can get these exercises down.
translations: 一份正式的报告，封面大部分是空白的，盖着 PHAVIAN 项目的图章，纸张正中印着红色的“苍翠之手：最高机密”。与你最初的假设相反，这不是一本武术训练手册。相反，它描述了一系列冥想和可视化练习，旨在“将徒手作战能力提高五倍”。有几张图表显示了使用苍翠之手的作战人员在不同交战距离上对抗训练携带武器或枪械的对手的结果。显然，它仍然不如使用步枪那么好，但是如果你能完成这些训练，那么数据看起来还有点希望。

messages.msgid: A formal report with a mostly-blank cover page, stamped with the Project PHAVIAN logo at the top and a red "TURQUOISE KEYSTONE - EYES ONLY" centered underneath.  Skimming through it, you see a lot of very worrying phrases in light of recent events, like "…the sudden but so-far unexplained increase in our mathematicians' prowess…" or "…E71 is now capable of passing through two meters of solid matter."  The main topic of the document seems to be using teleportation ("LOST RAIN", as the report calls it) in combat.  By lengthening the space between the teleporter and their target to build up momentum on their strikes, warping space to make near-misses turn into hits, or teleporting fractions of a meter to avoid incoming attacks or put themselves in a better position to make strikes, the TURQUOISE KEYSTONE practitioner can vastly increase their prowess in close-quarters combat.  Written at the bottom of the last page is, "We had better test this soon--I think we're going to need it."
translations: 这是一份正式报告，封面大半空白。顶端盖有“PHAVIAN计划”的标志，下方居中是红色的“TURQUOISE KEYSTONE——仅供亲阅”字样。粗略翻阅之下，你会发现结合最近发生的事件来看，文中的许多短语都令人相当不安，例如“……我方灵能者的力量突然出现了原因不明的增长……”，又或是“……E71现在能够穿透两米厚的实体物质。”这份文件的主题似乎是在战斗中运用传送能力（报告中称之为“迷失之雨”）。通过拉长传送者与目标间的空间为攻击积蓄动能、扭曲空间将失之交臂的攻击转为命中、或进行微距传送以躲避来袭或占据更有利的攻击位置，“TURQUOISE KEYSTONE”的修炼者可以极大地提升自己的近战实力。最后一页的底部写着：“我们最好尽快测试一下——我想我们很快就会需要它了。”
《实验报告：马赛克病人流程》的副本
messages.plural: copies of Lab Report: PATIENT MOSAIC process

messages.msgid: A thick lab report with a mostly-blank cover page, stamped with the Project PHAVIAN logo at the top and a red "PATIENT MOSAIC - EYES ONLY" centered underneath.  According to the summary, the report details how a powerful GRAY DAWN participant may use a specifically attuned focusing tool to allow themselves to induce permanent changes in their personality and other segments of their brain.  The report details little success in GRAY DAWN participant applying this process to others.
translations: 一份厚厚的实验报告，封面大部分为空白，顶部印有PHAVIAN计划的标志，下方中央是红色的“马赛克病人 - 绝密”字样。根据摘要，该报告详述了一名强大的“灰晓”参与者可以如何利用一种经过特殊调谐的聚焦工具，对自己的人格及其他大脑区段进行永久性改造。报告中提到，“灰晓”参与者将此流程应用于他人时收效甚微。

messages.msgid: A thick liquid, mixed with ground matrix crystal and ready to be catalyzed.  In total darkness, it glows very faintly.
translations: 一种粘稠的液体，与磨碎的基质晶体混合，准备被催化。在一片漆黑中，它发出微弱的光芒。

messages.msgid: Refined matrix crystal mixed directly into water.  The liquid has a faint pink glow.
translations: 一份精制过的矩阵晶体水溶液。液体散发出微弱的粉红色光芒。

translations: 精炼矩阵晶体直接溶于水中而成，液体散发着淡淡的天蓝色辉光。

messages.msgid: Refined matrix crystal mixed directly into water.  The liquid has a faint golden glow.
translations: 精炼矩阵晶体直接溶于水中而成，液体散发着淡淡的金色辉光。

translations: 一份精制过的矩阵晶体水溶液。液体散发出微弱的绿色光芒。

messages.msgid: A bluish-green ovoid globule, firm to the touch but looking more like gelatin than something you plucked from a tree.  It has a strong acrid odor.
translations: 一种蓝绿色的卵形球体，摸起来很坚硬，但看起来更像是明胶，而不是从树上摘下来的东西。它散发出一股强烈的辛辣气味。

messages.msgid: You don't know what this is but now that you've gotten a closer look it's definitely not water.  It's completely opaque and freezing cold to the touch, but when you pull your fingertip out of it, your skin is dry as a bone.
translations: 你不知道这是什么，但凑近一看，这绝不是水。它完全不透明，触手冰凉刺骨，但当你将指尖从中抽出时，皮肤却干爽如初。

messages.msgid: A handful of white berries plucked from an otherworldly bush.  You're not sure if eating them is a good idea, but they sure look tasty.
translations: 一把从异界灌木上采摘的白色浆果。你不确定吃了它是不是个好主意，但它们看起来确实很诱人。

messages.msgid: A large fruit pulled from an alien tree.  The rind is extremely hard and you'll need to cut into it to eat it.
translations: 一种从外星树上摘下来的大果子。 果皮非常硬，需要切开才能吃。

messages.msgid: Some paper with what looks to be private communication on it.  The writer would be very annoyed at you for reading this if they weren't almost-certainly shambling around looking for brains.
translations: 几张写着像是私密记录的纸。作者肯定会对你读到这些文字感到十分恼火，若不是它早已蹒跚地四处寻找大脑的话。

messages.msgid: A folder full of what appear to be transcripts of experimental results or reports, with the heading "BURNT NOVEMBER".  Most of it is rather trivial, but certain passages catch your eye…
translations: 一个满是实验结果或是记录报告的文件夹，标题为“燃情雾月”。大部分内容都很琐碎，但某些段落还是能吸引你的眼球……

translations: 一个满是实验结果或是记录报告的文件夹，标题为“高尚视野”。大部分内容都很琐碎，但某些段落还是能吸引你的眼球……

translations: 一个文件夹，里面装满了似乎是实验结果或报告的抄本，标题为“红宝石环路”。大部分内容都相当琐碎，但其中某些段落引起了你的注意……

messages.msgid: A piece of half-crumpled paper with writing on it.  You'd need to take a closer look to figure out what it says.
translations: 一张半皱的纸条，上面写着些文字。你需要仔细查看一下才能弄清楚上面写着什么。

translations: 一个满是实验结果或是记录报告的文件夹。大部分内容都很琐碎，但某些段落还是能吸引你的眼球……

messages.msgid: A note written on official XEDRA letterhead.
translations: 一份写在XEDRA 官方信笺上的备忘录。

messages.msgid: A folder full of what appear to be transcripts of experimental results or reports, with a large "Project OBSIDIAN RING" on the front.  Most of it is rather trivial, but certain passages catch your eye…
translations: 一个满是实验结果或是记录报告的文件夹，标题为“黑曜石环”。大部分内容都很琐碎，但某些段落还是能吸引你的眼球……

messages.msgid: A visitor's pass to some sort of facility.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant one-time access at a card reader, if you can find one.  It also lists the addresses of nearby facilities; activate it to add their locations to your map.  There is a prominent symbol stamped on it with the word "PHAVIAN" underneath.
translations: 某种设施的访客通行证。背面描述了使用它的协议；如果你能找到读卡器，这可以授予一次访问权限。它还列出了附近设施的地址；使用它以将设施位置添加到地图中。这张通行证上面印着一个显眼的符号，下面有"PHAVIAN"一词。

messages.msgid: A strange-looking, surprisingly-heavy crystal with a faintly-glowing pink light in its depths.  Holding it, you feel more capable.
translations: 一个外形奇特，重得出奇的晶体，深处透出一股微弱的粉红色光芒。拿着它会让你觉得自己更强壮了。

messages.msgid: The pink glow calls to you.
translations: 粉红色的光芒在呼唤你。

messages.msgid: A bit of crystalline dust with a faint pink shimmer.
translations: 一小撮散发着淡淡的粉红色微光的结晶尘埃。

messages.msgid: Concentrated matrix crystal dust.  It glitters pink even in complete darkness.
translations: 一小撮浓缩矩阵晶体粉尘。即使在完全的黑暗中，它也能散发出粉红色光芒。

messages.msgid: A strange-looking, surprisingly-heavy crystal with a faintly-glowing gray light in its depths.  Holding it, you feel more perceptive.
translations: 一个外形奇特，重得出奇的晶体，深处透出一股微弱的灰色光芒。拿着它会让你觉得自己更敏锐了。

A bit of crystalline dust with a faint gray shimmer.
translations: 一小撮散发着淡淡的灰色微光的结晶尘埃。

messages.msgid: The golden glow calls to you.
translations: 金黄色的光芒在呼唤你。

A bit of crystalline dust with a faint yellow shimmer.

translations: 一个外形奇特，重得出奇的晶体，深处透出一股微弱的蓝色光芒。拿着它会让你觉得自己更飘忽了。

A bit of crystalline dust with a faint blue shimmer.

messages.msgid: A strange-looking, surprisingly-heavy crystal with a faintly-glowing green light in its depths.  Holding it, you feel healthier.
translations: 一个外形奇特，重得出奇的晶体，深处透出一股微弱的绿色光芒。拿着它会让你觉得自己更健康了。

messages.msgid: The green glow calls to you.
A bit of crystalline dust with a faint green shimmer.
translations: 一小撮散发着淡淡的绿色微光的结晶尘埃。

messages.msgid: Concentrated matrix crystal dust.  It glitters green even in complete darkness.
translations: 一小撮浓缩矩阵晶体粉尘。即使在完全的黑暗中，它也能散发出绿色光芒。

messages.msgid: A strange-looking, surprisingly-heavy crystal.  In total darkness, there is a faint light visible in its depths.
translations: 一个外形奇特，重得出奇的晶体。在完全的黑暗中，深处透出一股微弱的光芒。

messages.msgid: The faint light calls to you.
A bit of crystalline dust that seems to absorb light.
translations: 一小撮似乎能够吸收光线的结晶尘埃。

messages.msgid: Concentrated matrix crystal dust.  It seems to completely absorb any light that falls on it.
translations: 一小撮浓缩矩阵晶体粉尘。它似乎完全吸收了落在其上的光线。

messages.msgid: A strange-looking, surprisingly-heavy crystal.  In total darkness, multicolored lights churn and swirl within its depths.
translations: 一个外形奇特，重得出奇的晶体。在完全的黑暗中，深处透出不断翻腾旋转的五彩光芒。

messages.msgid: The coruscating light calls to you.
A very heavy chunk of a strange crystalline outcropping.  You could use it as a weapon, but you might want to wear gloves.
translations: 一块外形奇特，重得出奇的晶体碎片。可以拿来戳人，不过还是先戴上手套比较好。

messages.msgid: An extremely thick-looking liquid that will "enhance your resilience against detrimental mutagenic alterations caused by XE037 overexposure" if injected.
translations: 一种看起来极其粘稠的液体，注射后可“增强你对因过度暴露于XE037而产生的有害突变的抵抗力”。

messages.msgid: You inject the morphic reinforcement serum.
translations: 你注射了形态强化血清。

messages.msgid: A faintly-glowing green liquid, the document you found told you that this would "restore your morphology to baseline", whatever that means.
translations: 一种微弱发光的绿色液体，你所找到的文件中说这玩意能够“将你的形态恢复到基线”，不管那是什么意思。

messages.msgid: A clear liquid, designed to alleviate some of the unpredictable effects of excessive psionic channeling.
translations: 一种透明液体，旨在减轻过度引导灵能所带来的某些不可预测的影响。

messages.msgid: A strange device, a bit like one of those eyesight testing machines you look into in an optometrist's office.  The main housing has a place to rest your chin and a pair of binocular-like tubes, but there is also a headband attached to a set of wires hanging from a hook on the side and an armband hanging from the other side.
translations: 一个奇怪的装置，形似验光师办公室里的视力测试仪。主壳体上有一个下巴托和一对双筒镜般的镜筒，一侧挂钩上悬着一条连有数根线缆的头带，另一侧则挂着一条臂带。

messages.msgid: A deck of Zener cards, used pre-Cataclysm to test for psychic ability.
translations: 一副齐纳卡片，在大灾变前被用作测试灵能的工具。

messages.msgid: A small plastic device about the size of two smartphones stacked on top of each other, with a toggle on one end and "OS647-P" written prominently on one side above the XEDRA logo.  There is an indentation on the other side the right size to contain a matrix crystal.
translations: 一个大约两部智能手机大小的小型塑料设备，堆叠在一起，一端有一个开关，XEDRA标志上方的一侧醒目地写着“OS647-P”。另一侧有一个适当大小的压痕，可以容纳矩阵晶体。

messages.msgid: Insert a black matrix crystal and flip the toggle.
translations: 插入黑色矩阵晶体并翻转开关。

messages.msgid: A small plastic device about the size of two smartphones stacked on top of each other, with a toggle on one end and "OS647-P" written prominently on one side above the XEDRA logo.  Parts of the device seem melted and the toggle no longer moves.
translations: 这是一款小型塑料设备，大小相当于两台智能手机堆叠在一起，一端有一个开关，在XEDRA标识上方醒目地写着“OS647-P”。设备的部分部件似乎融化了，手柄也不再转动。

messages.msgid: Your body, lying on the ground while your spirit walks free.  Hopefully nothing happens to it while you're gone.
translations: 你的身体，躺在地上，而你的灵魂自由行走。希望你离开的这段时间里没发生什么事。

messages.msgid: A handful of dry leaves(?) from an alien plant.  Despite their otherworldly origin, they have very few uses and are thus (almost) only good for burning.
translations: 一把外星植物的干叶子（？ 尽管它们来自异世界，但用途却很少，因此（几乎）只能用来燃烧。

messages.msgid: You are breathing through your skin.
You can perform many common handy tasks with your bare hands.
translations: 你可以赤手空拳完成许多常见的简单制造任务。

messages.msgid: You can see ambient radiation as a faint, sinister glow.
translations: 你可以看到周围的辐射是一种微弱的、邪恶的光芒。

messages.msgid: A thin silver cord, stretching off into the distance, connecting you to your body.  You could follow it back to return.
translations: 一根银色细绳，延伸到远处，将你与身体连接起来。你可以跟着它回去。
远程控制机器人的接口。

messages.msgid: Your powers allow you to communicate by radio waves.  With a moment's concentration, you may instead scan for radio signals.
translations: 你的灵能使你能够通过无线电波进行通信。稍加专注，你就可以改变频率或切换到侦听模式。

messages.msgid: Your powers allow you to listen for radio signals from the surrounding area.  With a moment's concentration, you may change frequency or switch to communicating by radio.
translations: 你的灵能使你能够收听周围地区的无线电信号。稍加专注，你就可以改变频率或切换到通信模式。

messages.msgid: With a little concentration, you can control the light your eyes accept.  Protects you from glare and welding arcs.
translations: 只要稍稍集中专注，你就可以控制眼睛接受的光线。保护你的眼睛免受闪光和焊接时的强光伤害。

messages.msgid: Dancing flames hovering over your hand.  You can use this to provide heat and light when necessary.
translations: 舞动的火焰在你的手上盘旋。你可以在必要的时候用它来提供热量和光线。

messages.msgid: A thin, searing beam, almost too bright to look at.  You can use this to weld or cut through things.
translations: 一束细细的灼热的光束，几乎亮得无法直视。你可以用它来焊接或切割东西。

messages.msgid: You can lift one thing with your powers, removing its effect on your encumbrance.
translations: 你可以用你的灵能悬浮一件东西，消除它对你的负担的影响。

messages.msgid: Using your powers, you can lift up a vehicle just enough to allow you to change the wheels.
translations: 使用你的灵能，你可以举起一辆车，刚好可以让你更换车轮。
疗愈者的灵能，用以止血。
疗愈者的灵能，用以消毒防止感染。

messages.msgid: This is a series of technical design documents for a "matrix channeling array" designed to "allow an attuned mathematician to direct a stronger level of Netherum energy".  It sounds like nonsense, but the document does have the XEDRA seal stamped on it.
translations: 一系列技术设计文档，描述了一种“矩阵引导阵列”，设计用来“让已同调的灵能者引导更强的异界能量”。听起来狗屁不通，但文件上确实盖着XEDRA的印章。

messages.msgid: This is a series of technical design documents for a focusing assembly designed to "enhance the precision of Netherum mathematics".
translations: 一系列技术设计文档，描述了某种聚焦设备，用以“增强异界数学的精准度”。

messages.msgid: A series of technical documents for further refining ground matrix crystal, separating out the inert parts from the "Netherically active" parts.
translations: 一系列的技术文件，以进一步精制矩阵晶体，将惰性部分从具有“异界活性”的部分分离出来。

messages.msgid: This is a series of technical design documents for using matrix crystals to shield the wearer from excess Netherum energies with the drawback of also shutting down any psionic ability they have while worn.
translations: 一系列技术设计文档，描述了如何使用矩阵晶体来保护佩戴者免受过量异界能量的影响，然而同时提到缺点是也会阻碍佩戴者使用灵能能力。

messages.msgid: This is a series of technical design documents for using matrix crystals to shield the wearer's mind from telepathic assault and from unfriendly attention from Netherum entities.  The design also mentions that it reduces the wearer's own psionic power, however.
translations: 一系列技术设计文档，描述了如何使用矩阵晶体来保护佩戴者的思想免受心灵感应攻击，以及来自异界生物的敌意关注。然而同时提到缺点是会降低佩戴者自身的灵能能力。

messages.msgid: This is a design document to create a grenade using matrix crystal dust that explodes in a sea of pure flame.  In pen below is the note "EXTREMELY DANGEROUS".  You're not sure you could replicate the exact process with the tools available to you, but you could definitely come up with your own version.
translations: 这是一份使用矩阵晶体粉末制造手雷的设计文档，该手雷会在一片纯净的火焰中爆炸。下面用钢笔写着“极度危险”的字样。你不确定自己能否用手头现有的工具精确复制这个过程，但你肯定能想出自己的版本。

messages.msgid: This is a series of design documents for building a transporter beacon and connected transporter remote, which you can use to teleport yourself through the Nether to the beacon.  It's labeled "for immersion use only", but that part has a line through it and "IT WORKS!" written next to it in pen.  There's another note in red that states that on very rare occasions, "entities" can also use the beacon to exit the Nether, and also that as of two weeks before the Cataclysm, the designers have not solved the energy surge problems that make each remote burn out after use.
translations: 一系列技术设计文档，描述了如何制造传送器信标并将其与远端传送器相连，你可以使用异界传送到这些信标所在地。上面写着“仅供沉浸使用”，但那句话被划掉了，旁边用圆珠笔写着“这能行！”。还有另一条用红字标明的备注指出，在极少数情况下，“其他生物”也可以使用信标进出异界，而且截至大灾变前两周，设计者还没有解决能量激增的问题，这使得每个信标在使用一次远程传送后就会被烧毁。

messages.msgid: This is a series of design documents to use ground matrix crystals to greatly enhance the power efficiency of a lamp.
translations: 这是一系列的设计文件，使用矩阵晶体以大大提高灯的功率。
精神反应催化剂说明书

messages.msgid: A chemical formula for mixing ground matrix crystals with other metals and dissolving them in liquid.  There's a long list of possible applications for the resulting compound, almost all of which would have seemed like pure fantasy if you hadn't lived through the end of the world.
translations: 一种将磨碎的矩阵晶体与其他金属混合并将其溶解在液体中的化学配方。得到的化合物有一长串可能的应用，如果不是在大灾变，几乎所有的应用都会看起来像是天方夜谭。

messages.msgid: This document details a series of steps for making an injectable serum which will "enhance the subject's resilience against detrimental mutagenic alterations caused by XE037 overexposure, reducing negative outcomes during testing".  It's stamped with a XEDRA symbol in the corner with "Project PHAVIAN" written at the top.
translations: 这份文件详细说明了制作一种注射血清的步骤，该血清能“增强实验体对XE037过度暴露所致有害突变性状的抵抗力，减少测试中的负面结果”。文件一角盖着XEDRA的印章，顶部写着“PHAVIAN计划”字样。

messages.msgid: A series of steps to create a serum that will "Eliminate the undesirable effects of XE037 overexposure".  It is designed to be injected in the recipient.
translations: 指导如何制造“消除XE037过度暴露的不良效果”的血清，必须注射。

messages.msgid: This document details the chemical process necessary to create what it calls Compound XV471, which it claims is a pharmaceutical treatment for a wide variety of ills.  According to this, it acts as a near-universal antivenin, an antifungal, an antiparasitic, an antibiotic, cures several common diseases such as influenza or the common cold, improves the immune system generally, and even increases strength, agility, and overall bodily function.  You would think it was too good to be true if you hadn't seen so many other bizarre things since the Cataclysm.
translations: 这份文件详述了一种名为XV471化合物的化学制备流程，并声称它是一种能治疗多种疾病的药物。根据文件所述，它几乎是一种万能抗毒素、抗真菌剂、抗寄生虫剂和抗生素，能治愈流感或普通感冒等常见疾病，还能全面改善免疫系统，甚至增强力量、敏捷度和整体身体机能。要不是自大灾变以来你已见识了太多离奇之事，你恐怕会觉得这好得有些不真实。

messages.msgid: A technical document outlining a treatment for "noetic overuse".  After the outline of the treatment is a note, dated two weeks before the end of the world, that while it showed great promise in initial trials the side effects require further study before it can be recommended for widespread usage.
translations: 这份文档详细描述了如何治疗“灵能过劳”的症状。在文档背后贴着一张大灾变前两周的笔记，指出虽然先期试验表明疗程潜力巨大，但副作用仍未明确。

messages.msgid: A USB thumb drive with the XEDRA logo over a large Ψ symbol printed on it.  You'd bet there's something important on here.
translations: 一个USB拇指驱动器，上面印有XEDRA标志和一个大的Ψ符号。你可以打赌这里有一些重要的东西。

messages.msgid: Use a laptop to access the data.
translations: 使用笔记本电脑访问数据。
灵智共鸣探测器操作说明

messages.msgid: An extensive series of instructions on the proper calibrations and parameters for using the "noetic resonance detector" to determine a target's noetic potential.  There is no way you could have ever figured this out without these directions to follow.
translations: 这是一系列详尽的说明，指导你如何正确校准并设置参数，以使用“灵智共鸣探测器”来确定目标的灵智潜能。若无这些指示可循，你绝无可能自行摸索出用法。

messages.msgid: A series of notes, musings, and marginalia about grinding up matrix crystals, refining the dust and then…mixing it with water and drinking the results?  Hopefully it won't make you go blind.
translations: 一系列的笔记、思考和旁注，内容是关于将矩阵晶体磨成粉、提纯粉末，然后……兑水喝掉？但愿这东西不会让你瞎掉。

messages.msgid: The standard-issue officer's sidearm for the Imperial Navy, guaranteed manufactured on Tlalticpactli itself by scions of the Huey Calpulli, the Ch47 replaced the earlier Ch41 and is widely renowned for its accuracy and ease of maintenance.  This particular Ch47 even bears an eagle and snake on the grip, indicating it was produced in a factory in Anáhuac.  Hopefully it'll make a good melee weapon as well.
translations: Ch47 是帝国海军的制式军官佩枪，由休伊·卡尔普利的子嗣在“特拉尔蒂克帕克特里”自行制造，它取代了早期的 Ch41，并因其准确性和易于维护而广为人知。 这款特殊的 Ch47 甚至在握把上刻有一只鹰和一条蛇，表明它是在“阿纳瓦克”的一家工厂生产的。希望它也能成为一把优秀的近战武器。

messages.msgid: A power pack for the Ch47.
translations: CH47聚变手枪所使用的能量来源。

messages.msgid: Power cartridges for the Ch47.  You had better make every shot count, because there's no way you're finding any more of these.
translations: Ch47的能量弹药。你最好让每一枪都有价值，因为你不可能再找到这样的子弹了。

messages.msgid: The M12 was designed as a less-than-lethal alternative to more dangerous forms of crowd pacification, able to disable a target for up to a minute with a single shot and few to no permanent effects.  While it cannot be said to be nonlethal because it is not safe to use on targets with heart conditions or epilepsy, it is a great improvement over the previous X04 "Tecuacuilli" which, on unfortunately not-rare-enough occasions, could cause permanent paralysis.  On this world, though, you don't think the M12's lethality or lack thereof is going to be much of a concern.
translations: M12被设计为一种低致命性武器，用以替代更危险的人群控制手段。它单发即可使目标丧失行动能力长达一分钟，且几乎没有永久性后遗症。虽说不能称其为非致命性武器，因为它对患有心脏病或癫痫的目标并不安全，但这已是巨大的进步了，毕竟之前的X04“噬人者”型号，在一些不幸但并不少见的场合下，会造成永久性瘫痪。不过，在这个世界上，你觉得M12是否致命，恐怕已经不是什么需要担心的问题了。

messages.msgid: Power cartridges for the M12.  You had better make every shot count, because there's no way you're finding any more of these.
translations: M12的能源弹药。你最好珍惜每一发，因为你不可能再找到更多了。

messages.msgid: A shipboard battle rifle, whose non-kinetic ammunition was designed to avoid puncturing ship hulls during engagements.  The G-Tz77 has been a mainstay of the Imperial Navy for decades at this point and seen service on the surface of and in orbit around dozens of worlds.  This is just one more in its long history of protecting the Ēxcān Tlahtōlōyān.
translations: 一把舰载战斗步枪。其配备的非动能弹药，专为避免在交战中击穿舰体而设计。数十年来，G-Tz77一直是帝国海军的主战装备，其身影曾遍布数十个世界的地表与轨道。如今，它将为守护三合帝国的漫长历史再添一笔功勋。

messages.msgid: This is recognizably a rifle but it's like nothing you've ever seen.  The magazine seems to be inserted into the stock and the barrel is almost as big around as your wrist.  When you hold it, some kind of electronic display above the grip shows a series of odd symbols.
translations: 这东西能认出是一把步枪，但和你见过的任何种类都大相径庭。它的弹匣似乎是装在枪托里的，枪管几乎有你的手腕那么粗。当你握住它时，握把上方的一个电子显示屏会显示出一系列奇怪的符号。

messages.msgid: A power pack for the G-Tz77.
Power cartridges for the G-Tz77.  You had better make every shot count, because there's no way you're finding any more of these.
translations: G-Tz77的能源弹药。你最好珍惜每一发，因为你不可能再找到更多了。

messages.msgid: An all-encompassing helmet, standard issue for Imperial warrior orders.  Containing integral hearing protection and air filtration while still leaving your mouth free, highlights distant targets to provide easier targeting in battlefield conditions, has integral nightvision and thermal sensing, provides some protection against telepathic assault, and looks great while doing it.  This one has the eagle and stars of the Itzcuāuhtli Corps on it.
translations: 一顶全覆盖式头盔，帝国武士团的制式装备。它集成了听力保护与空气过滤系统，同时嘴部区域保持开放；能够高亮显示远方目标，使战场瞄准更为轻松；内置夜视与热感应功能；可提供一定的反心灵突袭保护；并且外观酷炫。这一顶上带有黑曜之鹰军团的鹰与星徽记。

messages.msgid: You flip the switch and activate the helmet's functions.
translations: 你拨动开关，启动了头盔的功能。

messages.msgid: The switch clicks but nothing happens.
translations: 开关咔嗒一声，但什么也没发生。
帝国海军战斗头盔（已激活）

messages.msgid: An all-encompassing helmet, standard issue for Imperial warrior orders.  Containing integral hearing protection and air filtration while still leaving your mouth free, highlights distant targets to provide easier targeting in battlefield conditions, has integral nightvision and thermal sensing, provides some protection against telepathic assault, and looks great while doing it.  This one has the eagle and stars of the Itzcuāuhtli Corps on it.  It is currently active.
translations: 一顶全覆盖式头盔，帝国武士团的制式装备。它集成了听力保护与空气过滤系统，同时嘴部区域保持开放；能够高亮显示远方目标，使战场瞄准更为轻松；内置夜视与热感应功能；可提供一定的反心灵突袭保护；并且外观酷炫。这一顶上带有黑曜之鹰军团的鹰与星徽记。它目前处于激活状态。

messages.msgid: You flip the switch and deactivate the helmet's functions.
translations: 你拨动开关，关闭了头盔的功能。

messages.msgid: A set of torso and upper-arm armor made with mixed leather overlaid with sheets of ichcayolli, pāncahcallō armor derives its effectiveness from the integral generator capable of projecting an ehēcatepantli barrier that provides most of the armor's protection.
translations: 一套由混合皮革制成，外覆甲胄棉薄片的躯干和上臂护甲。磐壳甲的效能源于其内置的发生器，该发生器能投射出风灵障壁，为护甲提供了绝大部分的防护能力。

messages.msgid: You flip the switch and activate the ehēcatepantli barrier.
translations: 你拨动开关，启动了风灵障壁。

messages.msgid: A set of torso and upper-arm armor made with mixed leather overlaid with sheets of ichcayolli, pāncahcallō armor derives its effectiveness from the integral generator capable of projecting an ehēcatepantli barrier that provides most of the armor's protection.  The ehēcatepantli is currently active.
translations: 一套由混合皮革制成，外覆甲胄棉薄片的躯干和上臂护甲。磐壳甲的效能源于其内置的发生器，该发生器能投射出风灵障壁，为护甲提供了绝大部分的防护能力。风灵障壁当前处于激活状态。

messages.msgid: You flip the switch and deactivate the ehēcatepantli barrier.
translations: 你拨动开关，关闭了风灵障壁。

messages.msgid: A set of leather armor covered in some kind of very stiff white cloth.  A small textured box is attached to the left side, easily accessible with either hand.  The box has a switch of some kind and several odd pictographs around the switch.
translations: 一套覆盖着某种非常僵硬的白色布料的皮甲。左侧附有一个带纹理的小盒子，用哪只手都能轻松够到。盒子上有一个开关，周围还有几个奇怪的象形文字。

messages.msgid: A set of leather armor covered in some kind of very stiff white cloth.  A small textured box is attached to the left side, easily accessible with either hand.  The box has a switch of some kind and several odd pictographs around the switch.  The switch is currently flipped.
translations: 一套覆盖着某种非常僵硬的白色布料的皮甲。左侧附有一个带纹理的小盒子，用哪只手都能轻松够到。盒子上有一个开关，周围还有几个奇怪的象形文字。开关当前处于拨开状态。
黑曜之鹰军团礼服披风

messages.msgid: A formal dress cape for the Itzcuāuhtli Corps in crimson and gold, with the eagle's head over a field of stars insignia on the left shoulder, worn by generations of those who sought out new worlds in service to the Huey Tlatoani and the Ēxcān Tlahtōlōyān.  You're pretty sure this is the furthest anyone wearing one has ever been from Anáhuac.
translations: 黑曜之鹰军团的正式礼服披风，赤金二色。左肩饰有鹰首星野徽记。一代又一代的开拓者曾身披此袍，为至高尊主与三合帝国探索未知的新世界。你敢肯定，身着此袍之人，从未远离阿纳瓦克至如此地步。

messages.msgid: A flat crimson hat worn by members of the Imperial navy at formal events.  This one has the black circle of the Yohualli Ehēcatl on it.
translations: 帝国海军成员在正式场合佩戴的深红色平顶帽。这顶帽子上有一个夜风师团的黑色圆形标志。

messages.msgid: A holster for the Ch47.  You could put one of the primitive local ranged weapons in here too, if you had to.
translations: Ch47 手枪的枪套。如果需要的话，你也可以将其他本地原始的远程武器收进其中。

messages.msgid: A holster for the M12.  You could put one of the primitive local ranged weapons in here too, if you had to.
translations: M12用的枪套。如果需要的话，你也可以把本地的原始远程武器放进去。

messages.msgid: A dress tunic, in gold and crimson, slashed with black bars.  This would immediately mark your exact rank and position to anyone else in the Imperial Navy, if you ever see another one again.
translations: 一件金色和深红色的正装长袍，被黑色长条纹分割开。这件长袍能立即向帝国海军中的其他人标明你的确切军衔和职位，前提是你还能再见到一个。

messages.msgid: A dress tunic, in gold and crimson, slashed with yellow bars.  This marks the wearer as one of the Jaguar Warrior special forces.
translations: 一件金红相间的礼服，划有黄色条杠。这标志着穿戴者是美洲豹战士特种部队的一员。

messages.msgid: Some sort of uniform dress shirt in a blood-red crimson color with gold accents and a series of yellow bars on the left side.  You can't recall any military that dresses quite like this.
translations: 某种制式礼服衬衫，猩红色调，带有金色镶边，左侧有一系列黄色条杠。你想不起有哪支军队是这种打扮。

messages.msgid: A set of gold and crimson uniform pants.  The days of wearing only a maxtlatl are gone following the expansion of the empire out from Anáhuac, and considering the local climate, you're grateful for it.
translations: 一条金色和深红色的正装长裤。随着帝国从“阿纳瓦克”扩张，只穿着缠腰布的日子已经一去不复返了，考虑到本地气候，你对此心怀感激。

messages.msgid: Some sort of uniform pants in a blood-red crimson color with gold accents.  You can't recall any military that dresses quite like this.
translations: 某种制式长裤，猩红色调，带有金色镶边。你想不起有哪支军队是这种打扮。

messages.msgid: Simple black leather boots.  It's a good thing you weren't transporting a planetary tlatoani when the accident happened or you might have ended up on this gods-forsaken hellhole barefoot.
translations: 一双简单的黑色皮靴。幸好事故发生时你并没有运送行星级“特拉托尼”，否则你可能会赤脚踏进这个被诸神遗弃的地狱。

messages.msgid: Your trustworthy connection to the local mātlatzālantli, the māchīuhpōhualhuaztli allows you to store and read texts through tonaltēzcatl projection, look up info, keep track of your biometrics, play games, record visuals or sound, connect with far-distant friends and family, act as a calendar and event planner, and even identify you to agents of the government or, gods forbid, the Tlamachchiuhqueh, should that become necessary.  There's nothing to connect to on this blighted world, but the other functions should still work.
translations: 你与本地灵网的可靠连接，知算仪能让你通过魂镜投影来储存和阅读文本、查询信息、追踪你的生物特征、玩游戏、录制视频或声音、与远方的亲友联系、充当你的日历和日程规划器，甚至在必要时向政府人员或（诸神保佑）知执者的特工表明你的身份。虽然在这个被诅咒的世界上已经没什么东西可以连接了，但其他功能应该还能用。

messages.msgid: This looks like a smartwatch but it doesn't have a screen.  There are two buttons on each side, and when you press one of them, a series of glowing holograms spring up over your wrist.  They depict what looks like a menu, but everything is written in blobby symbols that look vaguely…Mayan?  You've never seen anything like this before.
translations: 这东西看起来像个智能手表，但没有屏幕。两侧各有两个按钮，当你按下一个时，一连串发光的全息影像就会从你手腕上方弹出。影像描绘的似乎是个菜单，但所有内容都是用一种团块状的符号写成的，看起来有点……像玛雅文？你以前从未见过这样的东西。
黑曜之鹰军团作战服长裤

messages.msgid: The standard combat uniform of the Itzcuāuhtli Corps, in shades of dark green and grey.  These are pants, with several pockets.
translations: 黑曜之鹰军团的制式作战服，采用深绿与灰色的色调。这是一条带有数个口袋的长裤。
黑曜之鹰军团作战服衬衫

messages.msgid: The standard combat uniform of the Itzcuāuhtli Corps, in shades of dark green and grey.  This is a shirt.
translations: 黑曜之鹰军团的制式作战服，采用深绿与灰色的色调。这是一件衬衫。
黑曜之鹰军团作战服夹克

messages.msgid: The standard combat uniform of the Itzcuāuhtli Corps, in shades of dark green and grey.  This is a jacket.  It has the eagle over a field of stars symbol of the Itzcuāuhtli Corps on both shoulders.
translations: 黑曜之鹰军团的制式作战服，采用深绿与灰色的色调。这是一件夹克，双肩饰有黑曜之鹰军团的鹰翔星野徽记。

messages.msgid: A necklace made of fine gold chain, bearing an image of Jesucristo as the Ultimate Sacrifice as a pendant, his heart clearly visible through his chest.  Under his left hand is a raindrop, representing the Aeon Tláloc, and under his right hand is a sun disc, representing the Aeon Huītzilōpōchtli.
translations: 一条精致的金链项链，吊坠是作为“终极献祭”的耶稣像，祂的心脏透过胸膛清晰可见。祂的左手下方是一滴雨珠，代表雨神特拉洛克；右手下方是一轮日盘，代表太阳神维齐洛波奇特利。

messages.msgid: This is an inferno grenade, designed to channel Netherum energy to increase its incendiary power.  Once you throw it, you will have five seconds to get away before it explodes into a raging firestorm.
translations: 炼狱手雷，以异界能量引导出更强的燃烧效果。启动后五秒就会炸成暴烈的火风暴。

messages.msgid: This is an active inferno grenade.  Better throw it!
translations: 激活的炼狱手雷，快扔出去！

messages.msgid: This is a post-apocalyptic recreation of an inferno grenade, less powerful than a lab-made one but still very dangerous.  Once you throw it, you will have five seconds to get away before it explodes into a raging firestorm.
translations: 这是一款末日后的炼狱手雷仿制品，威力虽不及实验室制造的那般强大，但依然十分危险。一旦投掷出去，你将有五秒钟的时间逃离，随后它便会爆炸，引发一场熊熊燃烧的火风暴。

messages.msgid: This is an active makeshift inferno grenade.  Better throw it!
translations: 激活的自制炼狱手雷，快扔出去！

messages.msgid: A strange grenade, designed like nothing you've seen before.  It's round, with flat black crystalline panels like television screens on four sides, and two buttons on either end.  On both of the buttons is a large Ψ, surrounded by a circle with a line through it.
translations: 一枚造型奇特的手雷，和你以前见过的任何设计都不同。它是圆形的，四面有平板电视屏幕般的黑色水晶面板，两端各有一个按钮。两个按钮上都有一个大大的Ψ符号，符号外还有一个带横线的圆圈。

messages.msgid: You press the buttons on the sides of the null grenade.
translations: 你按下了寂灭手雷两侧的按钮。

messages.msgid: This null grenade is activate and ready to unleash its pulse.  You'd better throw it!
translations: 这枚寂灭手雷已被激活，随时会释放脉冲。快把它扔出去！

messages.msgid: The %s is already active, try throwing it instead.
translations: %s已被激活，试试直接把它扔出去吧。

messages.msgid: A strange grenade, designed like nothing you've seen before.  It's round, with flat black crystalline panels like television screens on four sides, and two buttons on either end.  On both of the buttons is a large Ψ, surrounded by a circle with a line through it.  The buttons on either end are depressed.
translations: 这是一枚奇特的手雷，其设计前所未见。它呈圆形，四面嵌有电视屏幕般的黑色扁平晶体板，两端各有一个按钮。两个按钮上都印有一个大大的Ψ符号，符号外围则是一个被线条贯穿的圆圈。两端的按钮均已按下。

messages.msgid: A matrix crystal attuned to pyrokinesis.  This one has a (currently) stable loop of energy set up within it.  It would take only a thought to destabilize the energy loop and set up a reaction that would lead to a massive explosion.
translations: 一块与焰动灵能相协调的矩阵晶体。这块晶体内部目前有一个稳定的能量循环。只需一个念头就能破坏这个能量循环，引发一场巨大的爆炸。

messages.msgid: With a thought, you destabilize the matrix crystal.
translations: 随着一个念头，你使矩阵晶体失去稳定。
焰动矩阵晶体炸弹（失稳）

messages.msgid: A matrix crystal attuned to pyrokinesis.  The faint light in its depths is growing brighter and brighter, and the crystal itself is heating up as you hold it.
translations: 一块与焰动灵能相协调的矩阵晶体。其内部微弱的光芒正变得越来越亮，而当你握住它时，晶体本身也在逐渐升温。

messages.msgid: The %s is already destabilized, try throwing it instead.
translations: %s已经失去了稳定，你应该把它丢出去。

messages.msgid: The LV429 fires a series of extremely short high-energy laser pulses, more like bullets than a traditional laser beam, greatly reducing dwell time and increasing weapon effectiveness.  Matrix crystal technology has made the weapon compact enough to be man-portable and provided it with enough power for essentially unlimited combat operations, but heat dissipation is still a problem, preventing it from being fired more than once every few seconds.
translations: LV429 发射一系列极短的高能激光脉冲，相对传统的连续波激光，极大减少滞留时间、提高武器效能。矩阵晶体技术使该武器紧凑得可以随身携带，且基本，但散热仍然是一个问题，让它必须冷却几秒才能再次射击。

messages.msgid: The LV429 fires a series of extremely short high-energy laser pulses, more like bullets than a traditional laser beam, greatly reducing dwell time and increasing weapon effectiveness.  Matrix crystal technology has made the weapon compact enough to be man-portable and provided it with enough power for essentially unlimited operation.  This is a prototype, obvious from the bright red coloration of the barrel and grip, as well as the word "prototype" written in large letters on the stock and the flammable symbol next to it.
translations: LV429发射一系列极短的高能激光脉冲，比传统的激光束更像子弹，极大地缩短了停留时间，提高了武器效率。矩阵晶体技术使武器足够紧凑，便于携带，并为其提供了足够的电力，基本上可以进行无限的操作。这是一个原型，从枪管和把手的鲜红色，以及用大字写在股票上的原型和旁边的易燃符号上可以明显看出。

messages.msgid: A simple synthetic fabric belt with a box to the right of the belt loop.  The box has a toggleable switch and a stylized shield with Ψ and the XEDRA logo inside it.
translations: 简单的化纤腰带，右边挂着一个盒。盒上有个开关，还有一个盾牌徽记，内有Ψ字样和XEDRA标志。

messages.msgid: You flip the switch on the box and a red LED lights up.
translations: 你拨动盒子上的开关，红色LED亮起。

messages.msgid: You flip the switch on the box and the red LED turns off.
translations: 你拨动盒子上的开关，红色LED熄灭。

messages.msgid: A simple synthetic fabric belt with a box to the right of the belt loop.  The box has a toggleable switch and a stylized shield with Ψ and the XEDRA logo inside it.  It also has a large crack across it and rattles when moved.
translations: 简单的化纤腰带，右边挂着一个盒。盒上有个开关，还有一个盾牌徽记，内有Ψ字样和XEDRA标志。盒上有一条大裂缝，移动时会发出响声。

messages.msgid: You flip the switch on the box, but nothing happens.
translations: 你拨动盒子上的开关，但什么也没发生。

messages.msgid: A simple synthetic fabric belt with a box to the right of the belt loop.  The box has a toggleable switch and a stylized flame with a large circle and line superimposed over it and a Ψ behind the XEDRA logo inside it.
translations: 简单的化纤腰带，右边挂着一个盒。盒上有个开关，还有一个上有圆圈和斜线的火焰徽记，徽记里是背后有Ψ字样的XEDRA标志。
