messages.msgid: A simple synthetic fabric belt with a box to the right of the belt loop.  The box has a toggleable switch and a stylized flame with a large circle and line superimposed over it and a Ψ behind the XEDRA logo inside it.  It also has a large crack across it and rattles when moved.
translations: 简单的化纤腰带，右边挂着一个盒。盒上有个开关，还有一个上有圆圈和斜线的火焰徽记，徽记里是背后有Ψ字样的XEDRA标志。盒上有一条大裂缝，移动时会发出响声。

messages.msgid: A sleek blouse in a camouflage pattern with angled breast pockets and lots of loop velcro for affixing patches.  You might call it a jacket but it's really a blouse.  It bears an onyx patch reading "ONYX LIGHTNING".
translations: 一件时髦的迷彩上衣，配有斜向胸袋和大量用于粘贴徽章的魔术贴。你也许会称其为夹克，但它确实是一件上衣。衣服上带有一块写着“ONYX LIGHTNING”的玛瑙徽章。

messages.msgid: A thin steel circlet studded with chunks of matrix crystal.  Your skin prickles slightly where the crown touches it.
translations: 一个镶嵌着矩阵晶体块的细细的钢制头环。在相位锚冠接触处的皮肤会轻微刺痛。

messages.msgid: A steel skullcap with a matrix crystal at its crown.  It looks ridiculous, but the documents you read said it would protect you from telepathic attack.
translations: 一顶钢制无边便帽，帽顶镶嵌着一颗矩阵晶体。它看起来相当滑稽，但你读过的文档声称，这东西能保护你免受心灵攻击。

messages.msgid: A set of AR-looking glasses.  The code "QD944-P" is printed in small letters on the temples.
translations: 一套 AR 眼镜。 镜腿上用小字印着代码 “QD944-P”。

messages.msgid: A set of AR-looking glasses.  The code "QD944-P" is printed in small letters on the temples.  They are currently active.
translations: 一副外观颇具AR风格的眼镜，镜腿上用小字印着代码“QD944-P”。它们目前处于激活状态。

messages.msgid: A set of matrix crystals arranged together to direct Netherium energy.  You're not entirely sure all the crystals are actually touching the metal assembly soldered around them.
translations: 一组矩阵晶体排列在一起，用以引导虚质能量。你不太确定所有晶体是否都真正接触到了焊接在它们周围的金属部件。

messages.msgid: A precise arrangement of cut crystal pieces from the crystal outgrowths left by the portal storms.  The air in the center shimmers like a summer heat gaze when you look through the focal point of the apparatus.
translations: 一片从空间风暴留下的晶体产物上精心切割下来的晶片。当你透过晶片焦点看过去时，那中间的空气就像夏日灼热的阳光一样闪闪发光。

messages.msgid: A glowing white netherium crystal surrounded by floating dust and shards of crystal.  The closer you look at the assembly the louder your thoughts sound.
translations: 一枚泛着白光的虚质晶体，周围悬浮着尘埃与晶体碎屑。你越是靠近端详，脑海中的思绪就越是响亮。

messages.msgid: A household flashlight enhanced with matrix technology.  It is slightly dimmer but will last significantly longer.
translations: 采用矩阵技术增强的家用手电筒。它稍微暗一些，但使用时间要长得多。

messages.msgid: Powered by matrix technology, this lamp will shed a bluish light for far longer than a standard battery-powered lamp.  Activate to open the lid.
translations: 这盏灯由矩阵技术供能，能发出幽蓝色的光，其续航时间远超标准电池灯。激活以打开灯罩。

messages.msgid: Powered by matrix technology, this lamp will shed a reddish light for far longer than a standard battery-powered lamp.  Activate to close the lid.
translations: 这个灯采用矩阵技术供电，散发出偏红的光芒，寿命比普通电池供电的灯要长得多。激活它以关闭灯罩。

messages.msgid: A tall floor lamp that provides illumination when plugged into a power outlet.  This lamp is enhanced with matrix technology, making it far more power efficient.
translations: 一盏高大的落地灯，插入电源插座即可提供照明。这盏灯经过矩阵技术强化，能效远胜以往。

messages.msgid: This defies easy description, it feels solid but the surface is yielding.  Looking at it you are reminded of the electric tingle in the air before a portal storm.
translations: 这很难用简单的语言来描述，它摸上去感觉很结实，但表面却很柔软。看着它，你会想起空间风暴发生前空气中的电刺感。

messages.msgid: Seems like chaos in solid form.
translations: 看起来像是固体形式的浑沌。

messages.msgid: This is the pseudo-tool provided by having a nearby cluster of black nether crystal.  You shouldn't see this as an individual item.
translations: 这是由附近的黑色异界晶体提供的伪工具。如果你以物品形式看到这个，说明游戏出bug了。
已激活的灵智谐振探测器

messages.msgid: This is the pseudo-tool provided by having a nearby active noetic resonance detector.  You shouldn't see this as an individual item.
translations: 这是由附近已激活的灵智谐振探测器提供的虚拟工具。它不应作为独立物品出现。

messages.msgid: A pyramidal object with a matrix crystal on top, surrounded by several chunks of the otherworldly boulders you've found dotting the landscape.  You could place it somewhere and after you've configured it, use a transporter remote to teleport yourself to its location.
translations: 一个金字塔形的物体，顶部有一个矩阵晶体，周围环绕着几块你找来的散落在野外的异界石块。你可以把它放在某处，在你配置完成后，使用传送终端把自己传送到它所在的位置。

messages.msgid: A blocky item, like an old feature cellphone crossed with a radio.  A matrix channeling array is stick out of the side like an antenna.  There is a small screen on the front, currently off.
translations: 一台四四方方的设备，就像是老式功能手机和收音机的混合体。一个矩阵引导阵列像天线一样从侧面伸出。正面有块小屏幕，目前处于关闭状态。

messages.msgid: You turn the transporter remote on and the screen begins displaying coordinates.
translations: 你打开传送终端，屏幕上开始出现一排坐标。

messages.msgid: The transporter remote's batteries need more charge.

A blocky item, like an old feature cellphone crossed with a radio.  A matrix channeling array is sticking out of the side like an antenna.  There is a small screen on the front, currently running what looks like a series of mathematical calculations.
translations: 一台四四方方的设备，就像是老式功能手机和收音机的混合体。一个矩阵引导阵列像天线一样从侧面伸出。正面有块小屏幕，目前正在进行一系列数学计算。

messages.msgid: You turn the transporter remote off.
Begin the transportation process.  It will take several minutes for the remote to zero in on the beacon location.
translations: 启动传送进程。终端需要几分钟才能锁定信标的位置。

messages.msgid: A blocky item, like an old feature cellphone crossed with a radio.  A matrix channeling array was sticking out of the side like an antenna, but it's now cracked and probably useless.  There is a small screen on the front, obviously burned out.  Parts of the plastic casing are warped as though the plastic had frozen and cracked.
translations: 一台四四方方的设备，就像是老式功能手机和收音机的混合体。一个矩阵引导阵列像天线一样从侧面伸出。正面有块小屏幕，很明显烧焦了。一部分塑料外壳扭曲变形了，就好像塑料被冻裂了一样。

messages.msgid: This "psychic powers" stuff is easy, as long as nothing distracts you.  When you are concentrating on 0 powers, or have 0 pain, you have an easier time invoking your powers.
translations: 所谓的“灵能”并不难，只要别被分心就好。当你不维持任何能力，或不受任何疼痛困扰时，你会更容易施展你的力量。

messages.msgid: Your telekinetic attacks really hammer into your target.  Damaging telekinetic powers have a much higher chance to stagger or knock down your targets.
translations: 你的念动攻击像真实的锤子一样重击在你的目标上。伤害性念动灵能有更高的几率使目标踉跄或倒地。

messages.msgid: Some part of your Metabolic Hyperefficiency is running even when you sleep, or perhaps your wakeful meditations have made the process of sleeping more efficient.  You can stay awake for 20% longer, and sleep is 20% more restorative.
translations: 即使当你睡着了，灵能“高效代谢”的某些部分也还在运转，或者你清醒时的冥想使睡眠过程更加高效。你保持清醒的时间延长20%，睡眠的恢复能力也提高了20%。

messages.msgid: Happy.  In Your Lane.  Focused.  Flourishing.  Your Intelligence is only penalized 66% of the normal amount from pain, and 33% of normal if you're using the Biokinetic power Overcome Pain, the Electrokinetic power Pain Suppression, or the Telepathic power Mood Stabilization.
translations: 心情愉悦，守住本心，精神集中，茁壮成长。疼痛对你智力造成的减损仅为正常情况的66%；若你使用炼体者灵能“克服苦痛”、驱电者灵能“疼痛抑制”或传心者灵能“稳定情绪”，则该减损将降至正常情况的33%。

messages.msgid: Once you get going you just keep rolling.  Your next use of a psionic power within five seconds of channeling one has its stamina cost reduced by 25%.
translations: 只要你踏出一步，就可以顺势前进。在你引导灵能后五秒内，你下次使用灵能时所消耗的耐力降低 25%。

messages.msgid: Your control of your own body has given you control of your own genetics, albeit a subconscious one.  You will be less likely to suffer from negative mutations when taking mutagen.
translations: 你对自己身体的控制使你能够控制自己的基因，尽管是潜意识的控制。 在服用诱变剂时，你将更少出现负面变异。

messages.msgid: Your Premonition ability has developed to such a level that you can sense movement around you even when you sleep.
translations: 你的危险感知能力已臻化境，即使在睡梦中也能察觉周遭的动静。

messages.msgid: Nether energy easily flows through you, causing your power to rise and fall far faster than normal.  You gain far more Nether Attunement from channeling or maintaining your powers, but you lose your Nether Attunement much faster as well.  You do not lose Nether Attunement at this accelerated rate while maintaining any powers.
translations: 虚空能量能轻易地流经你的身体，使你的力量涨落远超常人。你引导或维持灵能时会获得更多的虚空同调，但虚空同调的消退速度也同样快得多。在维持任何灵能期间，你的虚空同调不会以这种加速速率消退。

messages.msgid: Only the phoenix rises and does not descend, but you're going try your hardest.  The stamina cost of your powers is reduced beginning at Nether Attunement level 8, reaching 1/3rd of normal by Nether Attunement level 12.
translations: 唯有凤凰浴火高飞，永不坠落，但你仍将竭力一试。从虚空同调8级开始，你灵能的耐力消耗将会降低，到12级时将降至正常消耗的三分之一。

messages.msgid: You are one with the Nether and the Nether is with you.  The stamina cost of channeling your next power is reduced by 25%.
translations: 你与虚空同在，虚空与你同行。引导下一个能力的耐力消耗降低25%。

messages.msgid: A brown jumpsuit with OA written in big yellow block letters on the back.
translations: 一件棕色连身衣，背面写着OA两个黄色大写字母。

messages.msgid: A black jumpsuit with white symbol "υ" on the back.
translations: 黑色连身裤，背面有白色符号“υ”。

messages.msgid: A black jumpsuit with white symbol "ϴ" on the back.
translations: 黑色连身裤，背面有白色符号“ϴ”。

messages.msgid: A black jumpsuit with white symbol "ν" on the back.
translations: 背面印有白色符号ν的黑色连体裤。

messages.msgid: A black jumpsuit with white symbol "τ" on the back.
translations: 背面印有白色符号τ的黑色连体裤。

messages.msgid: A black jumpsuit with white symbol "Ψ" on the back.
translations: 一件黑色连体服，背后印有白色的“Ψ”符号。

messages.msgid: The Ierde's mind has the resilience of iron, and they cannot be affected by delusions, hallucinations, or other mental problems.  In addition, they are immune to telepathic attack.
translations: 土妖精的心智如钢铁般坚韧，不受妄想、幻觉或其他精神问题的影响。此外，他们还对心灵攻击免疫。

messages.msgid: The air nearby fractures and something comes through!
translations: 附近的空气破裂了，有东西进来了！

messages.msgid: The air erupts into an eye-searing flash!
translations: 空中爆发出一道灼眼的光芒！

messages.msgid: Add the effect to give the whispering_amalgamation mindsight.
translations: 添加效果，赋予低语融合怪心灵视觉。

messages.msgid: Stone at the ready to crush that which isn't part of the blob.
translations: 一块碎石，准备粉碎任何还未臣服于变形怪的生物。

messages.msgid: Spray fire in a cone in front of you, if you're a hellhound.
translations: 作为地狱犬，你可以朝面前喷射锥形火焰。

messages.msgid: Add the effect to give the hidebehind mindsight.
translations: 添加效果，赋予藏身怪心灵视觉。

messages.msgid: Add the effect to give the eater mindsight.
translations: 添加效果，赋予吞噬者心灵视觉。

messages.msgid: Your expanded mind is far more capable of understanding Netherum Mathematics than a mere human's.  You have an greater chance of awakening new psionic paths.
translations: 你膨胀发散的思维比一般人更有利于理解异界的数学逻辑。你有更高概率去觉醒新的灵能道途。

messages.msgid: You have a normal human (lack of) capacity for psionic powers.
translations: 像正常人类一样，你没有灵能。

messages.msgid: Thanks to your powers, you need less food and drink than the average person and are more efficient at processing it.
translations: 灵能让你需要更少食物和水，消化也更为高效。

messages.msgid: Your powers protect you from some sensory disruption and allow you to detect creatures from beyond.
translations: 你的能力保护你免受部分感官干扰，并使你能够察觉来自异界的生物。

messages.msgid: Your powers help protect you from electrical damage and slightly reduce the intensity of pain you feel.
translations: 你的灵能保护你免受电击伤害，并稍微减轻你感受到的疼痛强度。

messages.msgid: Your powers passively filter the amount of photons your eyes receive.
translations: 你的灵能能够被动过滤眼睛接收到的光子数量。

messages.msgid: You naturally heat the air around you slightly, making it more comfortable in the cold.  It also helps prevent you from getting too wet.
translations: 你能够自然地稍微加热四周空气，使你在寒冷中感觉舒适。它还能防止你被完全淋湿。

messages.msgid: Thanks to a minor application of telekinesis, the items you want to grab are always quick to hand.
translations: 略施念力，想抓取的物品便唾手可得。

messages.msgid: You are subtly influencing the minds of the people you speak to.
translations: 你正在巧妙地影响与你交谈的人的思想。

messages.msgid: You can keep otherworldly eyes off you to some extent, and you will sometimes instinctively teleport to avoid danger.
translations: 你能减少异界存在对你的关注，有时也会无自觉地传送以离开危险。

messages.msgid: Your psionic powers speed your healing slightly and increase your overall resilience, and any broken limbs you have mend straight and true.
translations: 你的灵能加速了自愈速度、提高了身体韧性，断肢也会快速复原。

messages.msgid: The fire in your soul rises and falls, but never truly goes out.
translations: 你灵魂中的火焰虽有起伏，却永不熄灭。

messages.msgid: Gazing into the near future lets you know what part goes where.
translations: 凝视不久的将来，让你知道每个部分应该安装在哪。

messages.msgid: With a modicum of concentration you can carry a single item with your powers.
translations: 稍加专注，你便能以念力托举单件物品。

messages.msgid: Thanks to the crystalline elixir, you can lash out with unfocused surges of telekinetic power.
translations: 多亏了晶体灵药，你释放出无需专注的念力灵能进行猛烈攻击。

messages.msgid: You are lashing out with your elixir-forged telekinetic powers.
translations: 你正在用你的灵药锻造的念力灵能猛烈攻击。

messages.msgid: You rein your powers back in for now.
The anchor crown you're wearing is shutting down your psionic powers.
translations: 你所穿戴的相位锚冠正在阻碍你使用灵能。

messages.msgid: The telepathic dampener you're wearing is protecting your mind.
translations: 你佩戴的心灵减震器正在保护你的心智。

messages.msgid: You can make the air around you emit a strong light.
translations: 你能让你附近的空气发出强光。

messages.msgid: The air around you starts glowing brightly.
translations: 附近的空气开始发出强光。

messages.msgid: The air around you is emitting a bright light.
translations: 附近的空气正在发出强光。

messages.msgid: The air around you loses its radiance.

translations: 对各类生理过程的灵能控制力。

messages.msgid: The ability to extend the senses beyond the body.
translations: 将感官延伸到身体之外的能力。

messages.msgid: Mental control of lightning and electricity.
translations: 对闪电和电流的灵能控制力。

messages.msgid: Mental control of visible light and electromagnetic waves.
translations: 对可见光和电磁波的灵能控制力。

messages.msgid: Mental control of heat and flame.
translations: 对热量和火焰的灵能控制力。

messages.msgid: Mental control over the motion of objects and people at a distance.
translations: 对远处物体和人的运动的灵能控制力。

messages.msgid: The ability to move without crossing the intervening space, as well as some control over space itself.
translations: 能够在不穿过中间空间的情况下移动，以及对空间本身的一定控制。

messages.msgid: Mental control over health and vitality.
translations: 对健康和活力的灵能控制力。

messages.msgid: You've seen people do some crazy things after the Cataclysm, but you've never managed to figure out how they do it.  You can never learn psionic powers.
translations: 你见过人们在大灾变后完成一些疯狂的事迹，但你从来没尝试想过他们是怎么做到的。 你永远无法学会灵能。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm, you were lucky in some way.  Maybe you never lost your keys, or maybe you always made that last green light before getting home, or maybe you never had to take a sick day in your life.  Now after the Cataclysm, you have the potential for even more power.  Your first attempt to awaken psionic powers will always be successful.
translations: 大灾变之前，你在某种程度上运气一直很好。也许你从未丢失过钥匙，也许你总能在回家前赶上最后一趟绿灯，也许你一生中从未请过病假。大灾变之后，你拥有了更强大的潜力。你第一次唤醒灵能的尝试必定成功。

messages.msgid: You managed to awaken psionic powers, but it was a struggle and you're not sure you'll be able to do it again.  You are subject to the random odds of awakening new powers.
translations: 你成功觉醒了灵能，但过程很艰难，而且你不确定自己是否还能再次做到。 你觉醒新能力的几率是随机的。

messages.msgid: You aren't from this universe and hopefully someday you can go home.  This is a hidden trait, used for dialogue.
translations: 你不是来自这个位面，希望有一天你能回家。这是一个隐藏的特征，用于对话。

messages.msgid: You can drain a bit of vital energy from victims when attacking their minds with telepathy or their bodies with vitakinesis.
translations: 当你使用心灵感应攻击受害者的心智，或使用疗愈术攻击其肉体时，你可以从他们身上汲取少量生命能量。

messages.msgid: Who needs weapons?  Thanks to your biokinesis, you deal more melee damage while fighting with your bare hands.  This damage improves as your unarmed skill and biokinetic prowess increase.
translations: 谁还需要武器？凭借你的炼体能力，你在徒手战斗时能造成更高的近战伤害。这项伤害会随着你的徒手技能与炼体者灵能的提升而增长。

messages.msgid: You can keep your mind on something even if there are plenty of distractions.  The number of psionic powers you can maintain at once is increased by 1.
translations: 即使有很多分心的事情，你也能集中注意力。你可以同时维持的灵能数增加1。

messages.msgid: Any day now you're going to buckle down and oh hey is that a butterfly?  The number of psionic powers you can maintain at once is reduced by 1.
translations: 你的注意力随时都会被引……哦有蝴蝶？你能同时维持的灵能减少1个。

messages.msgid: You could keep every single bug in the game in mind simultaneously with this one.
translations: 你可以同时记住游戏中的每一个漏洞，还保持专注。

messages.msgid: You can take more time and care in channeling your powers.  It will take 25x as long to evoke them, but it will be much easier to activate them and you will be less likely to gain Nether Attunement while doing so.
translations: 你可以花费更多的时间和精力来引导你的灵能。唤醒灵能需要25倍的时间，但激活灵能会更容易，而且获得异界同调的可能性更小。

messages.msgid: The active trait for Extended Channeling.  It's a bug if you can see it.
translations: 延时引导激活的隐藏特性。如果你看到这个，说明游戏出bug了。

messages.msgid: You can draw deeply on the Nether, increasing the strength of your powers but making making them harder to initiate and control.
translations: 你更加深入异界，增加你的灵能强度，但同时变得更难启动和控制。

messages.msgid: The active trait for Torrential Channeling.  It's a bug if you can see it.
translations: 奔流引导激活的隐藏特性。如果你看到这个，说明游戏出bug了。

messages.msgid: The shadows are growing darker and darker to your sight.
translations: 阴影变得越来越黑暗，使你的视线变得模糊。

messages.msgid: Darkness begins to creep across your vision.
translations: 黑暗开始在你的视野中蔓延。

messages.msgid: Six point six Percent Nether Attunement Chance
Eight Point Three Percent Nether Attunement Chance
One hundred Percent Nether Attunement Chance
Applies Nether Attunement to you when maintaining a power.
translations: 在维持灵能时对自己施加异界同调。

messages.msgid: Use a target's own inner fears against them, paralyzing them with overwhelming terror.  The effect will not last long, but is completely immobilizing while it does, and it leaves a lingering horror behind in the target.
translations: 使用目标自身内心的恐惧来对付他们，用压倒性的恐怖使他们瘫痪。这种效果不会持续很久，但在持续期间完全能够使其无法动弹，并且会在目标身上留下持久的恐怖感。

messages.msgid: Walls are no barrier to a body of pure spirit.
translations: 墙壁并不能阻挡一个纯净灵魂的身体。

messages.msgid: Applies a longer debuff when using Primal Terror.  It's a bug if you have it directly.
translations: 使用原始恐惧时施加更长的debuff。直接拥有这个能力说明出bug了。

messages.msgid: This power is Obsolete, but you can still use it.  Teleport to an attuned location.
Attune to a location for later teleporting.
translations: 与区域同调，便于之后的传送。

messages.msgid:
By rerouting blood and stem cells from undamaged areas, you can lessen your most grievous wounds at the cost of weakness elsewhere.  You may also use this to control an asthma attack.


The power is OBSOLETE.
With a moment's concentration, your worst injuries heal, but you still don't feel well.
translations: 随着一阵专注，最严重的伤势痊愈了，但你仍然感觉不舒服。

messages.msgid: The healing part of Anabolic Rejuvenation.
The draining part of Anabolic Rejuvenation.
translations: 极速自愈 的耗尽部分。

messages.msgid:
You can improve your strength and agility with your powers.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
你可以使用灵能强化你的力量和敏捷。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid:
You can lessen the impact of pain on your performance, though this has no effect on the underlying injuries.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
你可以抑制疼痛，但对应的损伤仍会存在。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid:
You can make the entire surface of your skin selectively permeable, allowing you to 'breathe' through it.  You can breathe in low-oxygen environments or underwater, but are more vulnerable to toxic gas.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  Oxygen Absorption <color_red>cannot be active</color> with Sealed System.
translations:
你可以使皮肤具有选择透过性，让其拥有“呼吸”的灵能。这让你能在水下或氧气含量低的地方呼吸，但也会因为毒气受到更多伤害。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。体表呼吸 与 封闭躯体灵能<color_red>不能共存</color>。

messages.msgid: You can make your limbs move far beyond the normal human range of motion, allowing you to twist out of others' grasp and reduce fall damage.
translations: 你可以让你的四肢远远超出正常人类的运动范围，让你扭动身体，脱离别人的控制，减少摔倒造成的伤害。

messages.msgid: You body begins twisting in unbelievable ways.
translations: 你的肢体现在能以难以置信的方式运动。

messages.msgid: Like a cheetah, you can run with incredible speed for a short distance.
translations: 你可以在短时间内爆发出极快的速度，就像猎豹一样。

messages.msgid: You can reshape your physical appearance, changing hair, skin, or eye color.  Your own mother wouldn't recognize you when you're done.
translations: 你可以自由改变你的外观，改变头发、皮肤、眼睛颜色。没人能识破你的本来面目。

messages.msgid:
You can increase the strength of your skin, making it almost like armor while still allowing you to move freely.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
你可以增强皮肤的强度，使其坚硬如甲，同时不影响行动自如。

此异能需要<color_yellow>持续专注来维持</color>，若<color_yellow>专注中断</color>则可能<color_red>失效</color>。

messages.msgid: With a moment of concentration, you can trigger a surge of adrenaline.  This provides a speed boost, albeit at a draining cost when the boost expires.
translations: 只要专注片刻，你就能触发肾上腺素激增。这让你速度提升，尽管在激增期结束后需要承受精疲力竭的后果。

messages.msgid: Your heartbeat surges as your body floods with adrenaline.
translations: 你心跳加速，肾上腺素充满你的身体。

messages.msgid:
You can increase the heat dissipation and retention of your body, allowing you to function in a much wider range of temperatures.  Temperature Adaptability and Sealed System <color_red>will cancel each other</color>.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
你可以控制身体热量的去留，使你能够适应更宽的温度范围。温度适性和封闭躯体<color_red>会相互抵消</color>。
此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid:
Increase your range of motion and flexibility such that you can move more easily even in encumbering gear.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
增加你的灵活性和动作幅度，即使穿有很累赘的装备，也能轻松行动。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，  可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid:
Who needs tools?  You can apply enough raw force or torque with your bare hands to substitute for many simple tools.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
谁还要工具？如果你徒手就能施加足够的力或者扭矩，许多简单的工具就显得异常多余。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid:
You can improve your sensory acuity and the speed at which your brain processes sensory inputs.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
你可以提高你的感知能力并通过增强大脑处理感官输入信息的速度来提高动作速度。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid:
With a deep breath, you lock your body off from the outside world.  Gas, poison, blood, bile, electricity--nothing gets in, nothing gets out.

Sealed System <color_red>cannot be active</color> with either Temperature Adaptability or Oxygen Absorption.
translations:
你深深呼吸，将身体与外部世界隔绝开。气体、毒素、血液、胆汁、电流——内外的物质交换被隔断了。

封闭躯体 与 温度适性 或 体表呼吸 <color_red>不能共存</color>。

messages.msgid: You take a deep breath and seal your lips.
translations: 你深吸一口气，然后封闭了身体与外界。

messages.msgid:
You can supercharge your metabolism, allowing you to eat, drink, and sleep much less than normal.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.
translations:
你可以提高新陈代谢的利用率，比起正常人需要更少的吃喝和睡眠。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。<color_red>进入战斗失效</color>。

messages.msgid: Enter a trance and hyper focus on a narrow segment of your metabolism, supercharging your body's ability to create vitamins and expanding it beyond its normal range.  These vitamins will be created directly from your stored calories.
translations: 进入入定状态，将心神高度集中于新陈代谢的某一环节，从而极大地提高身体合成维生素的能力，并突破其常规极限。这些维生素会直接通过消耗你储存的卡路里来合成。

messages.msgid: You enter a trance and submerge your awareness into your body.
translations: 你进入入定状态，将意识沉浸于自己的身体之中。

messages.msgid:
With a large amount of focus, you can maintain a targeted control over any alterations to your body.  Whenever you mutate, you will have additional options to select from.  This power does not cause you to mutate on its own.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.  It requires <color_yellow>even more concentration</color> than usual.
translations:
通过高度专注，你可以对身体发生的任何变异进行定向控制。每当你发生突变时，都会有额外的选项供你选择。此异能本身不会引发突变。

此异能需要<color_yellow>持续专注来维持</color>，若<color_yellow>专注中断</color>则可能<color_red>失效</color>。一旦进入战斗，此效果便会<color_red>取消</color>。维持此异能需要比平时更高的<color_yellow>专注度</color>。

messages.msgid: You can flood your body with psionic power to enhance your combat prowess.
translations: 你可以用灵能充盈你的身体，以提高你的战斗灵能。

messages.msgid:
Your control over your body allows you to move incredibly quickly.  While this does not allow you to attack more quickly, you can cross distances in the blink of an eye and outrun a cheetah.  You could even run on water, though not walk on it.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It requires <color_yellow>even more concentration</color> than usual.

Perfected Motion <color_red>cannot be active</color> with Hurricane Blows.
translations:
你对身体的精妙控制使你能够以惊人的速度移动。虽然这并不能提升你的攻击速度，但你可以瞬间跨越长距离，速度快逾奔豹。你甚至能做到水上飞奔，尽管还无法在水上行走。

此异能需要<color_yellow>持续专注来维持</color>，若<color_yellow>专注中断</color>则可能<color_red>失效</color>。维持此异能需要比平时更高的<color_yellow>专注度。

“完美律动”无法与“飓风之击”<color_red>同时激活</color>。

messages.msgid:
You can now strike so quickly that you don't even seem to move at all.  Before an opponent can even finish blinking, you can strike them multiple times, executing your final blow before they feel the pain of the first.  Moving while using Hurricane Blows will disrupt your concentration, ending the effect.

Hurricane Blows <color_red>cannot be active</color> with Perfected Motion.
translations:
你攻击快如幻影，似乎根本看不到你抬手。在对手一个眨眼之间你就能发动数次攻击，在其刚开始察觉就打出了最后一击。移动会打断暴风连击的专注并终止效果。

暴风连击 与  极速行动 <color_red>不能共存</color>.

messages.msgid: The world around you slows down to a stop.
translations: 你周围的世界慢得像几乎停滞。

messages.msgid:
All of your senses are heightened, allowing you to see further and hear better, and at higher levels even see in murky water or use minor vibrations and small sounds to determine moving creatures nearby.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
你所有的感官都得到了强化，让你视距更远，听力更敏锐。等级提升后，你甚至能在浑水中视物，或通过微小的震动和声响来感知附近移动的生物。

此异能需要<color_yellow>持续专注来维持</color>，若<color_yellow>专注中断</color>则可能<color_red>失效</color>。

messages.msgid:
Your powers make words fairly leap off the page directly into your mind, allowing you to read much faster and better absorb what you read.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.
translations:
你的灵能让你能够高速阅读。书上的文字似乎在不停飞出，直接映入你的脑海，你得以读的更快并且记得更牢。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。<color_red>进入战斗失效</color>。

messages.msgid:
You can sense the presence of the things that wish to do you harm.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
你可以感觉到危险敌人的存在。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid:
You are able to sense your surroundings in areas of low light, and you can even "see" in pitch darkness.  Strictly speaking, this is not vision, and you cannot discern fine details or read.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
你能够在光线昏暗的区域感知周遭环境，甚至能在伸手不见五指的黑暗中“视物”。严格来说，这并非真正的视觉，因此你无法辨认精细的细节或进行阅读。

此异能需要<color_yellow>持续专注来维持</color>，若<color_yellow>专注中断</color>则可能<color_red>失效</color>。

messages.msgid: Your powers let you pinpoint exactly where your enemies are weak.
translations: 你的灵能可以让你准确地定位你的敌人的弱点。

messages.msgid: The vulnerabilities of your enemy are revealed.
translations: 敌人身上的弱点变得显而易见。

messages.msgid:
You can see people's emotions and physical state as a hazy swirl of color around their body.  This makes it much easier to get them to do what you want.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.
translations:
你隐隐约约看到彩色漩涡环绕人们周围，暗示他们的情绪和精神状态。这使你在交流谈判中处于上风。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。<color_red>进入战斗失效</color>。

messages.msgid: You can open your tenses to the tell-tale glow of radiation.
translations: 你可以打开你的神经来感受辐射的光芒。

messages.msgid:
With your enhanced senses, you can increase the effective range and accuracy of your ranged attacks.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
运用你被灵能增强了的感官，你可以增加远程攻击的射程与精度。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid: The classic example of a clairsentient's powers, you can see through walls and reveal everything nearby.
translations: 这是超感者的经典灵能，你可以透过墙壁看到周围的一切。

messages.msgid:
By gazing just a few moments into the future, you can be wherever your enemies are not attacking.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
你可以稍稍预感短暂的未来，从而更好地躲避敌人的攻击。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid:
Opening yourself up to the immediate future, you can see the best option to take when crafting or working on a task.  However, due to the intensity of the visions you will be <color_red>blind</color> to the outside world while crafting anything.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.
translations:
你彻底投入未来，你能察觉到到制造或工作时应该采取的最佳对策。然而，由于专注于对未来的观察，你在制作时会<color_red>忽视</color>周围的环境。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。<color_red>进入战斗失效</color>。

messages.msgid: Gaze into the future and, taking your enemy's future movements into account, fire at the perfect moment.  This power will only last for a single attack.
translations: 看向未来，将敌人的行动纳入考量，并于最佳时机开火，发射一颗前无古人的精准子弹吧！

messages.msgid: It's time to take the shot.
You can extend your senses over the landscape, becoming aware of every hill, building, and valley within a large area.
translations: 你可以将你的感官延伸到风景中，意识到大范围内的每一座山、每一栋建筑和每一座山谷。

messages.msgid: You close your eyes and concentrate, and you can see the landscape spread out as though you were a bird on the wing.
translations: 随着你闭目凝神，周围世界的鸟瞰视野在你眼前平铺开来。

messages.msgid:
Thanks to your powers, nothing can stop you from seeing the world as it is.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
拜灵能所赐，再也没有什么能够阻挡你看清世界的本来面貌了。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid: After a short period of concentration and meditation, cast your spirit forth from your body, wandering the world disembodied.  You will move at the speed of thought but cannot use further powers or interact with the world while your spirit is wandering.  Follow your silver cord to return back to your body.
translations: 在短暂的专注和冥想之后，将你的灵魂从你的身体中释放出来，以无实体的方式在世界上游荡。你将以思想的速度移动，但当你的灵魂游荡时，你无法使用其他灵能或与世界互动。跟随你的系魂银带回到你的身体。

messages.msgid: Follow the silver cord back to your body.
translations: 跟随系魂银带返回你的身体。

messages.msgid:
Gazing into the near future, you can call out warnings to your followers so they can avoid attacks before they occur.  This will greatly increase their defensive capability, though it will be harder for you to defend yourself.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It requires <color_yellow>even more concentration</color> than usual.
translations:
你可以看到未来，从而在危险到来前指挥你的跟随者。极大的增强他们的防守灵能，但也因为分心让你自己的防御更困难。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。比其寻常灵能需要<color_yellow>更多专注</color>。

messages.msgid: Extend your senses to a supernal degree, perceiving everything within the nearby area.  Every creature, every object, every blade of grass, everything.  <color_red>EVERYTHING</color>.
translations: 将你的感官延伸到一个超凡的程度，感知附近区域内的一切。每一个生物，每一个物体，每一片草叶，每一样东西。<color_red>一切</color>.

messages.msgid: You stop concentrating on your powers.
translations: 你停止了对异能的专注。

messages.msgid:
End your concentration on a specific power.

Channeling this power <color_green>always succeeds</color>.
translations:
结束对某个正在维持的灵能的专注。

引导这种灵能<color_green>总是成功</color>。

messages.msgid: You stop concentrating on one of your powers.
translations: 你不再专注于维持一个正在生效的灵能。

messages.msgid:
Build up a charge in your body, zapping anyone who attempts to attack you.  It will also protect you from EMP attacks.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
在你的体内积聚电荷，电击任何试图攻击你的人。这还能保护你免受电磁脉冲的攻击。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid:
Unleash electrical blasts on those you strike in melee.  It also provides protection against electrical damage.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
在使用武器攻击时附加电击伤害。同时还提供对电击伤害的防护。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。
闪电在你的手指间闪烁！

messages.msgid:
Generate power for battery-powered devices on your person.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
为随身携带的电池驱动设备供电。

此异能需要<color_yellow>持续专注来维持</color>，若<color_yellow>专注中断</color>则可能<color_red>失效</color>。

messages.msgid: Cause an electrical burst in the target's nervous system (or the remains of it), incapacitating them briefly.  It will only work on targets that have, or had, a nervous system.
translations: 在目标的神经系统（或其残骸）中引发一次电能爆发，使其短暂地陷入瘫痪。此能力只对拥有或曾经拥有神经系统的目标生效。

messages.msgid:
With your control over electricity, reduce the strength of the pain signals in your own body.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
运用你掌控电流的灵能，减弱体内的疼痛信号。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid: Launch a bolt of lightning at a nearby target.
translations: 向附近的目标发射一道闪电。

messages.msgid: You unleash a bolt of lightning.

By clamping down on all pain signals you can completely eliminate your ability to feel pain briefly.  This does not eliminate the source of pain, and when the power ends all of the original pain and more will return.

Analgesic Block is <color_red>incompatible</color> with Neuro-Acceleration.
translations:
通过压制疼痛信号，你可以短暂地消除疼痛感，但疼痛的源头依然存在。当压制结束，更多的疼痛会卷土重来。

疼痛阻断与神经加速<color_red>不兼容</color>。

messages.msgid:
You can improve the efficiency of your or an ally's nervous system, allowing for much faster response times.  This also increases the target's ability to retain information.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  Neuro-acceleration is <color_red>incompatible</color> with Analgesic Block.  When used on <color_green>allies</color>, the power has <color_yellow>one-half the normal duration</color>.
translations:
你可以提高自己或盟友的神经系统效率，从而大大加快反应。这也能增强记忆能力。

此项灵能 <color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。疼痛阻断 与 神经加速<color_red>不兼容</color>。对<color_green>盟友</color>使用时，该能力的持续时间是<color_yellow>正常时间的一半</color>。

messages.msgid: Cause a massive power surge within a robot or cyborg, disabling it.
translations: 对机器人或改造人释放强劲电流脉冲，使其瘫痪。

messages.msgid: You channel a surge of power into your target!
translations: 你引导一道电流对目标进行冲击！

messages.msgid: Use your powers to remotely interface with a robot's internal circuitry, allowing you to hack it if you have the skill.
translations: 使用你的灵能远程连接机器人的内部电路，如果你有足够的计算机技能的话，就可以黑进它。

messages.msgid:
Charge the air around you with power, unleashing blasts at anyone nearby.  This power does not discriminate between friend and foe.  It will also protect you from electricity while active.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>
translations:
用能力为你周遭充能，电击任何靠近的生物。这种能力不分敌我。能力激活时，还会保护你免受电击伤害。

此项灵能 <color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid: The air around you hums with power.
translations: 你周围的空气充盈着电能，微微颤动。

messages.msgid: Launch a blast of lightning at a nearby target, causing a secondary explosion at the location.
translations: 在附近引发一道离子闪电，并造成小型的爆炸。

messages.msgid: You unleash an explosive blast of lightning.
translations: 你释放了一道爆炸闪电。

messages.msgid: Manipulate the nervous system of a corpse, causing it to rise and protect you.  This protection will only last a short time.
translations: 操作尸体的神经系统，让它为你而战。仅能持续一小段时间。

messages.msgid: You charge a nearby corpse with lightning.
translations: 你用电流充能了附近的一具尸体。

messages.msgid:
Create a simple patch of light nearby, sufficient to read or perform simple tasks with.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.
translations:
创造一小片光芒，它不是很明亮，但足够阅读或进行其他简单任务。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。<color_red>进入战斗失效</color>。

messages.msgid: Create photons to illuminate an entire area.
translations: 创造光子，并操控其照亮整片区域。

messages.msgid: Your target is outlined in light.
translations: 你的目标被光芒勾勒出了轮廓。

messages.msgid: Interrupt the flow of photons to create an area of darkness.
translations: 截断光线的流动以创造一个黑暗区域。

messages.msgid: As you concentrate, an area nearby is plunged into darkness!
translations: 随着你专注地控制，附近的一个区域陷入黑暗！

messages.msgid:
Manipulate the light around your body, creating shifting illusions, blurring your outline and position, and becoming harder to hit.  An enemy successfully hitting you will pinpoint your location and <color_red>disrupt the power</color>.

his power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
操纵身体周围的光线，制造出不断变化的幻象，模糊你的轮廓与位置，从而让你更难被击中。一旦被敌人成功击中，你的位置就会暴露，此异能也会<color_red>随之中断</color>。

此异能需要<color_yellow>持续专注来维持</color>，若<color_yellow>专注中断</color>则可能<color_red>失效</color>。

messages.msgid: Concentrate photons into a high-energy beam.
You fire a searing beam of light!
translations: 你发射出一道灼热的光束！

messages.msgid:
By blending the light reflecting from you with the light reflecting from nearby surfaces, you can make yourself much harder to spot from a distance.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
通过将自身反射光与附近表面反射光混合，你可以使自己在远处更难被发现。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid:
Create a barrier of light around yourself to protect against radiation and light damage.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
在你周围创建一道光的屏障，以保护免受辐射和光能伤害。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid: Create the illusion of extra arms and wielded items to trick your enemies, forcing them off balance and rendering them open to attack.
translations: 用光线创造出额外的手臂，握持物品与武器，以真真假假的攻击诱使敌人失去平衡，做出错误的防御。

messages.msgid: Light around your arms shimmers and refracts, creating the illusion of multiple arms.
translations: 周围的光线闪烁和折射，塑造出多只手臂的幻象。

messages.msgid:
Hide your true form behind unassuming illusions, preventing baseline humans from reacting poorly to your presence if you are mutated or a cyborg.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.
translations:
用不起眼的幻象隐藏你真实的形态，防止没见识的普通人类对你的变异肢体或改造部位大惊小怪

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。<color_red>进入战斗失效</color>。

messages.msgid: Form images of yourself to confuse and distract enemies.
translations: 操控幻影汇集成你自己的形象，从而混淆和分散敌人的注意力。

messages.msgid: Identical copies of you suddenly appear!
translations: 一个与你一模一样的幻象突然显现！

messages.msgid:
Attune your senses to radio waves, allowing you to listen to transmissions and send them yourself.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.
translations:
调整你的感官以接收无线电波，使你能够侦听或发送信息。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。<color_red>进入战斗失效</color>。

messages.msgid: Use a focused emission of high-power radiation to eliminating microorganisms in food and allowing it to last much longer before rotting.  This power is <color_red>extremely taxing</color>.
translations: 通过集中的高能辐射束消灭食物中的微生物，使其保质期大大延长。此异能的<color_red>消耗极大</color>。

messages.msgid: Unleash a localized burst of electromagnetic radiation, overloading any electronic sensory equipment in the area.
translations: 释放一次局部的电磁辐射脉冲，使区域内所有的电子传感设备超载。

messages.msgid:
Refract light around yourself to become invisible.  Moving too quickly has a chance to disrupt the effect, and attacking in melee will invariably do so.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
折射你周围的光线来使你隐身。如果能力不够熟练，移动时有概率使隐身失效；近战攻击也会导致隐身失效。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid: Create a destructive flash of light in a line, damaging all targets caught in the beam.
translations: 创造一道线性的毁灭闪光，对光束路径上的所有目标造成伤害。

messages.msgid: You fire a searing wave of light!
translations: 你释放出一道灼热的光波！

messages.msgid:
You can emit so much light that anyone trying to attack you risks being blinded.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
你可以释放出耀眼的光芒，任何试图攻击你的人都有被致盲的风险。

此异能需要<color_yellow>持续专注来维持</color>，若<color_yellow>专注中断</color>则可能<color_red>失效</color>。

messages.msgid: Concentrate a massive amount of light into a single target, causing it to disintegrate.
translations: 将大量光线集中到一个单一目标上，将其瓦解。

messages.msgid: You focus a pointpoint burst of light on your target!
translations: 你将瓦解光束聚焦在你的目标上！

messages.msgid:
Create a myriad of illusions around yourself to mislead and confuse your enemies.  The illusions will explode into blinding flashes if damaged.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It requires <color_yellow>even more concentration</color> than usual.  Concentration will <color_green>automatically end</color> if all illusions are destroyed.
translations:
在周身创造出无数幻象，用以误导和迷惑敌人。这些幻象一旦受损便会爆炸，并发出致盲的闪光。

此异能需要<color_yellow>持续专注来维持</color>，若<color_yellow>专注中断</color>则可能<color_red>失效</color>。维持此异能需要比平时更高的<color_yellow>专注度</color>。当所有幻象都被摧毁时，专注会<color_green>自动结束</color>。

messages.msgid: Cause a burst of flames at the target location.
translations: 在目标位置引发一场大火。

messages.msgid: By strongly exciting the air at a particular point, you produce a burst of light.
translations: 通过在某一特定点强烈激发空气，你就会产生一束光。

messages.msgid: Using an extremely focused application of pyrokinesis, sear a wound shut to stop the bleeding.  This is liable to be painful and is almost certainly likely to just cause more damage if you don't have any medical knowledge.  If the bleeding is too strong, cauterization will be ineffective, and there is a <color_red>chance of infection</color> whether you are successful or not.
translations: 一项功能细分的焰动者能力，将伤口烧焦以止血。这可能会很痛苦，如果你没有医学知识，几乎肯定会造成更多的伤害。如果出血过多，烧灼将无效，并且无论你是否成功，都有<color_red>感染几率</color>。

messages.msgid:
Call up flames over your outstretched hand.  You can use them to heat up food, boil water, start fires, or anything else fire can accomplish.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.
translations:
伸出手并召唤火焰。你可以用它们来加热食物、煮水、点火，或者完成任何火焰能够做到的事情。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。<color_red>进入战斗失效</color>。

messages.msgid: As you can create fire, you can also extinguish it.
translations: 既然你可以生火，你也可以扑灭它。
你手一挥，熄灭掉了火焰。

messages.msgid:
Control the temperature of the nearby air, warming you and protecting you against flames.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
控制附近空气的温度，保持温暖并使你免受火焰伤害。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid: Spray fire in a cone in front of you.
translations: 在你面前的一个锥形区里喷火。

messages.msgid: You hurl a spray of flames.

Concentrate heat into a thin, searing beam capable of cutting through solid metal or welding it together.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.
translations:
将火焰汇聚成一道灼热的光束，其温度足以切割金属或将其重新焊接在一起。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。<color_red>进入战斗失效</color>。

messages.msgid: Heat the air nearby and maintain it, taking off the chill or turning winter to warm summer.
translations: 加热附近的空气并保持它，消除寒冷或把冬天变成温暖的夏天。

messages.msgid:
Surround yourself with a cloud of flames, damaging anyone in melee combat with you.  The flames also produce light.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
将你包裹在一团火焰中，反击任何试图近战攻击你的人。同时火焰还能提供照明。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid:
Your power over fire is such that you can now step directly into raging flames and walk through them unharmed, feeling no more than a pleasant warmth.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
你对火的掌控力已经到了可以直接踏入熊熊烈焰中并毫发无伤地穿行其中，只感到愉悦的温暖。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid: Create an expanding fireball that catches multiple targets in its wake.
translations: 创造一个不断膨胀的火球，在其尾流中捕捉到多个目标。

messages.msgid: You call forth a raging inferno!
translations: 你召唤狂怒的炼狱之焰！

messages.msgid: Send forth raging flames and turn the ground around you into an inferno.  You will be <color_yellow>briefly</color> immune to the aftereffects of your own power as well.
translations: 引发狂暴的烈焰，将周围彻底转为火海。你会<color_yellow>暂时</color>免疫烈焰引起的一系列副作用。

messages.msgid: The ground around you explodes in flames!
translations: 你周围的地面充斥着暴烈的火焰！

messages.msgid: Concentrate the entirety of your power into a single white-hot point, searing your target with the heat of a volcano.
translations: 将所有的烈焰集中同一点呈现出炽白的颜色，用这火山般的热量烧灼你的目标。

messages.msgid: You focus all of your power onto a single point!
translations: 你将所有的烈焰灵能集中在一个点上！

messages.msgid: Using a focused burst of telekinesis, slam two objects together, or an object into the ground, or simply hit the ground with your powers, causing a loud noise.
translations: 使用集中的念动爆破力，将两个物体撞击在一起，或者将一个物体撞向地面，或者只是将自身的灵能撞击地面，引发巨大的噪音。

messages.msgid: You lash out at the ground with your powers.
translations: 你使用灵能猛烈敲打大地。

messages.msgid: Slam something to the ground with a burst of telekinetic force, doing a small amount of damage and downing them.
translations: 操控念动力使某物猛烈地摔到地上，造成少量伤害和击倒。

messages.msgid: Your target is knocked to the ground.
Counteract the pull of gravity with telekinetic force, greatly reducing or even eliminating damage from falling and becoming much more buoyant.
translations: 用心灵能力抵消重力的拉扯，极大地减少甚至消除坠落造成的损害，并变得更加轻快。

messages.msgid:
Lift yourself enough to counteract your mass, allowing the surface tension of liquids to support you, enabling you to walk on water.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It requires <color_yellow>even more concentration</color> than usual.
translations:
通过抬升自身来抵消体重，从而让液体的表面张力足以支撑你，使你能够行走于水面之上。

此异能需要<color_yellow>持续专注来维持</color>，若<color_yellow>专注中断</color>则可能<color_red>失效</color>。维持此异能需要比平时更高的<color_yellow>专注度</color>。

messages.msgid:
Hover a single object next to you, freeing your hands for other tasks and making it easy to access.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
将一个物体悬停在你旁边，供你轻松取用或腾出双手执行其他任务。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid:
Focus your powers to allow you to move much heavier objects and smash through walls.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.
translations:
集中提高你的灵能，让你能够移动更重的物体或砸破墙壁。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。<color_red>进入战斗失效</color>。

messages.msgid:
Focus your powers to raise a vehicle just enough to change a tire or perform repairs.  As your powers increase, you will be able to lift heavier vehicles.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.
translations:
集中你的灵能，将车辆抬起一些高度，足以更换轮胎或进行修理了。随着你的灵能增加，你将能够举起更重的车辆。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。<color_red>进入战斗失效</color>。

messages.msgid:
Create a telekinetic barrier around yourself to protect you from damage.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
创建一个念动屏障，保护自己免受伤害。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid: A burst of telekinetic force shatters the terrain at the target location, as well as anything caught inside.
translations: 一股瞬动力量的爆发粉碎了目标位置的地形，以及任何目标位置的物品。
你使用灵能无差别地轰击目标位置！

messages.msgid:
Use your telekinesis and lift yourself up, defying gravity.  While not true flight, you can cross open air and descend safely.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.  It requires <color_yellow>even more concentration</color> than usual.
translations:
运用念力托举自身，对抗重力的束缚。这并非真正的飞行，但足以让你跨越空域并安全降落。

此异能需要<color_yellow>持续专注来维持</color>，若<color_yellow>专注中断</color>则可能<color_red>失效</color>。一旦进入战斗，此效果便会<color_red>取消</color>。维持此异能需要比平时更高的<color_yellow>专注度</color>。

messages.msgid: Telekinesis on a grand scale, this power allows you to move truly enormous amounts of weight, hurling a human-sized target at lethal speeds or picking up and throwing something monstrously large.  The amount of weight you can move is dependent on the power level.
translations: 范围及强度更大的念动，这种灵能可以让你移动非常重的物品，并以足以致命的速度投掷出接近人类体型的目标，或者捡起并投掷巨大的物品。你可以移动的重量取决于灵能水平。

messages.msgid: Create a shield impenetrable to physical damage around yourself.  It will <color_yellow>only last a few moments</color>.  You will be <color_red>unable to move</color> while the power is in effect.
translations: 在周围生成一个物理伤害无法穿透的盾牌。只能维持<color_yellow>极短时间</color>并且你在持续期间<color_red>无法移动</color>。

messages.msgid: The air around you becomes as hard as adamant.
translations: 周围的空气在灵能引导下变得坚不可摧。

messages.msgid: Seize the nearby earth with your powers and *wrench* it, toppling buildings and knocking everyone nearby off their feet.
translations: 用灵能操纵附近的大地，将其*扭曲*，推倒建筑物，击倒附近的所有人。
你感觉到脚下的大地在震动！

messages.msgid:
Focus your own mind into a trance state, increasing learning speed.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color>.
translations:
将自己的思维调整到一种近似于催眠的状态中，提高学习速度。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。<color_red>进入战斗失效</color>。

messages.msgid:
You can protect your mind from the dangers of the post-Cataclysmic world.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
你可以保护自己的思维免受后灾变世界的危险。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid: Hypnotize a target, causing them to stand in a trance or wander around in a small area.  Any damage taken will snap the target out of their trance.  Some targets are more resistant to mesmerism than others.
translations: 催眠一个目标，使其陷入恍惚状态，或是在一小片区域内徘徊。任何伤害都会使其从恍惚中惊醒。部分目标对迷惑术的抗性更强。

messages.msgid:
With the ability to edit others' thoughts comes the ability to edit your own, removing negative moods to a degree.  You have also learned to do this more subtly on others, calming their anger or assuaging their fears.

When used on yourself, this power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
能修改他人的思想自然也能修改自己的思想，这使你得以在一定程度上消除负面情绪。同时，你也学会了在别人身上更巧妙地做到这一点，平息他们的愤怒或缓解他们的恐惧。

将此项灵能施加到自身时，<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid: Short-circuit and overwhelm a target's brain, causing extreme damage or death.
translations: 短路并超载目标的大脑，造成极大的伤害甚至死亡。

messages.msgid: Take control of an animal's mind, forcing it to obey you.  This power will not work on insects, spiders, or similar beings.
translations: 控制动物的思维，强迫它服从你。这种灵能对昆虫、蜘蛛等生物无效。
你引发目标最原始的恐惧。

messages.msgid:
Use a light touch on others' minds to hide your presence.  You will be invisible to the target(s) while the power is in effect.

This power is <color_red>canceled by engaging in combat</color> with your target.
translations:
以难以察觉的方式影响他人的思维，从心理上隐藏自己的存在。当灵能生效时，目标将不能看见你。

此项灵能<color_red>进入战斗失效</color>。

messages.msgid: You hide your presence from your enemies.
translations: 你隐藏你的存在，不让敌人发现。

messages.msgid: Emit an uncontrolled psychic scream, attacking the mind of anyone nearby.  This power does not distinguish between friend and foe.
translations: 发出一种不受控制的心灵尖叫，攻击附近任何人的思想。这种灵能不区分朋友和敌人。

messages.msgid: You unleash a mind-piercing psionic shriek!
translations: 你释放出一声直达心理的刺耳灵能尖叫！

messages.msgid: Perform mental surgery on an animal, making it friendly to you for a much longer duration.  The animal must already be friendly, either naturally or through powers such as Beastmastery, in order to be tamed.
translations: 对动物进行意识改造，使其长时间将你视为朋友。动物必须已经成为同伴。可以是正常驯服，也可以通过其他灵能控制得来。

messages.msgid: The animal sniffs at your palm.
translations: 动物凑过来闻了闻你的手掌。

messages.msgid: Seize control of the target's mind, forcing them to do your bidding.
translations: 控制目标的思想，迫使他们听从你的命令。

messages.msgid: You take control of your target's mind!

Forge an unconscious telepathic network between you and nearby allies, allowing you all to send and receive information about nearby dangers and react more quickly in combat.  The network requires at least one ally nearby to be effective.
translations: 在你和附近的盟友之间构筑一个潜意识的心灵网络，让你们能够收发关于周遭危险的情报，从而在战斗中更快地作出反应。此网络至少需要一名盟友在附近才能生效。

messages.msgid:
Step briefly into the void between dimensions and emerge at a random nearby location.

The power <color_red>will fail</color> if the volume of your carried gear is too great.
translations:
短暂步入维度夹缝中的虚空，并随机出现在附近某处。

若携带装备的体积过大，此能力将会<color_red>失效</color>。

messages.msgid: Manipulate space to increase relative distance around the target, reducing their speed.
translations: 操纵空间来增加目标周围的相对距离，降低他们的速度。

messages.msgid: You warp the space around your enemies!
translations: 你扭曲了敌人周围的空间！

messages.msgid: By stepping for a moment into the void between dimensions, you can bypass a wall or walk from the ground to the roof of a house.
translations: 通过短暂穿行于维度之间的空隙，你可以穿透墙壁或从地面穿行至屋顶。

messages.msgid:
Rather than teleporting yourself, you could teleport an item you're holding somewhere nearby without having to follow it to its destination.

Items that are <color_yellow>too large</color> cannot be apported.
translations:
你可以将你持有的物品传送到附近的某个地方，而无需亲自搬运。

<color_yellow>太大</color>的物品无法被传送

messages.msgid:
By warping space to shorten distances, you can make each of your movements carry you much further.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
通过折叠空间来缩短距离，你的每一步都能你走得更远。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。
你踏出的每一步似乎都在让距离凭空消失。

messages.msgid: Entangle yourself with your target's position and, with a twist, swap places with them.
translations: 把你自己和你目标的位置纠缠在一起，扭转一下，和他们交换位置。

messages.msgid: There is a moment of darkness and terrible cold, and you are somewhere else, and so is your target.
translations: 随着短暂的黑暗和令人毛骨悚然的寒冷，你和目标的位置都交换了。

messages.msgid: With a touch, you can send your target through the void to re-emerge somewhere nearby, further away from you.  Targets that are <color_yellow>too large</color> cannot be displaced.
translations: 只需轻轻一触，你便能将目标送入虚空，让他们重新出现在附近一个离你更远的位置。<color_yellow>体型过大</color>的目标无法被置换。

messages.msgid:
Maintain a field of unstable space around you, allowing you to effortlessly teleport enemies that strike you further away.  Unfortunately, their attacks will still hurt you as normal.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
在你的周围维持一个不稳定的空间场，让你能毫不费力地将攻击你的敌人传送到远处。不幸的是，他们的攻击仍然会像往常一样伤害你。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid: The actual teleport effect of reactive displacement.  Having this spell is a bug.
Affect the fabric of space, changing relative distance around a point so that everything moving within finds themselves moving towards it.
translations: 影响空间结构，改变范围内的所有东西相对某点的距离，无论怎么移动，最终都在向中心点靠近。

messages.msgid: The air around your enemies shimmers as their forward motion carries them rapidly towards each other.
translations: 敌人周围的空气随着他们移动不断闪烁，任何挣扎都只是让他们随漩涡移动得更快。

messages.msgid: Transport items in your hands through the Nether to an attuned location.
translations: 通过虚空将手中的物品传送至一个已同步的地点。

messages.msgid:
By warping space as you attack, you can allow your melee attacks to reach much further than normal.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
攻击时扭曲空间，可以让你的近战攻击范围远超寻常。

此能力需要<color_yellow>专注来维持</color>，若专注<color_yellow>被打断</color>则可能会<color_red>失效</color>。

messages.msgid: By moving slightly into the void between dimensions, you can exist in a state that allows effortless travel through obstacles.
translations: 只要稍微涉足维度之间的空隙，你就能处于一种可以毫不费力地穿越障碍的状态。

messages.msgid:
Skating along the void between dimensions, move to a specific place nearby.

The power <color_red>will fail</color> if the volume of your carried gear is too great.
translations:
滑行于维度夹缝中的虚空，移动到附近指定的地点。

若携带装备的体积过大，此能力将会<color_red>失效</color>。

messages.msgid: Teleport the target through the nether to some other dimension.  They are technically not dead, but they are no longer your concern.  Oubliette will occasionally fail when used against very powerful enemies, or succeed but cause damage to the teleporter.
translations: 通过异界将目标传送到其他维度。他们并不会直接因此死亡，但也不能再威胁到你了。传送非常强大敌人时，异界监牢可能会失效，就算成功也会对施法者造成伤害。

messages.msgid:
Start concentrating on your current location, allowing you to return here at will with the [Ψ]Loci Technique power.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
开始专注于记录能当前的位置，以便于通过施展“[Ψ]锚点回归”来回到锚点。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid: Transport yourself through the nether to your established loci location.  You must currently be concentrating on your [Ψ]Loci Establishment (C) for this to function.
translations: 通过异界将自己传送到设立好的锚点。传送前必须先使用[Ψ]锚点设立(C)与目的地同调。

messages.msgid:
Transport yourself through the Nether to an attuned location.  You must attune yourself to the place you wish to travel to.

The power <color_red>will fail</color> if the volume of your carried gear is too great.
translations:
通过虚空将自己传送至一个已同步的地点。你必须先与希望前往的地点进行同步。

若携带装备的体积过大，此能力将会<color_red>失效</color>。

messages.msgid: Transport yourself and every adjacent creature to a chosen location.  You must have already attuned an area with [Ψ]Gateway.
translations: 将自己和所有邻近的生物传送至指定地点。你必须已使用[Ψ]空间传送同步过一个区域。

messages.msgid: The spell that actually teleports the adjacent targets.  Should only be casted via teleport_gateway_other's EOC.
The spell that actually teleports the player.  Should only be casted via teleport_gateway_other's EOC.

Open a brief passage to the Nether using yourself or an enemy as an anchor and allow one (or more) of its inhabitants to come through.  You have no control over what finds the doorway and no ability to command it when it arrives.

Remember that some denizens of the Nether die instantly in sunlight.
translations:
利用你自己或敌人作为相位锚，短暂开启一条通往异界的通道，并使一个（或多个）异界生物通过。你无法控制找到传送门的生物，也无法在它抵达主位面后指挥它。

记住，有些异界生物在阳光下会立即死亡。

messages.msgid:
Through constant contraction and expansion of nearby space, as well as near-constant micro-teleports less than decimeter in distance, you can increase the effective momentum behind your strikes, make your exact position nearly impossible to determine, and your blows nearly impossible to stop.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It requires <color_yellow>even more concentration</color> than usual.
translations:
通过不断收缩和扩张附近的空间，并持续进行距离不足一分米的微型传送，你能够增加攻击的有效动能，让你的确切位置几乎无法被锁定，攻势也几乎无法被阻挡。

此能力需要<color_yellow>专注来维持</color>，若专注<color_yellow>被打断</color>则可能会<color_red>失效</color>。它比平时需要更强的<color_yellow>专注力</color>。

messages.msgid: Make your own contribution to the Cataclysm by opening a rift in reality, allowing all manners of netherium creatures access to Earth.  The rift is temporary…hopefully.
translations: 为这场末日浩劫“添砖加瓦”吧——在现实中撕开一道裂隙，放任形形色色的虚质生物涌入地球。这道裂隙只是暂时的…但愿如此。

messages.msgid:
Your powers can keep you in the bloom of health.  This can also stop or prevent an asthma attack.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  Healthy Glow <color_red>cannot be active</color> with Leucocyte Acculumation
translations:
你的异能可使你永葆康健，这也能中止或预防哮喘发作。

此异能<color_yellow>需要集中精神</color>来维持，若精神<color_yellow>被打断</color>则可能会<color_red>失效</color>。治愈光辉无法与集中再生同时<color_red>激活。

messages.msgid:
By increasing the efficiency of your platelets and speeding their movement, you can slow your rate of bleeding and even prevent it before it starts.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
通过提高血小板的效率和加速其流动，你可以减缓流血的速度，甚至在出血之前就能预防流血。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid: You concentrate on your injuries, and they close and the blood flow stops.
translations: 你专注于你的伤口，让它们愈合、停止流血。

messages.msgid: You summon up the energy to close your wounds!
translations: 你操控灵能来使伤口愈合。

messages.msgid:
By rerouting blood and stem cells from more lightly damaged areas, you can speed the healing of your most grievous wounds at the cost of lessened healing elsewhere.  You may also use this to control an asthma attack.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  Leucocyte Acculumation <color_red>cannot be active</color> with Healthy Glow
translations:
通过将轻伤区域的血液和干细胞转移至他处，你可以加速修复最严重的创伤，但代价是其他部位的愈合速度会减缓。你也可以用它来控制哮喘发作。

此异能<color_yellow>需要集中精神</color>来维持，若精神<color_yellow>被打断</color>则可能会<color_red>失效</color>。“集中再生”无法与“治愈光辉”<color_red>同时激活</color>。

messages.msgid: With but a touch you can cause your target to begin deteriorating slowly.  This is most effective on targets with preternatural means of healing but has some effect on anyone.
translations: 只要轻轻一碰，你的目标就会开始慢慢衰弱。这对拥有超自然治愈能力的目标效果显著，但对正常人也有效果。

messages.msgid: You touch your target and leave an angry red weal behind.
translations: 你触摸你的目标，留下一道醒目的红肿印记。

messages.msgid: You can apply your Healthy Glow power to a follower or ally.  This can stop an asthma attack.
translations: 你可以将治愈光辉灵能施加在一个追随者或盟友身上。这也可以阻止哮喘发作。

messages.msgid: Your touch your target and they seem to perk up.
translations: 你触摸目标，使他们生机焕发。

messages.msgid: When poisoned, you can isolate the poison and move it to your sweat glands where you will harmlessly sweat it out.  While doing so, your flesh will be toxic to any creatures that take a bite.
translations: 你在中毒后可以将毒素隔离并移动到汗腺中，然后随着汗液无害地排出体外。此时，任何咬你的生物也会发现你体表带毒。

messages.msgid: In lieu of sleep, you can meditate.  As long as you maintain your meditations, you will rarely need to spend a night sleeping.
translations: 你可以用冥想来代替睡眠。只要你保持冥想，你就很少再需要花一夜的时间睡觉了。

messages.msgid:
Kick your immune system into overdrive in order to overcome any illnesses you may be suffering from.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
将你的免疫系统加速，以对抗你可能正在遭受的任何疾病。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid: Before you could stop your bleeding with but a thought.  Now, you can treat infected wounds with your powers as well.
translations: 之前你用一个念头就能止血。现在，你可以用你的灵能对伤口消毒或治疗感染。

messages.msgid: You concentrate on the injuries, and the itching eases.
translations: 你专注于伤口，瘙痒感逐渐消退了。

messages.msgid: Enter a trance state and heal your injuries many times faster than they would heal naturally.
translations: 进入一种恍惚的状态，以数倍于自然恢复的速度治愈你的伤口。

messages.msgid: With an inverse of vitakinesis's healing powers, you randomly tear flesh and cut blood vessels, causing significant damage in your target.
translations: 疗愈者灵能的反向应用，你随机撕裂肌肉、切断血管，对目标造成显著的伤害。

messages.msgid: You touch your target and wounds open on their flesh.
translations: 你触摸你的目标，使他们皮开肉绽。

messages.msgid: Use your powers to isolate and flush radiation from your body.  Depending on your level of contamination, this power may have serious side effects.
translations: 使用你的灵能来隔离和冲洗你体内的辐射。根据你的辐射程度，可能会有严重的副作用。

messages.msgid: You focus your powers on the corruption infusing your flesh.
translations: 你将你的灵能集中在侵蚀你肉体的辐射上。

messages.msgid: You submerge your mind into your bloodstream and remove the impurities you find there.
translations: 你将你的思想浸入你的血液中，并清除你在那里发现的杂质。

messages.msgid: Your power flows through your veins, cleansing your blood.
translations: 你的灵能流过血管，净化着你的血液。

messages.msgid: Enter a deep meditative trance and purge your body of illness, even serious ones like cancer or multiple sclerosis.  It will not cure mutation.  Some illnesses are more difficult to successfully eradicate than others.
translations: 进入深度冥想恍惚状态，清除体内的疾病，甚至是癌症或多发性硬化症等严重疾病。 这不会治愈变异。 有些疾病比其他疾病更难成功根除。

messages.msgid: You attempt to cure your afflictions.

You draw on your body's reserves to speed your healing a hundredfold.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.  It requires <color_yellow>even more concentration</color> than usual.
translations:
你调动身体的潜能，将自愈速度提高百倍。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。比其寻常灵能需要<color_yellow>更多专注</color>。

messages.msgid: You sink your mind the deepest within yourself you can possibly get and enter a meditative trance to rejuvenate lost limbs, one at a time.  Be sure to remove any prosthetics before doing this, it's hard to work around them.
translations: 你将你的思绪沉入自己内心最深处，进入冥想的状态，逐个恢复失去的肢体。在进行此过程之前，请务必移除任何假肢，因为它们会干扰恢复过程。

messages.msgid: You sink your mind deep within your body and enter a trance.
translations: 你将你的思绪深深沉入你的身体中，进入了一种恍惚状态。

messages.msgid: The ultimate expression of a vitakinetic's ability to reverse vital processes, this power induces massive cellular breakdown in the target, causing severe injury, weakness, and possible death.
translations: 作为疗愈者逆转生命进程之力的终极体现，此能力可引发目标体内大规模的细胞崩解，导致其重伤、衰弱，甚至可能死亡。

messages.msgid:
While this power is active, if you suffer potentially fatal damage, your vitakinesis will go into overdrive to keep you alive.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
当这个灵能处于激活状态时，如果你遭受潜在致命伤害，你的疗愈灵能将超负荷运转以维系你的生命。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid: You can maintain your concentration even if outside in winter without a coat or while in combat with a zombie.
translations: 你可以在赤身裸体站在冬天户外的情况下保持专注，或是在与丧尸血拼时保持专注。

messages.msgid: You have an understanding of how biokinesis functions and unlocking new powers is easier for you.
translations: 你对炼体术的运作方式有所了解，解锁新灵能对你来说更容易了。

messages.msgid: You have an understanding of how clairsentience functions and unlocking new powers is easier for you.
translations: 你对超感的运作方式有了解，解锁新灵能对你来说更容易了。

messages.msgid: You have an understanding of how electrokinesis functions and unlocking new powers is easier for you.
translations: 你对电动力学有所了解，解锁新灵能对你来说更容易了。

messages.msgid: You have an understanding of how photokinesis functions and unlocking new powers is easier for you.
translations: 你对控光的原理有一定的了解，解锁新灵能对你来说更容易了。

messages.msgid: You have an understanding of how pyrokinesis functions and unlocking new powers is easier for you.
translations: 你对火焰控制的原理有一定的了解，解锁新灵能对你来说更容易了。

messages.msgid: You have an understanding of how telekinesis functions and unlocking new powers is easier for you.
translations: 你对念力的运作方式有所了解，解锁新灵能对你来说更容易了。

messages.msgid: You have an understanding of how telepathy functions and unlocking new powers is easier for you.
translations: 你对心灵感应的运作原理有所了解，解锁新的灵能对你来说也更加容易。

messages.msgid: You have an understanding of how teleportation functions and unlocking new powers is easier for you.
translations: 你对传送的原理有了解，解锁新灵能对你来说更容易了。

messages.msgid: You have an understanding of how vitakinesis functions and unlocking new powers is easier for you.
translations: 你对疗愈术的运作方式有所了解，解锁新灵能对你来说更容易了。

messages.msgid: You are capable of using psi and can undertake crafts that require active psionic channeling.
translations: 你能够使用灵能，并可制作需要主动引导灵能的物品。

messages.msgid: You are a biokinetic and can undertake crafts that require biokinesis to create.
translations: 你是一名炼体者，能够制作需要运用炼体能力的物品。

messages.msgid: You are a pyrokinetic and can undertake crafts that require pyrokinesis to create.
translations: 你是一位焰动者，能够从事需要焰动灵能才能完成的制造。

messages.msgid: You are a teleporter and can undertake crafts that require teleportation to create.
translations: 作为一名传送者，你可以进行需要传送能力才能完成的制作。

messages.msgid: You are a vitakinetic and can undertake crafts that require vitakinesis to create.
translations: 作为一名疗愈者，你可以运用疗愈之力来完成特定的制作。

messages.msgid: You know the basics of focusing your powers into material items.
translations: 对于将你的力量注入物质实体，你已经知道基础。

messages.msgid: You are adept at the focused concentration and elaborate mental exercises required to practice more esoteric psionic abilities.
translations: 你擅长集中注意力和练习更深奥灵能所需的复杂精神锻炼。

messages.msgid: You are familiar with how psionic power flows between dimensions and can manipulate that flow.
translations: 你熟练掌握了灵能在维度之间运动的方式，并且可以操纵灵能流动。

messages.msgid: You are proficient in preventing stray substances or thoughts from contaminating your work.
translations: 你在防止杂质或思绪污染你的工作方面很专长。

messages.msgid: You have mastered using psionics to affect the form of living beings.
translations: 你已经掌握了使用灵能来影响生物形态的技巧。

messages.msgid: You know the basics of creating items using matrix crystals that don't require you to personally to use psi in the crafting process.
translations: 你已掌握运用矩阵晶体制造物品的基础知识，此制作过程无需你亲自使用灵能。

messages.msgid: Itzcuāuhtli Corps Liaison, Yohualli Ehēcatl Division
translations: 黑曜之鹰军团联络官，夜风师

messages.msgid: You make a habit of clearing your thoughts and finding your center, even amidst the chaos of the world.
translations: 即使在这个混乱的世界中，你也养成了清除杂念、找回本心的习惯。

messages.msgid: You spent many years traveling through the world, becoming wise and learned.  Normally you can answer any question, but even you are not quite sure what to do about the ravenous undead.
translations: 你用了很多年来游历世界，以增长见识变得聪慧。通常，你可以给出任何的问题的答案，但是即便是你也不知道该如何面对这些饥饿的不死生物。

messages.msgid: Over long years of self-imposed exile in the wilderness, you have come to an understanding with Mother Nature.  The world as they knew it might have ended for your forsaken species, but you can hardly tell the difference.
translations: 在野外历经长年的自我流放式的生活，你已经和大自然母亲达成了谅解。这个原属于被抛弃的人类的世界可能已经完蛋了，但是对你而言却依如昨日。

messages.msgid: You were dismissed from your position as a parapsychology professor at the local university and started your own business as a paranormal investigator.  Your former colleagues didn't approve of your research, but it looks like it's paying off now.
translations: 你曾任职于当地大学的超心理学教授，却被解雇，随后自立门户，成为一名超自然现象调查员。你过去的同事并不认可你的研究方向，但如今看来，这些研究终于开始显现其价值。

messages.msgid: You never made master, but you did very well in chess competitions before the Cataclysm.  All those hours of staring at the board, trying to keep all the pieces in your mind at once, have left you with a great ability to focus your attention on a single problem when you need to.
translations: 你不算是大师，但在大灾变之前的国际象棋比赛中表现得非常出色。你经历的那些努力记忆棋盘位置的时光，使你在处理问题时能很好地集中注意力。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm, many of your weekends were spent either competing in tournaments or studying records of past games, always trying to find the patterns.  All that time has also made you a master of concentrating on a specific subject, despite whatever is going on around you.
translations: 在大灾变之前，你花费了许多时间来参加比赛或者复盘，不断学习其中的规律。这些努力也使你成为了一位象棋大师，擅长专注于你的目标，无论周围发生了什么事。

messages.msgid: You were one of the best of the best, awarded a grandmaster title in your early twenties.  Chess was your passion and your life, and you were good enough at it to make a living competing before the Cataclysm.  You have an almost-inhuman ability to focus on a task and ignore all distractions.
translations: 你是顶尖的象棋选手，在二十多岁时获得了国际象棋大师的称号，国际象棋是你的爱好与生活。大灾变之前，你在比赛中表现出色，足以维持生计。你有一种几乎超人的能力，可以专注于任务并忽略一切干扰。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You feel in better shape than you ever have in your life, like you could run ten miles and climb a mountain and then wake up and do it again.  You'll probably need it.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。你从未感觉像今天这么棒，你可以连着跑十英里、爬上高山，一觉醒来又精力饱满。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You can breathe underwater and twist yourself enough to squeeze through a half-closed window.  You can run five meters in less than a second and shrug off a punch like it's nothing.  You'd almost be worried you were becoming one of those rioters, except you're definitely still sane.  Right?
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。你可以在水下呼吸，并扭转身体挤过半开的窗户。你可以在不到一秒的时间内跑出五米，而且毫不费力的吃下一拳。你几乎会担心自己会成为那些暴徒中的一员，然而你很肯定现在自己依然神志清醒。对吧？

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You can move inhumanly fast, hitting zombies before they even seem to know that you're there.  You can pull out nails with your bare hands and go out in winter without even a shirt and not feel the cold.  You're a new breed, Homo Cataclysmicus, and if anyone is equipped to survive in this new world, it's you.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。你可以以非人的速度飞速移动，在丧尸感知到你之前就击中它们。冬天赤手拔出钉子，甚至不穿衬衫出门也感觉不到寒冷。你现在算是个新人种，“大灾变种人”，如果人类还能在这个新世界中生存的话，那就非你莫属了。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You can read much faster and can see much better in the dark, and even in total darkness you no longer have any hesitation about moving.  At least once you avoided zombies on the other side of a wall that you didn't hear and couldn't see, but you, you just knew they were there.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。你读书速度更快、黑暗视力更强，甚至在完全黑暗中也能轻松行动。有一次你成功避过墙另一边的丧尸，你没听到也没看到，但就知道它们在那。
