messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You can see auras around people that tell you what they're feeling, and you've already used it to avoid someone who was feigning being injured with the hope of stealing your gear.  You can see through walls, and tell where the best place to hit something is to take it down for good.  That last ability will definitely get plenty of use.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。你可以看到人们周围的气场，判断他们的感受。你已经利用它识破了一个假装受伤希望偷走你装备的人。你可以透视墙壁，并且感知到目标的弱点以便将其彻底摧毁。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You can finish books in a few hours and remember almost everything you read, you had to fix a bicycle a few weeks ago and even though you've never tried to do that before in your life, everything you needed to do just…came to you.  What's more, last time the Zs attacked you, you never got a scratch.  Three of them came at you at once and you dodged every attack because you could see what they were going to do before they did it.  If only you could see where you needed to go to be safe.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。你可以在几个小时内完成一本书，并几乎记住你读过的一切，几周前你不得不修理一辆自行车，尽管你以前从未尝试过这样做，但你所需要做的一切都...自然而然地完成了。更重要的是，上次丧尸袭击你时，你一点伤都没有。三个丧尸同时向你袭来，你躲过了每一次攻击，因为你能在他们行动之前看到他们要做什么。只有你自己才知道到去哪里才安全。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  While running down an alleyway to escape a group of rioters, you looked back and realized you were going to get caught and then there was a deafening crash of thunder and your vision went white.  When your hearing and sight came back, the rioters were lying in a heap, some still with smoldering clothes, and you were unscathed.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。当你在一条小巷里逃离一群暴徒即将被抓住时，随着一道震耳欲聋的雷电，你眼前白亮一片。当你的听力和视力恢复时，暴徒们东倒西歪，衣服还冒着烟，而你却毫发无损。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You an hurl lightning bolts from your hands, like some kind of superhero, and your smartphone still has a full charge even though you haven't plugged it in weeks.  Some kind of huge wasp attacked you in the woods and there was a crackle like thunder and it fell to the ground twitching.  You didn't stop to check if it would move again.
translations: 大灾变期间，在肆虐的风暴中发生了某些事，现在的你能够做到一些曾经看似绝无可能之事。你能像超级英雄一样从手中掷出闪电，你的智能手机明明已经几周没有充电，却依然满电。在树林里，一只巨大的黄蜂袭击了你，只听一道雷鸣般的爆裂声，它便抽搐着倒在地上。你没有停下来确认它是否还会动弹。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You managed to drive the entire week the sky broke on a single charge in your car, and while you had to abandon it since then it got you out of the worst of the cities.  Anything that attacks you has to face your lightning and you haven't found anything yet that can withstand it.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。在天空裂开的那一周，你连续开车开了整整一星期，直到抛锚，虽然从那时起你不得不放弃它，但起码让你摆脱了情况最糟糕的城市。任何攻击你的东西都必须面对你的闪电，而你还没有找到任何可以抵挡的东西。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You noticed that light seemed to bend at the will of your thoughts, when you were almost caught by a wandering horde, light slowly dimmed enough for you to hide in the shadows.  You have a sense that there's more to your newfound talents.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。当你快被尸群发现时，你注意到光似乎随着你的思维弯曲，光线慢慢变暗，足够让你隐藏在阴影中。你有预感，你的这项新能力远不止如此。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You can make the air glow and fire lasers from your hands, and even sometimes hear radio signals.  You haven't heard any other survivors out there yet, but you listen for a bit every night, just in case.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。你可以让空气发光，用手射出激光，有时甚至可以听到无线电信号。你还没有听到任何其他幸存者的声音，但你每晚都会听一会儿，以防万一。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  Many times a horde has passed within sight of you and simply never noticed you, and the few times they did, you just created illusions of yourself and all ran different directions.  The few stragglers were easy to sear to ash with focused light.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。尸群无数次从你眼前经过，却根本没有注意到你，而少数被它们注意到的几次，你创造了自己的幻象，然后就从另一个方向逃走了。而少数脱离大部队的怪物则轻易地被激光烧成了灰。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  With just a thought, you can start a fire or make light radiate from the very air.  It's already saved your life once when you burned a zombie to ash while scavenging in a ruined house.  Sure, the house burned down too, but you'll definitely get more control as time goes on, right?
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。只需一个念头，你就可以点燃火焰，或者让光线从空气中辐射出来。在一座废弃的房子里拾荒时，你曾经一次用火将一只丧尸烧成灰烬，这已经救过你一命了。当然，房子也被烧毁了，但随着时间的推移，你肯定会获得更多的控制权，对吧？

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You don't even know how many zombies you've burned at this point, and keeping warm in winter certainly won't be a problem.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。你现在都记不清自己烧死过多少丧尸，冬天保暖当然也不成问题。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You are one with the flames, and they come at your command and obey your every instruction.  Zombies, mutants, aliens, stranger things--no matter what is out there, you will incinerate it and survive.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。你与火焰合而为一，它们听从你的命令，服从你的每一个指示。 丧尸、变种人、外星人、怪兽——无论外面有什么，你都会能烧死它并继续活下去。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You can lift things with your mind.  Mostly just small things, but during the chaos a group of rioters jumped you and you hurled them off of you just by thinking about it.  This will definitely come in handy.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。你能光靠意念举起物体，虽然只能举起小型物品。但有一次面对暴徒的时候，你只靠意念就击飞了它们。迟早会派上用场的。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  Moving things at a distance is child's play.  You can pick up zombies and fling them away from you, shatter doors with a thought, and jump from the fifth story and land with barely a bruise.  Nothing is going to get close to you now.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。远距离移动物体对你而言就是小孩子的游戏。 你可以抬起丧尸并将它们从你身边扔开，用意念破门，从五层楼跳下来，却毫发无伤。现在没有什么能接近你了。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  One ton cars lift off the ground with merely a thought, bullets bounce off the air before they hit you, and you can smash whole groups of zombies to paste in seconds.  You can even fly from rooftop to rooftop, preventing gravity from affecting you by sheer force of will.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。重达一吨的汽车只需一个念头就从地面升起，子弹在击中你之前会在空中反弹，你可以在几秒钟内粉碎整群丧尸。你甚至可以从一个屋顶飞到另一个屋顶，通过纯粹的意念来防止重力影响你。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  The crazies were bad enough during the riots, but once you were stopped by a police officer whose bloodshot eyes told you that he wasn't going to let you off with a warning.  But you could somehow hear his thoughts, a chaotic jumble of rage and hunger and fear, you just…nudged them a little bit, and he wandered off and left you alone.  It doesn't work the same way with the zombies, but you can't have everything.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。暴动里的疯狂已经够糟糕的了，但有一次你被双眼通红的警察拦下，他看起来就不想让你活着离开。你似乎能听到他的思想，混沌的愤怒、饥饿、恐惧，你只是……稍稍把它们挪走，他就浑浑噩噩走开了。这招对丧尸好像不太奏效，但没什么是完美的。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  Sure, the zombies are immune to telepathy, but those rioters aren't and neither are some of the monsters you've run into.  At least once, you managed to warn off another survivor who you knew meant to rob you.  You left him unconscious and without his weapons, and if the zombies got him, well, he shouldn't have messed with you.
translations: 大灾变期间，在肆虐的风暴中发生了一些事情，如今你能做到一些过去看来绝无可能之事。诚然，丧尸对心灵感应免疫，但那些暴徒却并非如此，你曾遭遇的一些怪物也一样。至少有一次，你成功吓退了一名意图抢劫你的幸存者。你让他丢下武器昏迷不醒，而如果他最后落入了丧尸之口，那也只能怪他自己不该来招惹你。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  Controlling human minds is still too hard but at this point, animal minds are child's play.  A while back, some kind of mutated wolf or dog or something jumped you in the forest and after a few seconds, it was wagging its tail and jumping around like a new puppy.  You wish you still had it with you, but it died fighting off some kind of pink crustacean…thing, giving you time to run.  The bravest dog you ever had.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。控制人类的想法仍然太难，但就目前而言，控制动物就像儿戏一样。不久前，某种变异的狼或狗之类的在森林里向你扑来，几秒钟后，它就摇着尾巴跳来跳去，就像一只初生小狗一样。你希望你还带着它，但它在与某种粉红色的甲壳……怪物的战斗中死去，给你争取出了逃跑的时间。你养过的最勇敢的狗。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You were fleeing down a side street when you heard a crash above you.  You looked up and saw something hurtling through the air down toward you, you closed your eyes and wished you were anywhere but where you were, and then… you were.  Indoors, in a house near the street, and you went out the back door and made good your escape.  You're very, very good at escaping now.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。当你沿着一条小街逃离时，你听到了头顶上的一声巨响。你抬头一看，看到有东西从空中冲向你，你闭上眼睛，希望自己不在那里，然后……你就不在那里了。在室内，靠近街道的一座房子里，你走出后门，成功逃脱了。你现在非常擅长逃脱。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You can step through walls, and once you were surrounded by a horde and looked up and a nearby rooftop and… there you were, safe and out of the zombies' line of sight.  The rule of the zombie apocalypse is "keep moving", and you're the best you've ever been at that.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。你可以穿过墙壁，一旦你被尸群包围，只要抬头看向附近的屋顶然后……你就到了那里，安全而且远离丧尸视线。 丧尸末日里的规则是“不停前进”，而你在这方面的能力无出其右。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  No wall or door is a barrier to you and sometimes when you close your eyes you can travel to places you've already been.  Once you were surprised by a bandit and when he leveled his gun at you, you wished he was somewhere else and he just…disappeared.  Nothing can keep you down now.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。任何墙或门对你来说都不成障碍，而当你闭上眼睛时，你可以回到你曾经去过的地方。有一次你被一个强盗埋伏，当他举枪指着你时，你希望他在其他地方，然后他就……消失了。现在没有什么能阻挡你了。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  But teleporting through walls isn't the most impressive part.  You spent a few days in an abandoned basement and on a scavenging trip, one of those rioters surprised you.  Snarling, she had you by the arm and was prepared to smash in your head with a pipe and then you were just…back safe in that basement.  That will definitely come in handy.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。但穿墙传送还不算是最令人印象深刻的部分。 你在一个废弃的地下室呆了几天，在一次拾荒之旅中，其中一个暴徒突然出现。她咆哮着，抓住你的手臂，准备用钢管砸碎你的头，然后你就……安全回到了地下室。迟早会派上用场的。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You broke your leg when you got caught in a riot, and when things got really bad you were positive you were going to die.  But somehow, after only a few days your leg didn't seem to hurt nearly as much anymore.  By the end of the week you could walk on it, and by now it's like nothing ever happened.  It's not going to help you fight the zombies but it'll sure help you recover afterward.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。当你被困在暴乱中时，你的腿骨折了，当情况变得非常糟糕时，你确信自己将会死去。但不知何故，仅仅几天后，你的腿似乎不再那么疼痛了。一周过后，你已经可以走路了，现在就像什么都没有发生过一样。这不会帮助你对抗丧尸，但肯定会帮助你恢复过来。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  Just last week you were looking in an abandoned building and fell through a weak floor.  But you barely bled, and after a few minutes lying there you picked yourself up and managed to run away from the things that came to investigate the noise.  You didn't have enough water to properly clean your wounds but it hasn't seemed to have mattered.  You're already back to normal.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。就在上周，当你在一座废弃的建筑中拾荒时，从一块脆弱的地板上摔了下来。但你几乎没有流血，躺在那里几分钟后，你重新站了起来，并设法逃离了那些前来调查噪音的怪物。你没有足够的水来正确清洁伤口，但这似乎并不重要。你已经恢复如初了。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You've suffered injuries that should have killed you multiple times over by now and recovered in days every time.  You've broken your leg twice, your arm once, drank bad water that had you puking your guts out, nearly been disemboweled by some mutated thing…every single time, your powers kept you going.  Hopefully they'll see you through to the very end of all this.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。到目前为止，你已经多次遭受过本该致命的伤害，但每次都在几天内康复。你的腿断过两次，胳膊断过一次，喝了让你五脏六腑都吐出来的坏水，差点被某种变异的东西开膛破肚……每一次，你的灵能都让你继续前进。希望它能陪你度过这一切。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm you were always surprisingly flexible, and that ability has been greatly heightened after the world ended.  While you are not a fully awakened psion, you have a single trick you can use.  Hopefully it helps you survive.
translations: 大灾变前，你总是出人意料地柔韧。末日降临后，这项天赋更是得到了极大的增强。虽然你并非完全觉醒的灵能者，但你确实掌握了一项小小的伎俩。但愿它能帮你活下去。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm you always had a hidden reserve of power when you needed it, and that ability has been greatly heightened after the world ended.  While you are not a fully awakened psion, you have a single trick you can use.  Hopefully it helps you survive.
translations: 大灾变前，每当你需要时，体内总会涌现出一股隐藏的力量。末日降临后，这项天赋更是得到了极大的增强。虽然你并非完全觉醒的灵能者，但你确实掌握了一项小小的伎俩。但愿它能帮你活下去。

While you are not a fully awakened psion, you have a single trick you can use.  Hopefully it helps you survive.

Before the Cataclysm you always had a sense of when a line was drawing power, and that ability has been greatly heightened after the world ended.  While you are not a fully awakened psion, you have a single trick you can use.  Hopefully it helps you survive.

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm, the few times you got into a fight you could down your opponents with almost no effort, and that ability has been greatly heightened after the world ended.  While you are not a fully awakened psion, you have a single trick you can use.  Hopefully it helps you survive.
translations: 大灾变前，屈指可数的几次打斗中，你总能不费吹灰之力就将对手放倒。末日降临后，这项天赋更是得到了极大的增强。虽然你并非完全觉醒的灵能者，但你确实掌握了一项小小的伎俩。但愿它能帮你活下去。

translations: 大灾变前，你总能轻而易举地穿行于拥挤的人群之中。末日降临后，这项天赋更是得到了极大的增强。虽然你并非完全觉醒的灵能者，但你确实掌握了一项小小的伎俩。但愿它能帮你活下去。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm you never had a single nightmare that you could remember, and that ability has been greatly heightened after the world ended.  While you are not a fully awakened psion, you have a single trick you can use.  Hopefully it helps you survive.
translations: 大灾变前，你从未记得自己做过任何噩梦。末日降临后，这项天赋更是得到了极大的增强。虽然你并非完全觉醒的灵能者，但你确实掌握了一项小小的伎俩。但愿它能帮你活下去。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm you always knew when someone was trying to sneak up on you, and that ability has been greatly heightened after the world ended.  While you are not a fully awakened psion, you have a single trick you can use.  Hopefully it helps you survive.
translations: 大灾变前，你总能察觉到有人想偷袭你。末日降临后，这项天赋更是得到了极大的增强。虽然你并非完全觉醒的灵能者，但你确实掌握了一项小小的伎俩。但愿它能帮你活下去。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm, animals always seemed to like you, and that ability has been greatly heightened after the world ended.  While you are not a fully awakened psion, you have a single trick you can use.  Hopefully it helps you survive.
translations: 大灾变前，动物们似乎总是很亲近你。末日降临后，这项天赋更是得到了极大的增强。虽然你并非完全觉醒的灵能者，但你确实掌握了一项小小的伎俩。但愿它能帮你活下去。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm, people just overlooked you when you didn't want to be seen, and that ability has been greatly heightened after the world ended.  While you are not a fully awakened psion, you have a single trick you can use.  Hopefully it helps you survive.
translations: 大灾变前，当你不希望被注意到时，人们就会自然而然地将你忽略。末日降临后，这项天赋更是得到了极大的增强。虽然你并非完全觉醒的灵能者，但你确实掌握了一项小小的伎俩。但愿它能帮你活下去。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm you just enjoyed good health no matter what you seemed to do, and that ability has been greatly heightened after the world ended.  While you are not a fully awakened psion, you have a single trick you can use.  Hopefully it helps you survive.
translations: 大灾变前，无论你做什么，你似乎总是身体康健。末日降临后，这项天赋更是得到了极大的增强。虽然你并非完全觉醒的灵能者，但你确实掌握了一项小小的伎俩。但愿它能帮你活下去。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm your injuries always seemed to heal pretty quickly, and that ability has been greatly heightened after the world ended.  While you are not a fully awakened psion, you have a single trick you can use.  Hopefully it helps you survive.
translations: 大灾变前，你的伤口似乎总是愈合得特别快。末日降临后，这项天赋更是得到了极大的增强。虽然你并非完全觉醒的灵能者，但你确实掌握了一项小小的伎俩。但愿它能帮你活下去。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm bee stings and poison ivy never bothered you, and that ability has been greatly heightened after the world ended.  While you are not a fully awakened psion, you have a single trick you can use.  Hopefully it helps you survive.
translations: 大灾变前，无论是蜂蜇还是毒藤都奈何不了你。末日降临后，这项天赋更是得到了极大的增强。虽然你并非完全觉醒的灵能者，但你确实掌握了一项小小的伎俩。但愿它能帮你活下去。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm you never really seemed to get sick, and that ability has been greatly heightened after the world ended.  While you are not a fully awakened psion, you have a single trick you can use.  Hopefully it helps you survive.
translations: 大灾变前，你似乎从来没生过什么大病。末日降临后，这项天赋更是得到了极大的增强。虽然你并非完全觉醒的灵能者，但你确实掌握了一项小小的伎俩。但愿它能帮你活下去。

messages.msgid: You survived a portal storm and hid inside while reality broke around you, and when you left to examine the damage you found a strange crystal the storm had left behind.  It was captivating, and you took it with you.  Sometimes, at night, you look into it before you sleep, and you almost feel like something in you is responding to the glow within the crystal.
translations: 你在一场空间风暴中幸存了下来，在躲藏的同时你周围的现实破碎了，当你离开去检查损害情况时，你发现了风暴留下一块奇怪的晶体。它很迷人，你把它带走了。有时，在晚上睡觉前，你会看着它，你几乎感觉到你身体里有什么东西在回应晶体里的光芒。

messages.msgid: You were always good at athletics.  People praised your effort and hard work, but the truth was you barely needed to practice.  It all just came naturally to you, as naturally as breathing.  That kept you safe during the Cataclysm--you outran the dead and worse things that chased you and made it out of the cities, and they're certainly the thing that will keep you going, especially since now, you're stronger and faster than you've ever been.
translations: 你的体育成绩一直很好。 人们称赞你的努力和勤奋，但事实上你几乎不需要练习。 这一切对你来说都是自然而然的，就像呼吸一样自然。 这保证了你在大灾变期间的安全--你跑赢了那些追杀你的死人和更可怕的东西，逃出了城市，它们当然也是你继续前进的动力，尤其是现在，你比以往任何时候都更强壮、更敏捷。

messages.msgid: You knew the world was going to end, but they never listened.  They never listened!  They couldn't see the things that walked among them!  They didn't know what you had seen, what you knew was coming, and where are they now?  In a zombie's stomach or walking with those corpses themselves, but you're still alive.
translations: 你知道世界正在走向终结，但他们从不倾听。 他们从不听 ！他们看不到在他们中间行走的东西！ 他们不知道你看到了什么，你知道即将发生什么，他们现在在哪里？在丧尸的胃里，或者和那些尸体一起走着，但你还活着。

messages.msgid: You followed your parents' wishes and became an engineer, and to your surprise you were extremely good at it.  It was like the electronics you built just spoke to you, like you could see inside the wires and circuits, and then when the sky broke that literally came true.
translations: 你遵循了父母的愿望，成为了一名工程师，令你惊讶的是，你在这方面非常擅长。就像你建造的电子设备在与你交流一样，就像你能够看到电线和电路的内部，然后当天空破碎时，这一切都变成了现实。

messages.msgid: Ever since you were a young kid, you just loved magic.  Growing up you managed to become a professional magician and even performed at a few big shows.  You were practicing a new trick when the Cataclysm hit, when you realized you don't need to practice anymore.  You can just do it, for real.
translations: 自从你还是个小孩的时候，你就喜欢魔术。长大后，你成功成为一名职业魔术师，甚至在几个大型演出中表演过。当大灾变来临时，你正在练习一种新的魔术，突然你意识到你不再需要练习了。你可以真正地做到它。

messages.msgid: Fire always fascinated you.  The fires you set almost got you arrested a few times, but the urge was just too powerful.  It was like they were calling to you, urging you to create them.  And ever since the sky broke, you can create fire with merely a thought.
translations: 火总是让你着迷。你因为纵火被逮捕了好几次。但这种冲动太强烈了。它们似乎在呼唤你，催促你。而自从天空破碎以来，你只需一个念头就能创造火焰。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm, you were 'volunteered' for a top-secret military project.  They never told you what all the injections and EEGs and hours of staring at a quarter on the table were supposed to accomplish, but now that you can move things with your mind you have a pretty good idea what they were aiming at.
translations: 大灾变前，你被“自愿”参加了一个绝密的军事项目。他们从未透露，那些注射剂、脑电图检测，以及让你连续数小时盯着桌上硬币的训练究竟目的何在。但如今既然你能用意念移动物体，大概就知道了他们到底想要什么。

messages.msgid: You did not die in the Cataclysm because on paper, you are already dead.  You assumed a new identity as part of an experimental program designed to produce psychic interrogators.  They told you that you were serving your country, that your gifts would be the key to winning the new Cold War that was surely developing, but they didn't consider the ramifications of having a telepath on the base.  You knew right away that things were much worse than the brass was telling you, and your gifts let you "persuade" the guards to let you out even in the face of the lockdown.  You had thought to go somewhere else, to get away from New England, but the end came much faster than even you thought it would.
translations: 你没有在大灾变中死去，因为在档案记录上，你早已是个死人。你获得了一个新身份，作为旨在培养灵能审讯员的实验计划的一员。他们告诉你，你是在为国效力，你的天赋将是赢得新一轮冷战的关键。但他们并未考虑到，基地里有一位传心者会带来怎样的后果。你立刻就意识到，情况远比高层透露的要糟，而你的天赋让你即便是在全面封锁之下，也能“说服”守卫放你出去。你曾想过去往别处，远离新英格兰，但末日的降临比你预想的还要快得多。

messages.msgid: The last thing you remember was inputting the jump coordinates into the tliltilhuicaātl drive and reaching out to initiate the transfer when there was a power surge and it felt like the entire ship was turning inside out.  Now, you have no idea where you are.
translations: 你所记得的最后一件事是将跃迁坐标输入进“特里尔维卡特尔”引擎之中，在伸手启动跃迁时，一道灵能波动袭来，感觉整艘船都天翻地覆。 现在，你不知道你在哪里。

messages.msgid: People came to you for diseases that modern medicine told them were incurable, and you made them well.  At least, they felt well, and that was what mattered.  Now the dead walk and do not respond to your exhortations, but your healing works better on yourself than it ever has on anyone else.
translations: 人们来找你治疗现代医学认为无法治愈的疾病，而你使他们康复了。至少，他们感觉良好，这才是最重要的。现在死者行走，不回应你的劝告，但你的治疗在你自己身上比在任何其他人身上都要有效。

messages.msgid: You were on guard duty when the ship was preparing to enter Tliltilhuicaātl and had just braced for the jump when something went wrong.  The ship seemed like it was turning inside out, then you seemed like you were turning inside out, and suddenly you were planetside in the ruins of a dying world.  You've served the Excān Tlahtōlōyān on a dozen worlds, taken five captives, and even have clearance for contact with huecachane civilizations, but none of that has prepared you for the Cataclysm
translations: 飞船正欲驶入黑水之渊，你正在当值守卫。就在你为跃迁稳住身形之际，异变陡生。先是飞船，再是你本人，都仿佛被由内而外地翻转过来。下一刻，你已置身于一颗垂死行星的废墟之上。你曾辗转十余个世界为三合帝国效力，捕获过五名战俘，甚至拥有与远域文明接触的授权，但所有这些经历，都未曾让你对大灾变的降临有丝毫准备。

messages.msgid: As a member of Psi 7, your job was to take out the dangerous rogue psychics that popped up with increasing frequency as the strangeness in the world increased.  Even before the end of the world you had seen enough bizarre things to write a dozen books, but nothing compares to what you've seen during the Cataclysm.
translations: 作为Psi 7的一员，你的职责是铲除那些危险的失控灵能者。随着世间异象纷呈，他们也开始愈发频繁地出现。即便是在末日降临前，你见过的奇闻怪事也足以写满十几本书，但这一切都无法与你在大灾变期间的所见所闻相提并论。

messages.msgid: Itzcuāuhtli Corps Liaison, Yohualli Ehēcatl Division
translations: 黑曜之鹰军团联络官，夜风师

messages.msgid: You make a habit of clearing your thoughts and finding your center, even amidst the chaos of the world.
translations: 即使在这个混乱的世界中，你也养成了清除杂念、找回本心的习惯。

messages.msgid: You spent many years traveling through the world, becoming wise and learned.  Normally you can answer any question, but even you are not quite sure what to do about the ravenous undead.
translations: 你用了很多年来游历世界，以增长见识变得聪慧。通常，你可以给出任何的问题的答案，但是即便是你也不知道该如何面对这些饥饿的不死生物。

messages.msgid: Over long years of self-imposed exile in the wilderness, you have come to an understanding with Mother Nature.  The world as they knew it might have ended for your forsaken species, but you can hardly tell the difference.
translations: 在野外历经长年的自我流放式的生活，你已经和大自然母亲达成了谅解。这个原属于被抛弃的人类的世界可能已经完蛋了，但是对你而言却依如昨日。

messages.msgid: You were dismissed from your position as a parapsychology professor at the local university and started your own business as a paranormal investigator.  Your former colleagues didn't approve of your research, but it looks like it's paying off now.
translations: 你曾任职于当地大学的超心理学教授，却被解雇，随后自立门户，成为一名超自然现象调查员。你过去的同事并不认可你的研究方向，但如今看来，这些研究终于开始显现其价值。

messages.msgid: You never made master, but you did very well in chess competitions before the Cataclysm.  All those hours of staring at the board, trying to keep all the pieces in your mind at once, have left you with a great ability to focus your attention on a single problem when you need to.
translations: 你不算是大师，但在大灾变之前的国际象棋比赛中表现得非常出色。你经历的那些努力记忆棋盘位置的时光，使你在处理问题时能很好地集中注意力。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm, many of your weekends were spent either competing in tournaments or studying records of past games, always trying to find the patterns.  All that time has also made you a master of concentrating on a specific subject, despite whatever is going on around you.
translations: 在大灾变之前，你花费了许多时间来参加比赛或者复盘，不断学习其中的规律。这些努力也使你成为了一位象棋大师，擅长专注于你的目标，无论周围发生了什么事。

messages.msgid: You were one of the best of the best, awarded a grandmaster title in your early twenties.  Chess was your passion and your life, and you were good enough at it to make a living competing before the Cataclysm.  You have an almost-inhuman ability to focus on a task and ignore all distractions.
translations: 你是顶尖的象棋选手，在二十多岁时获得了国际象棋大师的称号，国际象棋是你的爱好与生活。大灾变之前，你在比赛中表现出色，足以维持生计。你有一种几乎超人的能力，可以专注于任务并忽略一切干扰。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You feel in better shape than you ever have in your life, like you could run ten miles and climb a mountain and then wake up and do it again.  You'll probably need it.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。你从未感觉像今天这么棒，你可以连着跑十英里、爬上高山，一觉醒来又精力饱满。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You can breathe underwater and twist yourself enough to squeeze through a half-closed window.  You can run five meters in less than a second and shrug off a punch like it's nothing.  You'd almost be worried you were becoming one of those rioters, except you're definitely still sane.  Right?
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。你可以在水下呼吸，并扭转身体挤过半开的窗户。你可以在不到一秒的时间内跑出五米，而且毫不费力的吃下一拳。你几乎会担心自己会成为那些暴徒中的一员，然而你很肯定现在自己依然神志清醒。对吧？

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You can move inhumanly fast, hitting zombies before they even seem to know that you're there.  You can pull out nails with your bare hands and go out in winter without even a shirt and not feel the cold.  You're a new breed, Homo Cataclysmicus, and if anyone is equipped to survive in this new world, it's you.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。你可以以非人的速度飞速移动，在丧尸感知到你之前就击中它们。冬天赤手拔出钉子，甚至不穿衬衫出门也感觉不到寒冷。你现在算是个新人种，“大灾变种人”，如果人类还能在这个新世界中生存的话，那就非你莫属了。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You can read much faster and can see much better in the dark, and even in total darkness you no longer have any hesitation about moving.  At least once you avoided zombies on the other side of a wall that you didn't hear and couldn't see, but you, you just knew they were there.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。你读书速度更快、黑暗视力更强，甚至在完全黑暗中也能轻松行动。有一次你成功避过墙另一边的丧尸，你没听到也没看到，但就知道它们在那。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You can see auras around people that tell you what they're feeling, and you've already used it to avoid someone who was feigning being injured with the hope of stealing your gear.  You can see through walls, and tell where the best place to hit something is to take it down for good.  That last ability will definitely get plenty of use.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。你可以看到人们周围的气场，判断他们的感受。你已经利用它识破了一个假装受伤希望偷走你装备的人。你可以透视墙壁，并且感知到目标的弱点以便将其彻底摧毁。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You can finish books in a few hours and remember almost everything you read, you had to fix a bicycle a few weeks ago and even though you've never tried to do that before in your life, everything you needed to do just…came to you.  What's more, last time the Zs attacked you, you never got a scratch.  Three of them came at you at once and you dodged every attack because you could see what they were going to do before they did it.  If only you could see where you needed to go to be safe.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。你可以在几个小时内完成一本书，并几乎记住你读过的一切，几周前你不得不修理一辆自行车，尽管你以前从未尝试过这样做，但你所需要做的一切都...自然而然地完成了。更重要的是，上次丧尸袭击你时，你一点伤都没有。三个丧尸同时向你袭来，你躲过了每一次攻击，因为你能在他们行动之前看到他们要做什么。只有你自己才知道到去哪里才安全。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  While running down an alleyway to escape a group of rioters, you looked back and realized you were going to get caught and then there was a deafening crash of thunder and your vision went white.  When your hearing and sight came back, the rioters were lying in a heap, some still with smoldering clothes, and you were unscathed.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。当你在一条小巷里逃离一群暴徒即将被抓住时，随着一道震耳欲聋的雷电，你眼前白亮一片。当你的听力和视力恢复时，暴徒们东倒西歪，衣服还冒着烟，而你却毫发无损。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You an hurl lightning bolts from your hands, like some kind of superhero, and your smartphone still has a full charge even though you haven't plugged it in weeks.  Some kind of huge wasp attacked you in the woods and there was a crackle like thunder and it fell to the ground twitching.  You didn't stop to check if it would move again.
translations: 大灾变期间，在肆虐的风暴中发生了某些事，现在的你能够做到一些曾经看似绝无可能之事。你能像超级英雄一样从手中掷出闪电，你的智能手机明明已经几周没有充电，却依然满电。在树林里，一只巨大的黄蜂袭击了你，只听一道雷鸣般的爆裂声，它便抽搐着倒在地上。你没有停下来确认它是否还会动弹。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You managed to drive the entire week the sky broke on a single charge in your car, and while you had to abandon it since then it got you out of the worst of the cities.  Anything that attacks you has to face your lightning and you haven't found anything yet that can withstand it.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。在天空裂开的那一周，你连续开车开了整整一星期，直到抛锚，虽然从那时起你不得不放弃它，但起码让你摆脱了情况最糟糕的城市。任何攻击你的东西都必须面对你的闪电，而你还没有找到任何可以抵挡的东西。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You noticed that light seemed to bend at the will of your thoughts, when you were almost caught by a wandering horde, light slowly dimmed enough for you to hide in the shadows.  You have a sense that there's more to your newfound talents.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。当你快被尸群发现时，你注意到光似乎随着你的思维弯曲，光线慢慢变暗，足够让你隐藏在阴影中。你有预感，你的这项新能力远不止如此。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You can make the air glow and fire lasers from your hands, and even sometimes hear radio signals.  You haven't heard any other survivors out there yet, but you listen for a bit every night, just in case.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。你可以让空气发光，用手射出激光，有时甚至可以听到无线电信号。你还没有听到任何其他幸存者的声音，但你每晚都会听一会儿，以防万一。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  Many times a horde has passed within sight of you and simply never noticed you, and the few times they did, you just created illusions of yourself and all ran different directions.  The few stragglers were easy to sear to ash with focused light.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。尸群无数次从你眼前经过，却根本没有注意到你，而少数被它们注意到的几次，你创造了自己的幻象，然后就从另一个方向逃走了。而少数脱离大部队的怪物则轻易地被激光烧成了灰。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  With just a thought, you can start a fire or make light radiate from the very air.  It's already saved your life once when you burned a zombie to ash while scavenging in a ruined house.  Sure, the house burned down too, but you'll definitely get more control as time goes on, right?
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。只需一个念头，你就可以点燃火焰，或者让光线从空气中辐射出来。在一座废弃的房子里拾荒时，你曾经一次用火将一只丧尸烧成灰烬，这已经救过你一命了。当然，房子也被烧毁了，但随着时间的推移，你肯定会获得更多的控制权，对吧？

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You don't even know how many zombies you've burned at this point, and keeping warm in winter certainly won't be a problem.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。你现在都记不清自己烧死过多少丧尸，冬天保暖当然也不成问题。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You are one with the flames, and they come at your command and obey your every instruction.  Zombies, mutants, aliens, stranger things--no matter what is out there, you will incinerate it and survive.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。你与火焰合而为一，它们听从你的命令，服从你的每一个指示。 丧尸、变种人、外星人、怪兽——无论外面有什么，你都会能烧死它并继续活下去。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You can lift things with your mind.  Mostly just small things, but during the chaos a group of rioters jumped you and you hurled them off of you just by thinking about it.  This will definitely come in handy.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。你能光靠意念举起物体，虽然只能举起小型物品。但有一次面对暴徒的时候，你只靠意念就击飞了它们。迟早会派上用场的。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  Moving things at a distance is child's play.  You can pick up zombies and fling them away from you, shatter doors with a thought, and jump from the fifth story and land with barely a bruise.  Nothing is going to get close to you now.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。远距离移动物体对你而言就是小孩子的游戏。 你可以抬起丧尸并将它们从你身边扔开，用意念破门，从五层楼跳下来，却毫发无伤。现在没有什么能接近你了。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  One ton cars lift off the ground with merely a thought, bullets bounce off the air before they hit you, and you can smash whole groups of zombies to paste in seconds.  You can even fly from rooftop to rooftop, preventing gravity from affecting you by sheer force of will.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。重达一吨的汽车只需一个念头就从地面升起，子弹在击中你之前会在空中反弹，你可以在几秒钟内粉碎整群丧尸。你甚至可以从一个屋顶飞到另一个屋顶，通过纯粹的意念来防止重力影响你。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  The crazies were bad enough during the riots, but once you were stopped by a police officer whose bloodshot eyes told you that he wasn't going to let you off with a warning.  But you could somehow hear his thoughts, a chaotic jumble of rage and hunger and fear, you just…nudged them a little bit, and he wandered off and left you alone.  It doesn't work the same way with the zombies, but you can't have everything.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。暴动里的疯狂已经够糟糕的了，但有一次你被双眼通红的警察拦下，他看起来就不想让你活着离开。你似乎能听到他的思想，混沌的愤怒、饥饿、恐惧，你只是……稍稍把它们挪走，他就浑浑噩噩走开了。这招对丧尸好像不太奏效，但没什么是完美的。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  Sure, the zombies are immune to telepathy, but those rioters aren't and neither are some of the monsters you've run into.  At least once, you managed to warn off another survivor who you knew meant to rob you.  You left him unconscious and without his weapons, and if the zombies got him, well, he shouldn't have messed with you.
translations: 大灾变期间，在肆虐的风暴中发生了一些事情，如今你能做到一些过去看来绝无可能之事。诚然，丧尸对心灵感应免疫，但那些暴徒却并非如此，你曾遭遇的一些怪物也一样。至少有一次，你成功吓退了一名意图抢劫你的幸存者。你让他丢下武器昏迷不醒，而如果他最后落入了丧尸之口，那也只能怪他自己不该来招惹你。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  Controlling human minds is still too hard but at this point, animal minds are child's play.  A while back, some kind of mutated wolf or dog or something jumped you in the forest and after a few seconds, it was wagging its tail and jumping around like a new puppy.  You wish you still had it with you, but it died fighting off some kind of pink crustacean…thing, giving you time to run.  The bravest dog you ever had.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。控制人类的想法仍然太难，但就目前而言，控制动物就像儿戏一样。不久前，某种变异的狼或狗之类的在森林里向你扑来，几秒钟后，它就摇着尾巴跳来跳去，就像一只初生小狗一样。你希望你还带着它，但它在与某种粉红色的甲壳……怪物的战斗中死去，给你争取出了逃跑的时间。你养过的最勇敢的狗。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You were fleeing down a side street when you heard a crash above you.  You looked up and saw something hurtling through the air down toward you, you closed your eyes and wished you were anywhere but where you were, and then… you were.  Indoors, in a house near the street, and you went out the back door and made good your escape.  You're very, very good at escaping now.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。当你沿着一条小街逃离时，你听到了头顶上的一声巨响。你抬头一看，看到有东西从空中冲向你，你闭上眼睛，希望自己不在那里，然后……你就不在那里了。在室内，靠近街道的一座房子里，你走出后门，成功逃脱了。你现在非常擅长逃脱。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You can step through walls, and once you were surrounded by a horde and looked up and a nearby rooftop and… there you were, safe and out of the zombies' line of sight.  The rule of the zombie apocalypse is "keep moving", and you're the best you've ever been at that.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。你可以穿过墙壁，一旦你被尸群包围，只要抬头看向附近的屋顶然后……你就到了那里，安全而且远离丧尸视线。 丧尸末日里的规则是“不停前进”，而你在这方面的能力无出其右。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  No wall or door is a barrier to you and sometimes when you close your eyes you can travel to places you've already been.  Once you were surprised by a bandit and when he leveled his gun at you, you wished he was somewhere else and he just…disappeared.  Nothing can keep you down now.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。任何墙或门对你来说都不成障碍，而当你闭上眼睛时，你可以回到你曾经去过的地方。有一次你被一个强盗埋伏，当他举枪指着你时，你希望他在其他地方，然后他就……消失了。现在没有什么能阻挡你了。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  But teleporting through walls isn't the most impressive part.  You spent a few days in an abandoned basement and on a scavenging trip, one of those rioters surprised you.  Snarling, she had you by the arm and was prepared to smash in your head with a pipe and then you were just…back safe in that basement.  That will definitely come in handy.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。但穿墙传送还不算是最令人印象深刻的部分。 你在一个废弃的地下室呆了几天，在一次拾荒之旅中，其中一个暴徒突然出现。她咆哮着，抓住你的手臂，准备用钢管砸碎你的头，然后你就……安全回到了地下室。迟早会派上用场的。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You broke your leg when you got caught in a riot, and when things got really bad you were positive you were going to die.  But somehow, after only a few days your leg didn't seem to hurt nearly as much anymore.  By the end of the week you could walk on it, and by now it's like nothing ever happened.  It's not going to help you fight the zombies but it'll sure help you recover afterward.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。当你被困在暴乱中时，你的腿骨折了，当情况变得非常糟糕时，你确信自己将会死去。但不知何故，仅仅几天后，你的腿似乎不再那么疼痛了。一周过后，你已经可以走路了，现在就像什么都没有发生过一样。这不会帮助你对抗丧尸，但肯定会帮助你恢复过来。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  Just last week you were looking in an abandoned building and fell through a weak floor.  But you barely bled, and after a few minutes lying there you picked yourself up and managed to run away from the things that came to investigate the noise.  You didn't have enough water to properly clean your wounds but it hasn't seemed to have mattered.  You're already back to normal.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。就在上周，当你在一座废弃的建筑中拾荒时，从一块脆弱的地板上摔了下来。但你几乎没有流血，躺在那里几分钟后，你重新站了起来，并设法逃离了那些前来调查噪音的怪物。你没有足够的水来正确清洁伤口，但这似乎并不重要。你已经恢复如初了。

messages.msgid: Something happened during the storms that raged during the Cataclysm, and now you can do things that would have once seemed impossible.  You've suffered injuries that should have killed you multiple times over by now and recovered in days every time.  You've broken your leg twice, your arm once, drank bad water that had you puking your guts out, nearly been disemboweled by some mutated thing…every single time, your powers kept you going.  Hopefully they'll see you through to the very end of all this.
translations: 在大灾变期间肆虐的风暴发生了一些事情，如今你能做到以往看似不可能的事情。到目前为止，你已经多次遭受过本该致命的伤害，但每次都在几天内康复。你的腿断过两次，胳膊断过一次，喝了让你五脏六腑都吐出来的坏水，差点被某种变异的东西开膛破肚……每一次，你的灵能都让你继续前进。希望它能陪你度过这一切。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm you were always surprisingly flexible, and that ability has been greatly heightened after the world ended.  While you are not a fully awakened psion, you have a single trick you can use.  Hopefully it helps you survive.
translations: 大灾变前，你总是出人意料地柔韧。末日降临后，这项天赋更是得到了极大的增强。虽然你并非完全觉醒的灵能者，但你确实掌握了一项小小的伎俩。但愿它能帮你活下去。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm you always had a hidden reserve of power when you needed it, and that ability has been greatly heightened after the world ended.  While you are not a fully awakened psion, you have a single trick you can use.  Hopefully it helps you survive.
translations: 大灾变前，每当你需要时，体内总会涌现出一股隐藏的力量。末日降临后，这项天赋更是得到了极大的增强。虽然你并非完全觉醒的灵能者，但你确实掌握了一项小小的伎俩。但愿它能帮你活下去。

While you are not a fully awakened psion, you have a single trick you can use.  Hopefully it helps you survive.

Before the Cataclysm you always had a sense of when a line was drawing power, and that ability has been greatly heightened after the world ended.  While you are not a fully awakened psion, you have a single trick you can use.  Hopefully it helps you survive.

While you are not a fully awakened psion, you have a single trick you can use.  Hopefully it helps you survive.
translations: 大灾变前，屈指可数的几次打斗中，你总能不费吹灰之力就将对手放倒。末日降临后，这项天赋更是得到了极大的增强。虽然你并非完全觉醒的灵能者，但你确实掌握了一项小小的伎俩。但愿它能帮你活下去。

translations: 大灾变前，你总能轻而易举地穿行于拥挤的人群之中。末日降临后，这项天赋更是得到了极大的增强。虽然你并非完全觉醒的灵能者，但你确实掌握了一项小小的伎俩。但愿它能帮你活下去。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm you never had a single nightmare that you could remember, and that ability has been greatly heightened after the world ended.  While you are not a fully awakened psion, you have a single trick you can use.  Hopefully it helps you survive.
translations: 大灾变前，你从未记得自己做过任何噩梦。末日降临后，这项天赋更是得到了极大的增强。虽然你并非完全觉醒的灵能者，但你确实掌握了一项小小的伎俩。但愿它能帮你活下去。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm, animals always seemed to like you, and that ability has been greatly heightened after the world ended.  While you are not a fully awakened psion, you have a single trick you can use.  Hopefully it helps you survive.
translations: 大灾变前，动物们似乎总是很亲近你。末日降临后，这项天赋更是得到了极大的增强。虽然你并非完全觉醒的灵能者，但你确实掌握了一项小小的伎俩。但愿它能帮你活下去。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm, people just overlooked you when you didn't want to be seen, and that ability has been greatly heightened after the world ended.  While you are not a fully awakened psion, you have a single trick you can use.  Hopefully it helps you survive.
translations: 大灾变前，当你不希望被注意到时，人们就会自然而然地将你忽略。末日降临后，这项天赋更是得到了极大的增强。虽然你并非完全觉醒的灵能者，但你确实掌握了一项小小的伎俩。但愿它能帮你活下去。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm you just enjoyed good health no matter what you seemed to do, and that ability has been greatly heightened after the world ended.  While you are not a fully awakened psion, you have a single trick you can use.  Hopefully it helps you survive.
translations: 大灾变前，无论你做什么，你似乎总是身体康健。末日降临后，这项天赋更是得到了极大的增强。虽然你并非完全觉醒的灵能者，但你确实掌握了一项小小的伎俩。但愿它能帮你活下去。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm your injuries always seemed to heal pretty quickly, and that ability has been greatly heightened after the world ended.  While you are not a fully awakened psion, you have a single trick you can use.  Hopefully it helps you survive.
translations: 大灾变前，你的伤口似乎总是愈合得特别快。末日降临后，这项天赋更是得到了极大的增强。虽然你并非完全觉醒的灵能者，但你确实掌握了一项小小的伎俩。但愿它能帮你活下去。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm bee stings and poison ivy never bothered you, and that ability has been greatly heightened after the world ended.  While you are not a fully awakened psion, you have a single trick you can use.  Hopefully it helps you survive.
translations: 大灾变前，无论是蜂蜇还是毒藤都奈何不了你。末日降临后，这项天赋更是得到了极大的增强。虽然你并非完全觉醒的灵能者，但你确实掌握了一项小小的伎俩。但愿它能帮你活下去。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm you never really seemed to get sick, and that ability has been greatly heightened after the world ended.  While you are not a fully awakened psion, you have a single trick you can use.  Hopefully it helps you survive.
translations: 大灾变前，你似乎从来没生过什么大病。末日降临后，这项天赋更是得到了极大的增强。虽然你并非完全觉醒的灵能者，但你确实掌握了一项小小的伎俩。但愿它能帮你活下去。

messages.msgid: You survived a portal storm and hid inside while reality broke around you, and when you left to examine the damage you found a strange crystal the storm had left behind.  It was captivating, and you took it with you.  Sometimes, at night, you look into it before you sleep, and you almost feel like something in you is responding to the glow within the crystal.
translations: 你在一场空间风暴中幸存了下来，在躲藏的同时你周围的现实破碎了，当你离开去检查损害情况时，你发现了风暴留下一块奇怪的晶体。它很迷人，你把它带走了。有时，在晚上睡觉前，你会看着它，你几乎感觉到你身体里有什么东西在回应晶体里的光芒。

messages.msgid: You were always good at athletics.  People praised your effort and hard work, but the truth was you barely needed to practice.  It all just came naturally to you, as naturally as breathing.  That kept you safe during the Cataclysm--you outran the dead and worse things that chased you and made it out of the cities, and they're certainly the thing that will keep you going, especially since now, you're stronger and faster than you've ever been.
translations: 你的体育成绩一直很好。 人们称赞你的努力和勤奋，但事实上你几乎不需要练习。 这一切对你来说都是自然而然的，就像呼吸一样自然。 这保证了你在大灾变期间的安全--你跑赢了那些追杀你的死人和更可怕的东西，逃出了城市，它们当然也是你继续前进的动力，尤其是现在，你比以往任何时候都更强壮、更敏捷。

messages.msgid: You knew the world was going to end, but they never listened.  They never listened!  They couldn't see the things that walked among them!  They didn't know what you had seen, what you knew was coming, and where are they now?  In a zombie's stomach or walking with those corpses themselves, but you're still alive.
translations: 你知道世界正在走向终结，但他们从不倾听。 他们从不听 ！他们看不到在他们中间行走的东西！ 他们不知道你看到了什么，你知道即将发生什么，他们现在在哪里？在丧尸的胃里，或者和那些尸体一起走着，但你还活着。

messages.msgid: You followed your parents' wishes and became an engineer, and to your surprise you were extremely good at it.  It was like the electronics you built just spoke to you, like you could see inside the wires and circuits, and then when the sky broke that literally came true.
translations: 你遵循了父母的愿望，成为了一名工程师，令你惊讶的是，你在这方面非常擅长。就像你建造的电子设备在与你交流一样，就像你能够看到电线和电路的内部，然后当天空破碎时，这一切都变成了现实。

messages.msgid: Ever since you were a young kid, you just loved magic.  Growing up you managed to become a professional magician and even performed at a few big shows.  You were practicing a new trick when the Cataclysm hit, when you realized you don't need to practice anymore.  You can just do it, for real.
translations: 自从你还是个小孩的时候，你就喜欢魔术。长大后，你成功成为一名职业魔术师，甚至在几个大型演出中表演过。当大灾变来临时，你正在练习一种新的魔术，突然你意识到你不再需要练习了。你可以真正地做到它。

messages.msgid: Fire always fascinated you.  The fires you set almost got you arrested a few times, but the urge was just too powerful.  It was like they were calling to you, urging you to create them.  And ever since the sky broke, you can create fire with merely a thought.
translations: 火总是让你着迷。你因为纵火被逮捕了好几次。但这种冲动太强烈了。它们似乎在呼唤你，催促你。而自从天空破碎以来，你只需一个念头就能创造火焰。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm, you were 'volunteered' for a top-secret military project.  They never told you what all the injections and EEGs and hours of staring at a quarter on the table were supposed to accomplish, but now that you can move things with your mind you have a pretty good idea what they were aiming at.
translations: 大灾变前，你被“自愿”参加了一个绝密的军事项目。他们从未透露，那些注射剂、脑电图检测，以及让你连续数小时盯着桌上硬币的训练究竟目的何在。但如今既然你能用意念移动物体，大概就知道了他们到底想要什么。

messages.msgid: You did not die in the Cataclysm because on paper, you are already dead.  You assumed a new identity as part of an experimental program designed to produce psychic interrogators.  They told you that you were serving your country, that your gifts would be the key to winning the new Cold War that was surely developing, but they didn't consider the ramifications of having a telepath on the base.  You knew right away that things were much worse than the brass was telling you, and your gifts let you "persuade" the guards to let you out even in the face of the lockdown.  You had thought to go somewhere else, to get away from New England, but the end came much faster than even you thought it would.
translations: 你没有在大灾变中死去，因为在档案记录上，你早已是个死人。你获得了一个新身份，作为旨在培养灵能审讯员的实验计划的一员。他们告诉你，你是在为国效力，你的天赋将是赢得新一轮冷战的关键。但他们并未考虑到，基地里有一位传心者会带来怎样的后果。你立刻就意识到，情况远比高层透露的要糟，而你的天赋让你即便是在全面封锁之下，也能“说服”守卫放你出去。你曾想过去往别处，远离新英格兰，但末日的降临比你预想的还要快得多。

messages.msgid: The last thing you remember was inputting the jump coordinates into the tliltilhuicaātl drive and reaching out to initiate the transfer when there was a power surge and it felt like the entire ship was turning inside out.  Now, you have no idea where you are.
translations: 你所记得的最后一件事是将跃迁坐标输入进“特里尔维卡特尔”引擎之中，在伸手启动跃迁时，一道灵能波动袭来，感觉整艘船都天翻地覆。 现在，你不知道你在哪里。

messages.msgid: People came to you for diseases that modern medicine told them were incurable, and you made them well.  At least, they felt well, and that was what mattered.  Now the dead walk and do not respond to your exhortations, but your healing works better on yourself than it ever has on anyone else.
translations: 人们来找你治疗现代医学认为无法治愈的疾病，而你使他们康复了。至少，他们感觉良好，这才是最重要的。现在死者行走，不回应你的劝告，但你的治疗在你自己身上比在任何其他人身上都要有效。

messages.msgid: You were on guard duty when the ship was preparing to enter Tliltilhuicaātl and had just braced for the jump when something went wrong.  The ship seemed like it was turning inside out, then you seemed like you were turning inside out, and suddenly you were planetside in the ruins of a dying world.  You've served the Excān Tlahtōlōyān on a dozen worlds, taken five captives, and even have clearance for contact with huecachane civilizations, but none of that has prepared you for the Cataclysm
translations: 飞船正欲驶入黑水之渊，你正在当值守卫。就在你为跃迁稳住身形之际，异变陡生。先是飞船，再是你本人，都仿佛被由内而外地翻转过来。下一刻，你已置身于一颗垂死行星的废墟之上。你曾辗转十余个世界为三合帝国效力，捕获过五名战俘，甚至拥有与远域文明接触的授权，但所有这些经历，都未曾让你对大灾变的降临有丝毫准备。

messages.msgid: As a member of Psi 7, your job was to take out the dangerous rogue psychics that popped up with increasing frequency as the strangeness in the world increased.  Even before the end of the world you had seen enough bizarre things to write a dozen books, but nothing compares to what you've seen during the Cataclysm.
translations: 作为Psi 7的一员，你的职责是铲除那些危险的失控灵能者。随着世间异象纷呈，他们也开始愈发频繁地出现。即便是在末日降临前，你见过的奇闻怪事也足以写满十几本书，但这一切都无法与你在大灾变期间的所见所闻相提并论。

messages.msgid: You don't understand what happened.  You were readying for a routine jump at the Far Hebrides transfer point when there was a power cascade in the drive and now you're here, on some other version of Tlalticpactli that may as well be one of the worse levels of Mictlān.  You need to find your way back home, but first you need to find a way to survive.
translations: 你不明白发生了什么。在“法尔赫布里德斯”转移点准备进行例行跃迁时，引擎发生了灵能共振，现在你在另一个维度的“特拉尔蒂克帕克特里”，可能还是“米克特兰”等级最糟糕的那个。你需要找到回家的路，但首先你需要找到活下去的方法。

messages.msgid: Since the start of the Cataclysm, something has been hunting you relentlessly.  You can try to fight it, but each time it falls it will rise again, its powers growing stronger and stronger.  The only escape is for you to die.
translations: 自从大灾变开始以来，有只怪物一直永不停歇地追杀着你。你可以将它击退，但它总能卷土重来，它的力量越来越强。唯一的解脱就是你的死亡。

messages.msgid: You always loved setting fires as a child, sometimes spending hours just watching the flames.  That fire awakened in you during the Cataclysm, powerful and almost uncontrollable.  You can call up flames from thin air, burn zombies to ash with a thought, surround yourself in a blazing inferno, but the fire demands release.  It's like a internal pressure, growing as long as you don't use your powers, until it flows out as the flames rise.  Can you survive in the new world without burning yourself to ash?
translations: 孩提时，你总是痴迷于纵火，有时会花上好几个小时凝视着火焰。大灾变期间，那团火焰在你体内觉醒，它强大无比，几乎无法掌控。你凭空就能召唤烈焰，一念之间便可将丧尸焚为灰烬，也能让熊熊炼狱环绕己身，但那火焰渴求着释放。它就像一股内生的压力，只要你不动用能力，它就会不断积聚，直到最终化为冲天烈焰喷薄而出。在这个新世界里，你能在不引火自焚的情况下活下来吗？
